Ersa kieliewo, "Eneshi olon kunlade usurusan bi yenjisan chusun wo.

Ersa hhende kieliewo, "Bi chade shuhua kielieye, ene xii tigha lianhui kheilatula chi mii 3 hui ulie renjine."

Ingiese YajipaBaolode kieliewo, "Chi intughanighala mii kieliezhi Mexihani tuji gholughanu?"
Baolo kieliewo, "Intughaniye olune, olonye olune. Chi, pse enedu enende chenliesan kunla man bi mutun gholuse giezhi bi Hudase onxian giezho, zinie bi mutun jieliu bu zho giezho."
Ingiese honshan, shenzhan, Beinisi, pse sousan kunlare bosizhedene
khuina dao echi nieniedene kieliezho, "Ene kun fuguku, khaku zui ese fanjizho."
Ingiedene YajipaFeisidude kieliewo, "Ene kun Kaisa honshande ese zhazhoshi eqighan andaghawo."
Bijienni chon soughazhi Idalide echighane giezhi jiejin giese hhela Baolo, psedu fanrenlai hongun buduilani nie baifuzhande jiuizhi ogiwo. Niereini Yuliu giene.
Niekozi Yadamiqiense iresan chon Yaxiya oronni haibienzighun yone giezho. Bijien hhe chon jiere khirei yowo. Bijienre hhantu yosanshi Maqidunni Qiesalonijia kun Yalidagu wo.
Khuichudu Xidunde kuruwo. YuliuBaoloi danren giezhi zhanlienlaini uzheghale echise zhanlienlani Baoloi zhaogu giezho.
Hhense chonni keizhi qiise kei shun uwoshi bijien keini piizhi Saipulusiyi beimienghun yozho.
Bijien Jilijia, Panfeiliyani meliedu haini daodene Lijiani Meilade kuzhewo.
Hhende niekozi Idalide echine giesan Yalishandani chonni penjise baifuzhan bijienyi hhe chon jiere khireighawo.
Lienjizhi giedudu chon yozhi tanshi kuzhe dazhi ingiezhi cai Genitu bienzide kuzhewo. Kei bijienyi jiohoro giese Samonini bienzise keini piizhi Kelitedao douraghun yozho.
Bijien bienzighun yose chon yozhi chijia no wo. Ingie cai Laxiya chenshini kouisan Seighan Haibienzi giezhi nie oronde irewo.
Oloncha shijien danwu giezhi orozo bareiku shihou ijin daose pse chon keizhi wixiennudawo. Ingie Baolo kunlade sughazhi kieliewo,
Dajiala, bi uzhese enefa chon keizhi wixien no wo. Zinie ho, chonni qida olughaku pusho, matan aminne da gui dane.
Baifuzhan Baoloi kielienni ese chenliezhi chon keisan kun, chonni ezhanyi kielienyi chenliezho.

Ene haibienzide uncha daoghaku chijia wo. Ingiese dabufen kunla hhense likai giezhi Feinikede echidene uncha daoghaye giezhi jiejin giewo. Feinikeshi Kelitedaoni nie haibienzi wo. Niemienni xinan miende wo, niemienni xibei miende wo.
Ene shihoude nanbangiese ga kei bosiwo. Hhela sumulase zhao jihuaghala yose olune giezhi chon beighaku gougoui khizheghadene Kelitedaoi kouizhi yozho.
Oloncha ese beidene nie honfenkei Kelitedao bienzise feilie irewo. Hhe honfenkeini nierei Dunbeifen giene.
Chonni kei wiqi agise pse melie yo da, keini dagha yozho.
Nie ga daoni nierei Gaoda giene. Bijien ene daoni kanzighun keini piizhi yozho. Khuina laisan ga chonni beigha dazhi ingiezhi beighawo.
Ga chonni laizhi khizhedene zhashighala fugie chonni zhouwini banla goudaghawo. Saierjini usu douradu shazide guai feilieghakuse ayizhi chon jieredu fugie popui bouzhegha chonni durare yoghawo.
Bijienyi kei, lan izhi biidene jindaghase khuichudu hhela holai haide bendawo.
Pse niudu daosenu hhela chonde injisan dunxilai qinsi bendawo.
Hao giedudu naran, hodunyi chanla dawo. Honfenkei bijienyi biise bijienyi jiuiku xiwon widawo.
Kunla giedudu yama ese ijiezho. Baolo hhelai dunda beidene kieliewo, "Dajiala, ta mini kielienyi indan chenliekui wo. Kelitedaose likai ese giewoshi imeghei sunshiji qida olukui uwo.
Ede bi tande kielieye, ta zhughene tei. Tai kiemai amin nieda ulie widane, zinie chon widane.
Mii gonjisan, bi beiisan Hudai qienxien uzhughu xii mii kanzide beizhi kieliewo,
'Baolo, bu ayi. Chi kenjin Kaisa honshanyi melie beine. Huda chighala hhantu chon sousan kunlade pinnan ogine.'
Ingiese dajiala, zhughene tei. Huda made matugiezhi kieliese qintui gholukui bi xianxin giene.
Matanyi nie haini dao jiere guai feilieghane."
14 qien kurudene xienidei chon Yadeliyahai jiere hheliezhi eneman hheman giezho. Chabudu banyedei chon jieredu wiliechila zemin jiere chadashiwo gie,
jiochighala nie nanjise gunde 12 zhan wo. Melie gouji yodene pse nie nanjise 9 zhan wo.
Hhela chon tashi jiere mughukuse ayizhi chon boghose jieran chon beighaku gougoui boughadene ogheikui panjizho.
Wiliechila chon beighaku gougoui chon qiorunse boughazho giezhi yanzi gie, ga chonni usude bougha, holuku muji daizho.
Baolo baifuzhan, buduilade kieliewo, "Enezighan kunla chon jiere ulie feiliese ta aminne gui dane."
Ingiese buduila ga chonni zhashii chizhi siragha anda boughawo.
Ogheikude Baolo ashighalade ijiuni ijie giezhi sughazhi kieliezho, "Ta izhi yama ese ijiezhi enedushi 14 qien oluwo.
Ingiese bi tande sughazhi kielieye, ta gouji ijie. Ene tai aminni jiuine. Tai kiemadai nieganzi usunye ulie widane."
Ingie Baolo ene kielienyi kieliedene ginanyi barei ashighalai melie Hudade mafan kieliedene ghulu ijiewo.
Ingie hhela man zhughene teizhi ijiewo.
Bijien chon jiere 276 gie kun wo.
Hhela ijie chududene chonni gongiereghane giezhi boudeilai haide bendawo.
Ogheisenu hhela hhe oronyi tani dawoma, nie haibienzii chanlawo. Ingie chonni jinlianji bienzide echighane giezho.
Ingie jiesunyi chizhi siragha chon beighaku gougoui haide boughawo. Fanxian kunzhi gieku doni sularaghazhi popui lai khireighase zhao keizhe bienzide echiwo.
Lianmienni usu hhantulasan shazitu oronde chonni qiorunyi jiai beighawo. Lan chon boghoi eghi qida olughawo.
Ingiekude fanrenla unba holu widakuse ayizhi buduila hhelai alane giezho.
Baifuzhan Baoloi jiuine giezhi hhelai ingiezhi ese gieghawo. Ingie fenfulazhi unba mejiechen kunla usude jioli bou, xien bienzide khirei giewo.
Psedu kunla banba, chon jieredu dunxighala bienzide khirei gie wo. Ingiezhi dajialai jiuizhi usu bienzide khireiwo.
Bijien pinnande bienzi jiere khirei, ene daoni Maerta giekui mejiewo.
Hhe oronyi kunla bijiende gou no wo. Hhende ghura bouzhi qienqi kuiqienshi khan sideraghazhi bijienyi zhaogu giewo.
Baolo ezighan muzhai qiangu ire khande teise nie mogheii tulie bazilie da, holu khizhe Baoloi khaini jinji beizho.
Hhe oronyi kunla moghei hhei kha jiere horo beisanyi chanladene nieniedene kieliezho, "Ene kunshi kenjin nie sharenfan wo. Haise jiui khizhewoma, asiman hhei aminne ulie olughane."
Baolo mogheini khande benda oroghawoma, shan ese deilazho.
Hhela sumulase hhe khaitumu, pse zemin jiere fura boudene fugumu giezho. Oloncha sagheise yama uye giesei chanladene kharei hheshi nie huda wo giezho.
Hhe shida nie ghazha wine, dao jieredu zui fugie noyen Bubailiunughun wo. Hhe bijienyi jienliezhi shixinji ghurudu zhaodai giewo.
Ingiekude Bubailiuni adani fashao giezhi xieli kudene kijiezho. Baolo orozhi echi onxian giezhi hhei jiere khane teiwo.
Ingiese dao jieredu gientulaye irezhi man goudaghawo.
Hhela bijienyi hende danren giezhi bijien yokude mo jiere injiku dunxilai chon jiere khughozhi ogiwo.
Dao jiere ghuran sara beidene bijien nie Yalishandase iresan chon jiere khirei yo qiiwo. Ene chonshi haini dao jiere uncha daoghasan wo, qiorun jiereni Shongo giesan hao teizho.
Bijien Xilagude kurudene ghurudu beiwo.
Pse hhense raoizhi Lijiwunde echiwo. Niudu daose nanbangieni kei bosise khuichudu Bujiulide kuruwo.
Hhende ezighan gaijiulai ochiradene bijienyi xinlazhi echi hhelare hhantu doludu souwo. Bijien ingiezhi Lomade kuzhewo.

Hhendedu gaijiula bijienyi xioxini sonosudene Lomase Yabiwu geidoude, pse Ghuran Lishe giesan ime gholo oronde bijienyi jienliele irewo. Baolo hhelai chanladene Hudade mafan kieliezhi danzi fugiedawo.
Bijien Lomade kuruse Baoloi uzhesan nie buduighala danxin soukui tunyi oluwo.

Ghurudu daodene BaoloYutai kunni lindaolai uruzhi irewo. Hhela irese Baolo kieliewo, "Gaijiula, bi goya kunlane, xienrenlai guijinni fandui gieku shiqin uye giezhoma, mii Yelusalende bareizhi Loma kunde jiuizhi ogiwo.
Hhela mii shenwun giezhi yama fuguku zui ereizhi olu dadene mii andaghane giese
Yutai kunla fandui giezhi made banfa widadene Kaisa honshande zhawo. Bi goya kunlane zhane ese giezho.
Ingiese bi tai xinlazhi ire danmien kielieye giezho. Bi Isilie kunla panjisan hhe kunyi yenyin jiere ene qieshenyi zhozho."
Ingiese hhela kieliewo, "Bijien Yudayase chii kieliesan xinni jienliezhi ese daozho. Gaijiula dundaye kiema chii zhazhi yama huaini kieliezhi ese daozho.
Ingieliuzhe bijien chii ijien matugiezho giezhi chenlieku duran wine. Ene jiomunni kunla gochude fandui giekui bijien mejiene."

Ingiese hhela udu jinjidene olon kunla Baolo sousan oronde irewo. Baolo eqiemaghase khara olutula hhelade Hudai gojiai daolii jianjizhi ganzhen beizho. Musani shu, xienzhilai shughala Ersani shiqinyi kieliezhi shundaghawo.
Baolo kieliesan kielienyi chenliedene niezhanla xianxin giewo, niezhanla xianxin ese giewo.
Hhelai ijien kiemai ijien buxianshi sandane giekude Baolo nie aman kielien kieliewo, "Shenlin Isaiya xienzhii tungo giezhi tai xienrenlade kieliesan kielien ese codazho,
'Chi echidene ene bexinlade kielie, 'Ta izhi chenliezhoma, dunjire dane. Ta izhi uzhezhoma, minbai olu dane.
Ene bexinlai zhughe khiduzhezhi chighin beidazhi nudunne hameizho. Pse nudunni chanlazhi chighinni sonosuzhi zhughedeni minbai oludene kharei daorese Bi hhelai goudaghakuse ayizho.
Ingiese ta mejiendu. Huda ene jiuiku daolini niman kunlade chonjizhi ogiwo. Hhelaye chenliene."
Baolo goya bouisan giedene ghua hon souzhi hhei ochirale iresan kunlai man jienliewo.
Hhe zui fugie danzighala Hudai gojiai daolii jianjizhi Ezhan Ersa Mexihani shiqinyi kunlade sughase danlachen kun uwo.
Loma
Bishi Ersa Mexihani hoji Baolo wo. Hudai gouxioxini zhomen chonjighane giezhi mii uruzhi iredene shitu danlaghawo.
Ene gouxioxishi eqighanse Huda xienzhilai tungo giezhi zhiguitu jinwun jiere dain giesan wo.

Gouxioxishi Hudai kewon, mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihai kieliezho. Hhei kunni fanmiende kieliese Dawudeni houdei wo. Zhiguitu ruhherni fanmiende kieliese fugie nenlighala fugusan kun dundase aminne oluzhi Hudai kewon bikui mejieghawo.
Huda Mexihai tungo giezhi bijiende shitu danlaku nenjien ogidene soyuji minzulade hhei nierei xianxin gieghazhi shunjighazho.
Ene dunda taye wine. Huda tai uruzhi iredene Ersa Mexihanughun danlaghawo.
Huda orezhi uruzhi iredene shentu danlaghasan Loma kunlade bi xin huaizho. Mai ada Huda, Ezhan Ersa Mexiha tande nenjien, pinnan ogi gie!
Bi xien ta dajialade oluzhi Ersa Mexihai tungo giezhi bi zunjisan Hudade mafan kieliekushi ta xianxin giesei qienxiani kunla man mejiezho.
Bi onxian giekude ese beidene tai jilazho. Bi hhei kewonni gouxioxi jiere zhughesene shunjisan Huda enende ganzhen beine.
Bi chan xiahua giese Hudai isi enbese bi zuihoude tai hhende echine.
Bi tai hende chujiegheku duranshi Hudai nenjienni tande deilazhi tai khiduzheghane giezho.
Isishi matan nieniene xianxin giekughala nieniedene zhichi gieye giezho.
Gaijiula, psedu minzula dundashiku mutun tai dundase jiego khizheghane giezhi bi tai hhende haojihui echine giesan jihuai tande mejieghaku duran wine. Daliuzhe jiohoro giezhi echi dazho.
Bugon Xila kun, wigokun, unhuatu kun, unhua witu kunlade bi yama chaisan mutun giezho.
Ingiese bi ta Lomade sousanladeye gouxioxini chonjine giezhi hende duralazho.
Bi gouxioxise ulie shizhene. Gouxioxishi soyuji xianxin giesan kunlai jiuiku Hudai nenli wo, xien Yutai kun, pse Xila kun.
Gouxioxi jiere Hudai gundanni khizhezho. Ene gundanni kaishi giezhi baratula xianxin giekughala giene. Jinwun jiere kieliesan mutun, "Gou kun xianxin giekughala amiturane."
Hudai hokuku doghunnighala zhendaoi duisan kunlai soyuji xienlian witu, gou wituni kunlai jiere asiman jierese bouzhezho.
Ingiekushi kunla Hudai shiqinni mejiekui man mejiene. Hhelade Huda qinchude uzheghawo.
Duyai zhayaghasanse Hudai tejien, hhei chanqiku nenlini chanla danema, zhayaghasanlai uzhezhi qinchude mejiene. Ingiese kunlade yama kieliekui uwo.
Hhela Hudai mejienema, Huda wo giezhi ulie kuaizhi mafan ulie kieliene. Hhelai sumulaku yama oronde wiku gholuwo, zhugheni benni gholuzhi kharanide wo.
Hhela goyane jienzha wo giezhoma, ben wo.
Hhela chanqiku Hudai famani fuguku kun, bunzhu, yewo, ghugheilai yanzi gholughawo.
Ingiese Huda hhelai ese gonjidene hhela nefuxinne daghazhi zannannide echizhi nieniene beyede shizhekuni giezho.
Hhela Hudai zhendaoi jianighala daiqi giedene zhayaghachenni ese beiidene zhayaghasanlai shunjizhi beiine. Hudashi indan chanqi kuaikuni wo. Amine.
Ingiese Huda hhelai ese gonjidene hhela shizheku nefuxin giezho. Hhelai biereila zhenchande giekui ulie giedene zhenchan wini giene.
Ere kunlaye biereighalane zhenchande giekuni ulie giedene nienieni nefuxin bazilie dase ere kun ere kunghala shizhekuni giene. Ingiezhi hhelai codasande indan chenfa giekui goya jierene ireghazho.
Hhela Hudai tanise guazi wo giese Huda hhelai ese gonjidene guazitu sumuladande fanqi giewo. Ingiese hhela ulie giekuni giezho.
Hhelade yanyanji gou wini, doghunni, tanxin, mouxienni duruzho. Dubilieku, alaku, eghinduku, piendaku, tuguni duruzho. Xienhua kieliene,
beihoude kunni sugiene, Hudai henjine, kunni yamacha ulie teine, goyane fugiede uzhezhi kuaine, doghun shiqinyi khizheghane, ada anadene ulie shunjine.
Yama ulie mejiene, kieliendene ulie kurune, oreku, ubali xiiku zhughe uwo.
Hudai guijin mutunshi jien ene shiqinni giesan kun indan fugukuni hhela mejiene. Ingieliuzhe goyalane giene, da kunla giese gou wo giezho.
Ingiese chi ene kunlai kieliechen kun, chi kienliuzhe yama jiekou erei dane. Chi kunlai kieliekude goyaneye niekielienji giese goyadene zui jinjizho.
Huda intui giechen kunlai gundande panjikui matan mejiene.
Chi ene kunlai kieliedene niekielienji giesan kun, chi sumulase Hudai panjikuse andane giezhou?
Huda tebieji goude giezhi, ranjizhi, rennai giese chi meilade uzhenu? Huda chade goude giekushi chii geizhen gieghane giekuni ulie mejienu?
Chii zhughe khidunde geizhen ulie giedene Huda gundande panjiku hhe udu kuzhetula goyadene Hudai hokukui izhi olodoghazho.
Huda kunla giekughala kunlade kharulune.
Gou wilieni izhi giezhi kuaiku, gou minshen, chanqi ulie qida olukuni giesan kunlade Huda chanqiku aminni ogine.
Zi goyane guizhi zhendaoni ulie shunjidene gou winii shunjichen kunlade hokuku, faikughala kharulune.
Jien doghunnii giesan kunlade zeinan, tunkuni ogine. Xien Yutai kun, pse Xila kun.
Jien gounii giesan kunlade kuaiku, gou minshen, pinnanni ogine. Xien Yutai kun, pse Xila kun.
Huda kunlai pienxin ulie giene.
Jien guijinni chenliezhi uye daodene zui fanjisan kunla guijinghala gonxi widene widane. Jien guijinni chenliedene zui fanjisan kunlai guijinghala panjine.
Guijinni chenliese Hudai melie gounide ulie sanane, guijinni zunjise gounide sanane.
Guijin ese ogisan niman kunla olusanse goyane guijin mutun giese, hhelade guijin uwoma, ene hhelai guijin gholuwo.
Giesanlaini uzhese guijinni yoqiu hhelai zhughede teisei mejiene. Lianxinniye enende ganzhen beine. Hhelai zhughede maodun giezhi goyane kheilane, baohu giene.
Eneshi, bi chonjisan gouxioxi mutun, Huda Mexiha Ersai tungo giezhi kunla niuighasan shiqin man panjiku hhe udude fashen giene.
Chi ene goyane Yutai kun wo giesan, guijinni kouizhi Hudai mejiene giezhi goyane kuaizho.
Chi Hudai isii mejiene, guijinse suruzhi gounii fenji shidane,
goyane sughoni udurusan wo, kharani dundadu gon wo giezho.
Chi guijinghala erlin, zhendaoi zhanwo giezhi ben kun, kesilade sughachen loushi danlane giezhi goyane xianxin giezho.
Qinse chi kunlade sughase goyadene yan giezhi ese sughazho? Kunlade bu ghula giezhi sughadene goyane ghulanu?
Chi kunlade piofen bu gie giezhi kieliedene goyane piofen gienu? Chi nigiedalai uzhe dadene, goyane mioni dunxii ghulanu?
Chi guijinni kuaidene guijinni fanjizhi Hudai shizheghanu?
Jinwun jiere kieliesan mutun, "Tai yenyinghala niman kunlai dunda Hudai nierei sugiezho."
Chi guijinni zunjise giesan hetoune haochu wine. Hetoune giedene guijinni fanjise hetoune ese giesanghala niekielien wo.
Ingiese hetoune ese giesanla guijinni zunjise hetoune ese giezhoma hetoude ulie sananu?
Hetoune ese giedene guijinni zunjisan kunla hetoune giezhi huaisan guijinni bidene guijinni fanjisan kunni zui jinjine.
Biomien jiere Yutai kunshi Yutai kun pusho. Beye, mienzide giesan hetouneshi zhen hetoune pusho.
Zinie sudoro Yutai kun danlasan kunshi Yutai kun wo. Zhen hetouneshi zhughenughun wo. Huaisande ulie kouine. Shenlinde kouine. Ene kunyi kuaikushi kunse iresan pusho, Hudase wo.
Ingiese Yutai kun danlase yan haochu wo? Hetoune giese yande gou wo?
Go fanmiende wine. Xien Hudai kielienyi hhelade ogiwo.
Niezhanla xianxin ulie giese matugiene? Hhela kekao wise Hudaye kekao uwonu?
Kenjin pusho! Kunla man ghudan kieliese Huda ghudan ulie kieliene. Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun, "Chi kielien kieliekude gundan wo giene. Shenwun giekude chi injine."
Matanyi gou wiku Hudai gounii khizheghase matan matui kieliene? Huda matanyi faise gundan uwonu? Bi kunni jiodughala kieliezho.
Kenjin pusho! Qinse Huda matugie duyani panjine?
Bi ghudan kieliedene Hudai zhennii qinchushighazhi hhei kuaise mii yangiezhi zuiren mutun panjine?
Qinse matan huaini gieyema, gouni irene giezhi yale ulie kieliene? Niezhanla bijien ingiezhi kieliezho giezhi zhazho. Ene kunlai indan panjikuni wo.
Ingiese bijien Yutai kun niman kunlase hen onu? Kenjin pusho! Kunla man zui dunda wo, Yutai kun niman kun man niekielien wo giezhi bijien kieliezhi daozho.
Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun, "Gou kun uwo, nieliuzhe uwo.
Minbai oluchen kun uwo, Hudai ereichen kun uwo.
Kunla man xiemachalazhi yama oronde uwo. Gounii giechen kun uwo, nieliuzhe uwo."
Hhelai gholei keisan meza niekielien wo. Hhelai kielienshi kun piendakui wo. "Hhelai aman furedeni mogheii du wine."
Hhelai amande okho sugiekui duruzho.

Kun alane giese ghujin no wo.

Guijinshi guijintu kunlade kieliesei matan mejiene. Ingiedene soyuji kunlai amanni menjighazhi qienxiani kunlai man Hudai panjikude ireghane.
Guijinni zunjizhi giedene Hudai melie gounide sanasan kun nieda uwo. Guijinni tungo giezhi zuini mejiene.
Ede guijinse chugo Hudai gundanni khizhezho. Enende guijinshu, xienzhishu jiere ganzhen beizho.
Hheshijiu Ersa Mexihai xianxin giesan jien kunlade olusan Hudai gundanni wo. Yan kunliuzhe niekielien wo.
Jien kunla zui fanjidene Hudai famade dai dazhoma,
Ersa Mexihai shuikui tungo giezhi Hudai nenjienghala belien gouni wo giezho.
Huda Ersai kunni oronde fugughazhi shuiku gholughawo. Hhei xianxin giesan kunlai zuini mienliene. Ingiezhi Huda gundanne uzheghawo. Eqighandei Huda kunla fanjisan zuini rennai giezhi ese gonjizho.

Ene mimi ede xienjizhi khizhezho. Chanqiku Hudai minlin mutun xienzhilai shuni tungo giezhi soyuji minzulade mejieghadene hhelai xianxin gieghazhi shunjighawo.
Ersa Mexihai tungo giezhi zi niekozi aghelitu Hudade chanqi kuaikui ogi. Amine!
1 Gelindo
Hudai isighala urudene Ersa Mexihade shitu danlasan BaoloSoqini gaijiughala

Gelindoni Hudai jiohuide xin huaizho. Tai Mexiha Ersai miende zhiguishighazho, gochude mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihai nierei xiahua giesan kunlare hhantu man shentu giezhi uruzho. Mexihashi hhelai Ezhan wo, mai Ezhanye enbene.
Mai Ada Huda, Ezhan Ersa Mexiha tande nenjien, pinnan ogi gie!
Huda Mexiha Ersai miende tande nenjien ogise bi tande oluzhi bi zunjisan Hudade chan mafan kieliezho.
Ta hhei sudoro kielien kielieku, erlin, yanyanjilai jiere man hendazho.
Ingiezhi Mexihade beisan ganzhen tai dunda khiduzhezho.
Ta nenjien jiere yama ese chaizhi mai Ezhan Ersa Mexiha xienjikui sagheizho.
Huda tai zuihou kutula khiduzheghazhi mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihani udude ulie kheilaghane.
Hudashi kekaoni wo, hhe tai uruzhi goya kewonre, yeshijiu mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihare laiwon gieghazho.
Gaijiula, mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihani niereghala bi tai goude fenfulaye, ta man xianlitu kielien kielie. Tai dunda maodun bu khizhezhi nie zhughe nie sumuladanghala goude heqishi.
Mii gaijiula, tai dunda maodun wine giezhi Gelaini giededu kunla made kieliezho.
Mii isishi ta jien kunla, "Bishi Baolonughun wo," "Bishi Yabolonughun wo," "Bishi Jifanughun wo," "Bishi Mexihanughun wo." giezhi kieliezho.
Mexihashi fenkai giesanni onu? Baolo tande oluzhi shizijia jiere fuguwu? Ta Baoloni niereghala xili jienliewu?
Bi Jilisibu, Gaiyughalase chugo pse tai dunda kiemade xili ese gieghasande Hudade mafan kieliezho.
Pse ta mii niereghala xili jienliewo giezhi kunla kieliene.
Bi Siqifanai gieni kunladeye xili gieghazhi daozho, psedu kunlade xili gieghazhi daozhoyeshi bi matazho.
Mexiha mii peikushi xili gieghaku pusho, gouxioxii chonjighaku wo. Bi aghelitu kielienghala ese chonjizho, pse Mexihani shizijiai zoin widane.
Shizijiani daoli hhezighan widachen kunladeshi ben wo, matan enezighan ji0 uisan kunladeshi Hudai nenli wo.
Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun, "Bi aghelitu kunlai aghelini widaghane, jienzhatu kunlai jienzhani bendane."
Aghelitu kun khala wo? Hanjia khala wo? Ene duyani erlintu kun khala wo? Huda ene duyai aghelini benni ese gholughazhou?
Duya goya aghelighalane Hudai ese taniwo. Ingiese Huda kunla benni wo giesan bijien chonjisan daolighala xianxin giesan kunlai jiuine giezhi jiejin giewo. Eneshi Hudai agheli wo.
Yutai kun ghudureqi kerezho, Xila kun agheli ereizhoma,
bijien chonjisanshi shizijia jiere ghadasan Mexiha wo. Eneshi Yutai kunde banjiku tashi wo, niman kunde benni woma,
bugon Yutai kun niman kun, Huda urusan kunde Mexihashi Hudai nenli, Hudai agheli wo.
Hudai benni kunni aghelise fama wo. Hudai zholienni kunni khidunnise khidun wo.
Gaijiula, tai urusanni nie sumula. Kunni isighala kieliese tai dunda aghelitu, nenlitu, zhiguitu kun choghon wo.
Huda duya jieredu bennilai sunghuzhi aghelitulai shizheghazho. Huda duya jieredu zholiennilai sunghuzhi khidunnilai shizheghazho.
Huda duya jieredu kunla uzhezhi xiniesan, henjisan, yama witu kunlai sunghuzhi winetulai widaghazho.
Ingiese kun kiemada Hudai melie goyane kuai dane.
Ingiezhoma, Huda tai Mexiha Ersare hhantulaghazho. Hhe Hudase irezhi mai agheli, gundan, zhigui, shuiku gholuwo.
Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun, "Kien kuaise Ezhanyi kuai."
Gaijiula, eqighandei bi tai hhende echizhi Hudai mimii chonjikude seighan kielien, aghelighala ese giezho.
Bi tai dunda bikude zinie Ersa Mexiha, pse hhei shizijia jiere ghadasanse chugo psedulai ulie mejiene giezhi jiejin giewo.
Bi tai hhendeshi zholien, ayi, hende pugharazho.
Bi kieliezhi chonjikude seighan, aghelitu kielienghala ese giezhi Shenlinni nenlighala zhenmin giezho.
Ingiese tai xianxin gieku kunni aghelide ese kouizho, Hudai nenlide kouizho.
Ingiezhoma, xinyan jiere qiendasan kunlade bijien aghelini jianjizho. Eneshi duyai agheli pusho, duyai qienlini bareizhi widachen kunlai agheliye pusho.
Bijien jianjisanshi eqighandei niuighasan Hudai mimitu agheli wo. Eneshi Huda duyai zhayaghaku melie matande famai ogine giezhi jinjisan wo.
Ene aghelini duyani qienli bareichen kunla dunda mejiechen nieda uwo. Hhela mejiezhoshi famatu Ezhanyi shizijia jiere ulie ghadane.
Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun, "Hudade oresan kunlade Huda zhunbei giesanshi nudunghala uzhezhi ese daosan wo, chighinghala chenliezhi ese daosan wo, kunni zhugheye sumulazhi ese daosan wo."
Ingiezhoma, matande Huda Shenlinni tungo giezhi mejieghawo. Shenlin yanniliuzhe mejiene, lien Hudai chijia isiniye mejiene.
Kunni sudorodu ruhherse chugo kunni shiqinni kien mejiene? Niekielien wo, Hudai Ruhherse chugo Hudai shiqinni kiema mejie dane.
Matan jienliesanshi duya jieredu ruhher pusho, Hudase iresan ruhher wo, ingiese Huda matande ogisan nenjienlai matan mejiene.
Bijienye enelai jianjikude kunni agheli sughasan kielienghala ese giezho, Shenlin sughasanghala giezho. Ruhhertu shiqinlai ruhhertu kielienghala mejieghane.
Hudai Ruhher uwotu kunla Hudai ruhher ogisanlai jienlie dane. Hhela enei ben wo giezho, ye dunjire dane. Ene shiqinlai zinie ruhherghala uzhe khizhene.
Ruhhertu kunla yan shiqinniliuzhe uzhe khizhenema, kiema hhelai uzhezhi khizhe dane.
Kien Ezhanyi zhughei mejiene? Kien hhende surughane? Mai kieliese matande Mexihani zhughe wine.
Gaijiula, bi eqighandei tande kielien kieliekude tai ruhhernughun danlagha dazhi beyenughun danlaghazho. Mexihai miende tai yeliwa mutun uzhezho.
Bi tande budan ese qiezhezhi neizi qiezhekushi ta budanyi ijie dane, edeliuzhe ijie dane.
Tashi beyenughun wo. Tai sudoro dubilieku, jianjinduku wine. Eneshi beyenughun pushonu? Zhao duyani kunla giesan mutun ese giezhou?
Niezhan kunla kieliese bi Baoloni daghazho. Niezhan kunla kieliese bi Yaboloi daghazho giezho. Ingiezhi ta duyai kunlare niekielien pushonu?
Yaboloshi kien wo? Baoloshi kien wo? Manshi wiliechi wo, zhao Ezhan nieniede ogisan renwughala tai xianxin gieghasan wo.
Bi tareiwo, Yabolo usu teiwo, osighasanshi Huda wo.
Ingiese tareisan, usu kiesan yama pusho, zinie osighasan Huda hen wo.
Tareisan, usu kiesanghala niekielien wo, zhao nieniede wilie giesan mutun gunzi ogine.
Bijienshi hhantu wilie giesan Hudai wiliechi wo. Tashi Hudai ghazha, mechi wo.
Zhao Huda made ogisan nenjienghala bi nie hen guntou mutun jichui daizho, psedu kun jiereni gie giezhoma, jien kun matugie giekui xioxin gie.
Ene dai goudaghasan jichushi Ersa Mexiha wo, psedu jichui kiemada dai dane.
Ene jichu jiere kienliuzhe antan, miengu, boushi, mutun, osun, ghuyughala gie giese
panjiku udude jien kunla giesei xienjizhi khizheghane, khanghala khizheghane. Goya giesanla matugiezho giezhi ene khan shiine.
Gie giesan kun hhe jichu jiere giesan bei shidase hhende jianli ogine.
Giesanni sidera widase hhe kuiine. Hhei jiuinema, jiuiku hoxian khan dundase holu khizheku niekielien wo.
Tashi Hudai dajien bikui, pse Hudai ruhher tai sudoro sousanyi ta ulie mejienu?
Kien Hudai dajienyi qida olughase Huda hhe kunyi qida olughane. Hudai dajienshi zhiguitu wo, tashi ene dajien wo.
Kienliuzhe goyane bu pienda. Tai dunda kun goyane ene duyade agheli wine giezhi sumulase benni gholu. Ingiese aghelitu gholune.
Ene duyani aghelii Huda uzhese benni wo. Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun, "Ezhan aghelitu kunlai jienzhanii hhelai bareiku on gholughawo."
Pse huaizho, "Aghelitu kunlai sumulaku yama isi witui Ezhan mejiene."
Ingiese kienliuzhe kunni bu kuai, yanliuzhe manshi tanughun wo.
Baolo, Yabolo, Jifa, duya, amituku, fuguku, edeku shiqin, jianlaiku shiqin manshi tanughun wo.
Tashi Mexihanughun wo, Mexihashi Hudanughun wo.
Ingiese ta bijienyi Mexihani wiliechi, pse Hudai chijia daolini gonjia danlaghakui wo.
Gonjiade yoqiu giekushi shixinji giekui wo.
Ta mii kielie yehao kunla kielie yehao bi yamacha ulie teine. Bi goyane goya ulie kieliene.
Bi sumulase mii lianxinde yama ese chaizhoma, ingieliuzhe minughun man oluzho giezhi kielie dane. Mii kieliekushi Ezhan wo.
Ingiese shihou ese kuzhezhi Ezhan ese iretula ta kienyiliuzhe bu kielie. Hhe irese kharade niuighasanlai zhouizhi khizheghane, kunyi zhughei mujilai khizheghane. Hhe shihoude Huda jien kunlai kuaine.

Gaijiula, bi tande oluzhi ene shiqin jiere Yaboloji goyane bilazhi yanzi uzheghazho. Ingiekushi jinwun jiere jilasanse bu daogha giesan isii ta bijiense suru giezho, pse tai dunda kienliuzhe goyane bu kondazhi ene niei fugiede uzhe, hhe niei meilade uzhe bu gie giezho.
Kien chii kunlare niekielien pusho giezho? Chii alinieshi chade ogisan pusho? Ogisan enbese ogisan pusho giezhi yale goyane kuaine?
Ta ijin chuduzho, ijin bayazhewo. Bijiense chugo ta honshan danlawo. Mii xiwonshi ta zhenzhenji honshan danlama, bijienye tanre hhantu danlaye!
Bi sumulase Huda bijien shitu danlasanlai zhan eghisanse barei ire sixin panjisan kun mutun zui khuina teizhi kunlade uzheghasanyi xianli. Bijienyi xi mutun duyani kunlade, qienxienlade uzheghazho.
Bijien Mexihani yenyinghala benni gholuzho, ta Mexihai miende jienzhani gholuzho. Bijien zholien wo, ta khidun wo, kunla tai kuaizho, bijienyi meilade uzhezho.
Eli kuliuzhe bijien oliesuzhi undasuzho, hulan muchughun wo, kunlase neizhi souku oron uwo.
Khishulazhi goyane khaghala wilie giezho. Kunla kharase bijien gounii kieliezho, kunla heise rennai giezho.
Kunla bijienyi sugiese bijien gou kielienghala khareizhi kieliezho. Edeliuzhe bijien duya jieredu zannanni, yanyanjilai dundadu laji gholuzho.
Bi enei huaise tai shizheghane ese giezho, goya oresan kesilane mutun tande jingao giezho.
Mexihai miende tande loushi olon no woma, ada olon uwo. Bi gouxioxii chonjizhi Mexiha Ersai miende tande ada danlazho.
Ingiese bi tai goude fenfulaye, ta mii yanzii suru.

Ene yenyin jiere bi Qimotaini peizhi tai hhende echighawo. Hheshi Ezhanyi miende bi oresan shixinji kewon wo. Hhe tai qixin giezhi bi Mexiha Ersai sudoro matugie giesei, pse go oron, go jiohuilade matugie sughasei jilaghane.
Tai dunda niezhan kunla sumulase bi tai hhende ulie irene giezhi goyalane fugiede uzhezho.
Ingieliuzhe Ezhan duran bise bi tai hhende ghujighan echidene goyane fugiede uzhesanlai kielienni ulie uzhene, nenlii uzhene.
Hudai gojiashi kieliende uwo, nenlide wo.
Ta yan kerene? Bi banban bareizhi tai faile iremu, oreku, renyitu zhugheghala ire?
Bi chenliese shuhuajia tai dunda lon kijieku shiqin wine. Intu shiqin niman kunlai dundaliuzhe uwo. Nie kun goya khuitu anarene kijiezho.
Ta dou goyalane fugiede uzhene. Ta indan hende nango giekui wo. Ene shiqinni giesan kunni tai dundase tou khighakui wo!
Mii kun tanre hhantu uwoma, zhughemi tanre hhantu wo. Bi tai hhende bisan mutun intu shiqinyi giesan kunyi Ezhan Ersai niereghala ijin zui jinjiwo.
Ta hhantulazhi mii zhughe tanre hhantu bikude mai Ezhan Ersani qienlighala
intu kunni Ibiliside jiuizhi beyeni huailugha gie, ingiese ruhheryini Ezhanni udude jiuine.
Ta goyalane kuaise ese oluzho. Goujinie kunieghe nie duizi ghurunni man faighakui ta ulie mejienu?
Tashi tanmien woshi khuichen kunieghei widaghadene shini ghurun gholu. Matanyi Jiulidaosan Jieni ghoni ghughan yeshijiu Mexihai ijin zharuzhi sidagha giewo.
Ingiese matan jieqi daoghase doghun, mouxientu khuichen kuniegheghala bu daoghadene ganjin, shixintu tanmienghala daoghaye.
Bi eqighandei tande xin huaizhi ta lon kijiechen kunlare laiwon bu gie giezhi kieliewo.
Mii isishi ene duyadedu lon kijiechen, tanxin giechen, piendachen, nigiedai beiichen kunlare jiedui laiwon bu gie giekui pusho. Qingiese ta ene duyase likai giese da gou wo.

Ede bi ene xinni tande huaikushi goyaneshi xianxin giesan gaijiu wo giedene lon kijiesan, tanxin giesan, nigiedai beiisan, kun sugiesan, jiu ochisan, piendasan intui giesan kunlare ta laiwon bu giezhi budanye hhantu bu ijie giezho.
Ghadanedu kunyi bi kheilaku pushoma, sudorodu kunyi ta kheilaku pushonu?
Ghadanedu kunyi Huda panjine. "Ta dundasene mouxien kunlai tou khigha."
Tai dunda jianjinduku shiqin bidene matugie shentulade ese zhazhi gou witu kunlade zhale echizho?
Shentula duyai panjikui ta ulie mejienu? Ta duyai panjise ene ga shiqinlai panji danu?
Matan qienxienlai panjikui ta ulie mejienu? Ingiese duyai shiqinni yan sanane?
Ingiese jiohuide intu shiqin bise matugie jiohui zunzhun ese giesan kunlai panjighane?
Bi ingiezhi kieliekushi tai shizheghane giezho. Tai dunda gaijiulai shiqinyi chuli gieku aghelitu kun nieda uwonu?
Tai dunda gaijiula gaijiulai zhazhi dou xianxin ulie giechen kunlai melie zhale echiwo.
Ta nieniene zhase tanughun fugiede codazho. Ta yale bixinde ulie beizhi kui ulie ijiene?
Ta khareidene kunlai bixindaghazhi kuighazho, hhelashi goyai gaijiu wo.
Gou witu kunla Hudai gojiai jienlie dakui ta ulie mejienu? Goyane bu pienda, lon kijiechen, nigiedai beiichen, piofen giechen, ere kun biozi danlachen, tunxinlien giechen,
ghulachen, tanxin giechen, sudochen, kunni sugiechen, piendachen enela Hudai gojiani jienlie dane.
Tai dunda niezhan kunla eqighandei intui giezhi daozhoma, ede Ezhan Ersa Mexihani niere, pse mai Hudai ruhherni tungo giezhi tai ijin waghazho, zhiguishighazho, gounide sanazho.
Goyane yan shiqin gieliuzhe olune giezhi kunla kieliezhoma, man haochu bikui pusho. Bi yan shiqin gieliuzhe oluzhoma, alinie shiqinniliuzhe bi goyane kunzhi ulie gieghane.
Ijiuni kielide oluzho, kieli ijiunide oluzho giezhoma, Huda ene ghualai widaghane. Beyeshi lon kijiekude giesan pusho, Ezhande oluzhi giesan wo, Ezhan kunni beyede oluzho.
Huda Ezhanyi aminne olughazhi maiye goya nenlighalane aminne olughane.
Tai beyeshi Mexihani iyanzi bikui ta ulie mejienu? Bi Mexihani iyanzii biozini iyanzi gholughazhi olunu? Kenjin ulie olune!
Biozighala hhantulase hheghala nie beye gholukui ta ulie mejienu? Jinwun jiere kieliezho, "Ghuala nie beye gholune."
Ezhanghala hhantulasan kun Ezhanghala nie ruhher gholune.
Ta lon kijieku shiqinse pii. Kun yan zui fanjiliuzhe beye ghadane giezho, zinie lon kijiekushi goyai beye jiere giezho.
Tai beyeshi Huda tande ogisan Shenlin tai sudoro souku dajien bikui ta ulie mejienu? Tashi goyanughun pusho,
fugie jiageghala agizhi iresan wo. Ingiese ta beyeghalane Hudai kuai.
Xin jiere ta qiisan shiqinni kielieye. Ere kun eme kunni ulie shighase gou wo giezhoma,
lon kijieku shiqinlase ayizhi ere kunde bierei bise gou wo, eme kunde zhanguiji bise gou wo.
Zhanguiji biereidene zhanguiji danlaku zherenyi feii, biereiye zhanguijidene ingiezhi gie.
Bierei goya beyene gonjiku qienli uwo, qienli zhanguijide wo. Zhanguijiye goya beyene gonjiku qienli uwo, qienli biereide wo.
Ghuala nieniene bu kuigha. Zinie zhomen onxian giene giese ghuala tunyi bise zhanshi jiere danlin kijiese olune. Khuinashi ghuala hhantula, pse ta goyane kunzhi gie dakude Ibilisi miine.
Bi ingiezhi kieliese tande minlin ese xiaizho, ijien qilazho.
Mii xiwonshi kunla man bi mutun woshi giezhoma, jien kun Hudase jienliesan nenjien buxian wo. Niezhanla ingiezho, niezhanla qingiezho.
Jiehun ese giesan, pse guafulai kieliese hhela bi mutun jiehun ulie giese gou woma,
goyane kunzhi gie dase jiehun giekui wo. Zhughe tuliezhi bazilie datula jiehun giese gou wo.
Jiehun giesanlade bi fenfulaye. Eneshi bi fenfulasan pusho, Ezhan fenfulasan wo. Bierei zhanguijisene bu danxinra.
Danxinrase pse jiehun bu gie, yen zhanguijighalane gouda. Ere kunye biereine bu benda.
Psedu kunlade bi kielieye. Eneshi Ezhan kieliesan pusho, bi kieliesan wo. Xianxin giesan gaijiude xianxin ese giesan bierei bizhi hhe bierei hhere hhantu udu daoku duran bise hhei bu benda.
Biereide xianxin ese giesan zhanguiji bizhi hhe zhanguiji hhere hhantu udu daoku duran bise hhei bu benda.
Ese xianxin giesan zhanguiji biereini yenyinghala zhiguitu gholune. Ese xianxin giesan bierei zhanguijini yenyinghala zhiguitu gholune. Pse tai kesila ganjin uwoma, ede hhela zhiguitu wo.
Xianxin ese giesan kun danxinrane giese hhei danxinragha. Intu shiqinde xianxin giesan gaijiu eghechijiulade ziyu wine. Huda tai urukushi tai heqishighane giezho.
Bierei danlachen, chii tungo giezhi zhanguijiichii kenen jiui shidane. Zhanguiji danlachen, chii tungo giezhi biereinichii kenen jiui shidane.
Alinie kunliuzhe Ezhan nanpeilasan mutun, pse Huda hhei urusan mutun udu dao. Eneshi bi go jiohuilade jinjisan wo.
Niezhan kunlai hetoune giedene uruzhoshi jihaoni widaghaku biyo uwo. Niezhan kunlai hetoune ese giedene uruzhoshi hetoune gieku biyo uwo.
Hetoune gie, ulie gie zhunyo uwo. Zui zhunyonishi Hudai minlinyi goude zunji.
Jien kunyi urukude matui woshi qingiezhi bei.
Chii urukude chi hoji danlazhoshi munan bu gie. Ziyushiku jihui bise goude barei.
Hoji danlasei Ezhan uruse hheshi Ezhanni ziyutu kun wo. Ziyutu kunyi uruse hheshi Mexihani hoji wo.
Tashi fugie jiageghala agizhi iresan wo, kunde hoji bu danla.
Gaijiula, jien kunyi urukude matui woshi Hudai melie qingiezhi bei.
Jiehun ese giesan kunni kieliese made Ezhanni yama minlin uwoma, Ezhan made ubali xiizhi mii nie kekaotu kun gholughase bi ijienne kielieye.
Edeku kunnan mutunshi bi uzhese ta qinkonne ulie bienjighase gou wo.
Chade bierei bise hhense danxinrane bu gie. Chade bierei wise bierei agine bu gie.
Bierei agise zui ese fanjizho, oqin jiehun gieseye zui ese fanjizhoma, jiehun giesan kunla udu daokude ku shouine, bi tai intu ku shouighaku duran uwo.
Gaijiula, bi tande kielieye, shihou oloncha widawo. Enedu khuinashi bierei bichenla bierei wichen mutun giekui wo.
Wilachenla ese wilachen mutun gie. Bayasuchenla ese bayasuchen mutun gie. Dunxi agichenla yama uwoku mutun gie.
Duya jieredulai xianshou giesanla xianshou ese giesan mutun gie. Edeku duyai yanzi widane.
Mii duranshi ta yamade munan ulie giesejiu. Bierei ese agisanla Ezhanni shiqinde munan giezhi matugie Ezhanni bayasughakui sumulazho.
Bierei agisanla duya jieredu shiqinde munan giezhi matugie biereine bayasughakui sumulazhi
zhugheni nie jiere uwo. Guafu, oqinla Hudai shiqinde munan giezhi beye, ruhherlani man zhiguishighane giezho. Biereila duyani shiqinde munan giezhi zhanguijine matugie bayasughakui sumulazho.
Bi ene kielienyi kieliekushi tai gonjine ese giezho, tai gounide oluzho. Tai olusan shiqin gieghazhi psedu shiqinde zhughe bu chilazhi zhomen Ezhanni shunji giezho.
Nie kun goyade bolusan oqinyi kuighawo giese pse hhe oqinye jiehun gieku nasunse daose hhe kun sumulase indan jiehun giene giese zhao goyane isighala gie, eneshi zui pusho. Hhelai jiehun giegha.

Bijienyi zhanshi jieredu gongien kunnan jianlai ireku hashu witu chanqiku fugie famani chenjighane.
Bijien gonxin giekushi chanlaku pusho, chanla daku wo. Chanlakushi niechaku wo, chanla dakushi chanqiku wo.
Mai zemin jieredu zhanfanyi chei widaghase Hudai hhense ireku gie matande winekui matan mejiene. Kunni khaghala giesan pusho, asiman jieredu chanqiku gie wo.
Matan ene zhanfande shonholozhi asimanse iresan gieghala jien musiku mutun arunzhakui panjizho.
Qingie musise hulan muchughun ulie gholune.
Matan ene zhanfande gunduni beiliezhi shonholokushi teine ese giezho, musine giezho. Ingiezhi ene fuguku beyei amin yenji boughane.
Ene mujide oluzhi matai nanpeilasanshi Huda wo. Hhe matande Shenlinni yajin danlaghazhi ogiwo.
Ingiese, matan beyede bikude Ezhanse gholo bikui mejienema, matande chan fugie danzi wine.
Matan yan giese chanlakughala ese giezho, xianxin giekughala giezho.
Matande fugie danzi wine. Beyese likai giezhi Ezhanghala hhantu souku genjia duran wine.
Ingiese matan beyedeye olune beyese likai gieye olune matanyi mujishi hhei bayasughane.
Matan man bixi Mexihani shenpantai melie xienjizhi khizheghadene zhao jien kun giesan gouni, doghunni mutun kharulune.
Ezhanshi indan zunjikui bijien mejiese kunlade sughazhi kieliene. Huda bijienyi mejiene, bi xiwon giese taye zhughedene bijienyi mejie.
Bijien pse tande goyalane jieshao ese giezho, bijienyi kuaiku jihuini tande ogine giezho. Ingiese hhezighan zhughei ulie uzhedene mienzii uzhezhi kuaisan kunlai melie kieliekui wine.
Bijien fenjiulise Hudade oluzho, zhenchanshi tande oluzho.
Ingiekushi Mexihani oreku bijienyi biizho. Nie kun soyuji kunlade oluzhi duya ijiese soyuji kunla duya ijiesanyi bijien mejiene.
Mexiha soyuji kunlade oluzhi duya ijiekushi amitu kunla pse goyadene oluzhi ulie amiturazhi hhelade oluzhi duya ijiedene aminne olusan Ezhande oluzhi amituraghane giezho.
Ingiese enedu khuinase matan kienniliuzhe kunni uzhedanghala ulie uzhene. Eqighandei Mexihaniye kunni uzhedanghala uzhewoma, ede pse qingiezhi ulie uzhene.
Kien Mexihai miende bise hheshi shini giesan kun wo, khuichennila daozhi man shinii gholuwo.
Enelashi man Hudase iresan wo. Hhe Ersa Mexihai tungo giezhi matanyi goyarene goudaghazhi pse kun Hudaghala goudaghaku renwuni matande ogiwo.
Eneshijiu Huda duyai kunlai zuini ese asadene Mexihai tungo giezhi goyarene goudaghazho. Pse goudaghaku daolini matande jiuizhi ogiwo.
Ingiese matan Mexihai daibio giezho. Huda matai tungo giezhi kunlade sidaghazhi kieliezho. Matan Mexihai oronde ta Hudare gouda giezhi tai xiahua gieye.
Huda hhe zui wituni matande oluzhi zuitu gholughakushi matanyi hhei sudoro Hudai gouni gholughane giezho.
Hudare hhantu wilie giesan bijien tai xiahua gieye, Hudai nenjienni jienliezhi belienni bu gholugha.
Huda kieliezhi, "Heshitu shihoude bi chinughunyi chenliewo. Jiuiku udude bi chade banman giewo." giezho. Uzhe, ede zhen heshitu shihou wo, uzhe, ede zhen jiuiku udu wo!
Bijien giesan wiliene ulie sugieghane giezhi jinlianji kiendeliuzhe chijia ese teizho.
Khareidene goyaneshi Hudai hoji wo giezhi yanyanji shiqin jiere uzheghazho. Jiushi olon rennai gieku, kunnan, chijia shiqin, zeinan,
eghiku, khaku, nouiku, khishulaku, kijie daku, ijie daku dunda
bijien ganjinde giezhi erlin, rennai gieku, renyi, Shenlin, zhenzhenji oreku,
shuhua kielieku, Hudai nenlighala giezho. Borun soghei khade gundan uqi bareidene
bugon bijienyi zunjiye hao, shizheghaye hao, sugieye hao, kuaiye hao bijien ingiezhi giezho. Kunla kieliese piendachen wo giezhoma, bijien shuhua kieliezho.
Bijienyi kiema ulie mejiene giezhoma, niere fugie no wo. Fuguwo giezhoma, amitu wo. Bijienyi faizhoma, ese alazho.
Bijien yuchou giesanyi xianlima, chan bayasuzho. Nanxin wo giezhoma, olon kunlai bayazheghazho. Uzhese yama uwoma, yanliuzhe wine.
Gelindo kunlaya, bijien tande zhijie kieliezhi zhughene keighazho.
Bijien tai zhughei ese meilashighazho, ta goyalane meilashighazho.
Bi kewosidene kielieku mutun kielieye, bijien giesan mutun taye bijiende zhughene keigha.
Ta xianxin ulie giechen kunlare nie jiabanyi bu zho. Gouni mouxiennighala matugie hhantulane? Gon kharanighala matugie laiwon giene?
Mexiha Bilieghala matugie heqishine? Xianxin giesan, ulie xianxin giesanghala matugie hhantu giene?
Mechi nigiedaghala matugie hhantulane? Matanshi chanqiku mechi wo. Zhen Huda kieliesan mutun, "Bi hhelai dunda souzhi hhelare laiwon giene. Bi hhelade Huda danlane. Hhela made bexin danlane."
Ezhan kieliezho, "Ingiese ta hhelai dundase khizhezhi hhelase danxinra. Zannan dunxilai bu shighama, bi tai jienliene.
Bi tande ada danlane. Ta made kewon oqin danlane. Eneshi nenlitu Ezhan kieliesan wo."
Ingiese mii orentula, matande enezighan dain giesan bise beye, zhughe jieredu zannannilane waghazhi man widaghadene Hudai zunjiku zhugheghala onqienji zhiguishighaye.
Ta aghui zhugheghala bijienyi jienlie. Bijien kiemai ese kuighazho, kiemai ese heizhi pienyi ese zhanjizho.
Bi ingiezhi kieliekushi tai kheilane ese giezho. Bi eqighandei kieliezhi daosan mutun ta chan bijienyi zhughede bizhi bijien tanre amiturazhi fuguliuzhe hhantulaku duran wine.
Bi tande xinxin fugie wo, tai ologhonni kuaizhi zhughedemi futan no wo. Bijien shouisan olon kunnan dunda bi hende bayasuzho.
Bijien Maqidunde kurudeneye hhamura dazhi gochuse kunnan shouizho. Ghadane maodun wo, sudoro ayizho.
Ingieliuzhe xiwon widasan kunlai sidaghazhi kieliesan Huda Qidoi irekui tungo giezhi bijienyi sidaghazhi kieliewo.

Zinie hhei irekughala pusho, hhe tai hhense jienliesan sidaghazhi kieliekughala bijienyi sidaghazhi kieliewo. Ta mii sanasan, goya nango giesan, pse ta made rexinde giesei hhe made man kieliese bi genjia bayasuzho.
Bi tande hhe xinni huaizhi tai zhanshi jiere nango gieghasei mejiedene houhui giezhoma pse houhui ulie giene.
Ede bi bayasukushi tai nango gieghasande pusho, nango giedene geiikude echighasande wo. Ta Hudai isi mutun nango giedene bijien tai ese shanjizho.
Zhao Hudai isi mutun nango giese houhui ulie giezhi geidene jiuine. Duyai nango gieku kunyi fugughane.

Ta nie uzhe, ta zhao Hudai isi mutun nango giedene ede tai dunda imegheni rexinde gieku, goyane huiku, doghunnide hokuku, jinshen khizheku, mini sanaku, bayasuzhi gieku, codasanni faiku wine. Ene shiqin jiere go fanmiende ta goyalane gou bikui zhenmin giezho.
Ingiese bi tande hhe xinni huaise pienyi zhanjisan kunde ese huaizho, kuighasan kundeye ese huaizho. Khareidene ta bijiende rexin bisei Hudai melie tande zhenmin giene giezho.
Ingiese bijienyi sidaghazhi kieliewo. Ene sidaghasanse chugo ta olon kunla Qidoni zhughei futanshighazhi bayasughase bijien genjia bayasuzho.
Bi Qidode tai kuaizhi daozhoma, ta mii ese shizheghazho. Bijien tande kieliesan kielienshi man zhenni bikui mutun bijien Qidode tai kuaisanshi zhenni bikui zhenmin giewo.
Ta manla hhei shunjizhi ayi pugharazhi goude jienliesei hhe sumula irese tande oreku zhughe genjia hhereizho.
Bi tande onqienji zhughene teise bayasuzho.
Gaijiula, Huda Maqidun jiohuilade ogisan nenjienni bi tande mejieghaye.
Kunnan dunda hhelai fugiede shiikude hende bayasuzhi tebieji nanxin bikude kunlade tebieji dafande ogizho.
Hhela banman giekude zhao nenlighalane, pse nenlisene chaogo giezhi goyalane ogisei bi ganzhen bei shidane.
Hhela bijienyi haojihui hende xiahua giezhi shentulade banman gieku shiqin jiere jihui ogizhi guzi beigha giezho.
Hhela giesan bijien sumulasanse olon chaogo giezho. Hhela goyane xien Ezhande ogizhi pse Hudai isighala bijiende ogizho.
Ingiese bijien Qidode ene gou shiqinyi chi kaishi giese tai dunda giezhi chengun olugha giezhi sughazhi kieliewo.
Ta xianxin gieku, kielien kielieku, erlin, rexin, bijien tande oreku jiere man kunlase zui goude giesan mutun nanxin kunlade banman gieku shiqin jiereye zui goude giekui bijien xiwon giezho.
Bi ingiezhi kieliese tande ese fenfulazho, kunlai rexinghala tai oreku zhugheshi shixinji enbenu pusho bikui uzhene giezho.
Mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihani nenjienyi ta mejiene. Hhe yenlai bayan wo, tande oluzhi nanxinshikushi hhei nanxinnighala tai bayazheghane giezho.
Kunlade ogiku shiqin jiere bi tande sumulakune kielieye. Ta ingiezhi giese gou wo. Ta udai honse ene shiqinyi zui melie giezho, zui melie duralazhoma,
giezhi qiikude bisan rexin mutun ede ene shiqinyi giezhi chengun olugha. Zhao nengou biku mutun gie.
Ta duranghalane ogise Huda jienliene. Uwokulane ogi ese giezho, winekulane ogi giezho.
Bi kunlai gongienshighazhi tande kunnan ireghane ese giezho, manlai izhishighane giezho.
Edeku tai bayan hhelai chaisande banman gie shidaku mutun hhelai bayan jianlai tai chaisande banman giene, ingiese izhishiwo.
Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun, "Olon ghurasanlade feiliekui uwo, choghon ghurasanlade chaikui uwo."
Bi tande oluzhi rexintu zhughei Qidoi zhughede teisan Hudade mafan kielieye.
Qido bijien fenfulasei chenliezhoma, goyane genjia rexin bizhi yenyizhe tai hhende echiwo.
Bijien da nie gaijiui peizhi hhere hhantu echighawo. Ene kunyi gouxioxi chonjiku jiere olon jiohuila man kuaizho.

Zinie ene pusho, jiohuila hhei sunghudene peizhi bijienre hhantu echighazhi bijiende jiuizhi ogisan baerni khughoghazho. Bijien ene gou shiqinyi giese Ezhanni famade oluzho, bijien gou zhughene mejieghazho.
Bijien ingiezhi giekushi ene olon baerni gonjikude kunlai ulie sugieghane giezho.
Bijien gou shiqin giese zinie Ezhanni melie gieku pusho, kunlai melieye ingiezho.
Bijien pse nie gaijiui peizhi hhelare hhantu echighawo. Bijien olon shiqin jiere hhei kaoyen olon giedene hhende rexin bikui mejiewo. Ede hhe tai hende xianxin giedene genjia rexinshizho.
Qidoi kieliese hheshi mii nokie wo, tande oluzhi mare lienshou gholuzho. Pse hhe ghua gaijiushi jiohuila peisan wo, Mexihani fama wo.
Ingiese ta jiohuilai melie oreku zhughene, pse bijien tai kuaisei hhelade zhenmin gie.
Shentulade banman gieku shiqinyi kieliese bi tande xin huaiku biyo uwo.
Tande gou zhughe bikui bi mejiene. Bi Maqidun kunlade Yagaiya kunla udai honse zhunbei giezho giezhi tai kuaizho. Tai rexin olon kunlai zhughei gojiolughazho.
Ede bi hhe giedun gaijiulai peizhi echighakushi zhao mii kielienzhe tai zhunbei gie goudaghane giezho. Pse bijien ene shiqin jiere tai kuaisan belienni gholune.
Babuchu Maqidun kunla mare hhantu echizhi ta ese zhunbei giesei chanlase ta shizhekui pse bu kielieye, bijien tai xianxin giesan shizhekui gholune.

Ingiese bi sumulase hhe giedun gaijiui xien peizhi tai hhende echighazhi ta dain giesan olon mureni zhunbei gie goudagha giezhi goude kielieku biyo wine. Ingiezhi giese ta khireighasanshi biisan pusho, duranzhe giesan wo.
Eneshijiu choghon tareisan choghon ghurane, olon tareisan olon ghurane giesan wo.
Jien kun zhughedene jiejin giesan mutun ogikuni wo. Chijia bu tei, ye bu bii. Duranzhe khireighasan kunlade Huda xiqi wo.
Huda yanyanji nenjienlai tande olon ogizhi yandeliuzhe chan kurughazhi yanyanji gou shiqinni tai olon gieghane.
Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun, "Hhe dafande nanxin kunlade ogizho, hhei gundan chanqi wine."
Tareisan kunde fure ogisan, kunde ijiuni ogisan Huda tareiku fureni tande ogizhi olodoghane, ta giesan gundan wiliede jiego olon khizheghane.
Tai gofanmiende bayazheghazhi suishisui dafande kunlade ogighane. Ingiezhi bijien giesan wiliei tungo giezhi Hudade mafan kielieghane.
Ene banman gieku shiqinyi giezhi zinie shentulade chaisei buisan pusho, olon kunlai Hudade mafan kielieku tebie olodoghazho.
Ta Mexihai gouxioxii chenren giezhi shunjizhi hhelade, pse olon kunlade dafande ogiku wiliei hhela kaoyen giedene Hudai kuaizho.
Huda tande tebieji fugie nenjien ogizho. Ingiese hhela tande oluzhi onxian giezhi tai sanazho.
Nenjienyini kieliezhi baragha daku Hudade mafan kielieye!
Bi Baolo qinsi Mexihani renyi, gou zhugheghala tande goude kielieye. Kunla kieliese bi tai chujieghekude goyane meilade uzhezho, tai hhende uwokude wizha wo giezho.
Bi xiahua gieye, bijien duyani banfaghala giezho giezhi sumulasanlade bi wizhade gienema, bi tai hhende echikude mii biizhi wizhade bu giegha.
Bijien duyade udu daozhoma, duyani banfaghala zhan ese eghinduzho.
Bijien eghinduku uqishi duyanughun pusho, Hudai nenlitu wo, khidun chenqianni unaghane.
Bijien kun zhenjindusan, pse kunni danlazhi Hudai ulie tanighazhi goyane fugiede uzhesan yanyanjilai man widaghane. Yanyanji sumuladanlai man barei iredene Mexihade shunjighane.
Ta onqienji shunjikude soyuji ese shunjisan kunlai faikui bijien zhunbei gie goudaghazho.
Ta shiqin uzhese zinie mienzii uzhene. Niezhan kun goyaneshi Mexihanughun wo giese hhe goude sumulakui wo, hheshi Mexihanughun mutun bijienshiye Mexihanughun wo.
Ezhan bijiende qienli ogikushi tai qida olugha ese giezho, hendagha giezho. Bijienyi qienlii bi goujinie gofende kuaise shizhene ulie giene.
Bi ingiezhi kieliekushi bi xin huaizhi tai ayighane giezhi tai ulie sumulaghane giezho.
Niezhan kun kieliese hhei xin yenge wo, khidun wo, kunni chujieghese zholien wo. Hhe jianjisan yama jiazhi uwo giezho.
Intu kunla indan mejiekui wo. Bijien tai hhende uwokude xin jiere matugie kieliezhoshi chujieghese matugie giene.
Bijien hhezighan goyane jieshao giesan kunghala ulie bilane. Hhela goyane goya nanjizho, goyane goya bilazho, hhela men no wo.
Bijienyi kieliese bijien kuaise kamasene ulie daone. Zhao Huda bijiende nanjizhi ogisan kamaghala giene. Ene kama tai hhendeye kuruzho.
Bijien tai hhende echise kamasene daoku pusho. Shijishan bijien Mexihani gouxioxii lien tai hhendeye echizhi chonjizho.
Bijien kamasene ese daozhi kunlai khishulasanghala ese kuaizho. Bijien xiwon giese tai xianxin gieku fugiedakude tai dundadu bijienyi kamaye daghazhi hende fugiedase giezho.
Ingiese kunlai oronde kunla giesan wiliede ulie kuaizhi gouxioxini tanse chugo psedu oronlade chonjine giezho.
Kien kuaise Ezhanyi kuai!
Kaoyen giedene olusan kunshi goyane jieshao giesan pusho, Ezhan jieshao giesan wo.
Bi goujinie ben kun danlayema, ta rennai gie. Bi xiwon giese ta rennai gie.
Hudai dubilieku zhugheghala bi tande hende orezho. Bi tai nie zhanguijide boluwo. Ganjin oqin wo giezhi Mexihade ogiwo.
Moghei jienzhaghala Hhawai piendasan mutun ta Mexihade olusan zhenzhenji oreku zhughe widakuse bi ayizho.

Niezhan kunla irezhi bijien ese chonjisan da nie Ersai tande chonjise, pse ta jienliezhi ese daosan buxiantu ruhherni jienliezhi ta jieshou giezhi ese daosan buxiantu gouxioxii jieshou gieghase ta jienliezho!
Bi sumulase bi hhezighan famatu shitu wo giesanlase goujida bixin uwo.
Mii koucai hen uwoma, unhua boghoni uwo. Enei bijien gofanmiende olon banfaghala tande zhenmin giewo.
Bi tai undudaghane giezhi goyane boghonidaghazhi Hudai gouxioxii tande belien chonjise zui fanjizhou?
Bi psedu jiohuilase gunzi bareidene tande lilian khighase qianlakughala niekielien wo.
Bi tai hhende bikude made chaikude kiemade chijia ese teizho. Maqidunse iresan gaijiula made chaisei ogizhi kughazho. Bi gofanmiende goyane tande achan ese gholuzho, jianlaiye ulie gholune.
Yagaiya oronde bi ingiezhi kuaikui kiemada danla dane. Mii sudoro bisan Mexihai zhendaoi zhiizhi bi ingiezhi kielie shidane.
Yangiezhi? Bi tande ulie orenu? Bi orekui Huda mejiene.
Bi ede giesanne izhi giene. Ingiekushi goya kuaisan bijienre niekielien wo giesan hhezighan jihui ereisan kunlade jihuini siraghane giezho.
Hhe izhun kunlashi jia shitu wo, piendachen wiliechi wo, Mexihani shitu wo giezhi jiazhon giezho.
Ene hunerei uwo. Ibilisiye gieghantu qienxienni jiazhon giezho.
Ingiese Ibilisini hojilaye gundanni hoji jiazhon gieseye ghudure uwo. Hhelai jiego hhela giesan mutun gholune.
Bi pse kielieye, kiemada mii ben kun mutun bu uzhe. Ben kun mutun uzheliuzhe bi goyane goujinie kuaikui ta jienlie.
Bi ingiezhi kieliese Ezhanni qienlighala ese giezho, nie ben kun wo giezhi fugiede tunguliezho.
Olon kunla duyani biozhunghala kuaise biye kuaiye.
Ta zhenzhenji jienzha wo, bayasuzhi ben kunlai jienliezho!
Kien tai hoji danlaghazhi qianlazhi pienyi zhanjizhi meilade uzhezhi khizha jieretai eghise ta rennai giezho.
Bi ingiezhi kieliese shizhenema, bijien zholienshi qingiezhi gie dane. Ingieliuzhe kun yan shiqin jiere kuai shidase biye kuai shidane. Enei bi ben kun mutun kieliezho.
Hhelashi Xibolai kun onu? Biye enbene. Isilie kun onu? Biye enbene. Iburaheimuni houdei onu? Biye enbene.
Mexihani hoji onu? Bi ingie kieliese fenjiulizhoma, biye genjia enbene. Bi hhelase olon khishulazhi bafanzi olon souzhi olon mabienzi neizhi haojihui aminde wixien khizhezho.
Bi Yutai kunlase 39 gie mabienzi eghikui 5 hui neizho.
Mii banbanghala 3 hui eghizho, 1 hui tashidazho, hai jiere 3 hui zeinan penjizhi chon qida oluzho, 1 hui hai jiere niudu nie xii hheliezho.
Olonfa mo yokude moronni wixien, qiandaoni wixien, goya kunlai wixien, niman kunlai wixien, chenshii wixien, hontanni wixien, haini wixien, jia gaijiulani wixienyi penjizho.
Khishulazhi shouku giezho, olonfa hhuntura dazho, oliesuzhi undasuzho, olonfa ijiuni chaizho, gonjiezho, musiku jien uwo.
Psedulase chugo go jiohuilade zhughe chilazhi niudunie mii jiere achan daruzho.
Kien zholierese bi ulie zholierenu? Kien zui fanjise bi ulie jindanu?
Ijinyo kuaine giese bi zholiennine kuaine.
Ezhan Ersani ada Huda bi ghudan ese kieliesei mejiene. Hhei chanqi doulakui wo.
Bi Damashigede bikude Yalida honshanni kha douradu fugie noyen Damashige chenshini sagheighazhi mii bareine giezhoma,
kunla mii nie lanlande teidene chenqian jieredu chongunse jiuzhilie bouzheghase hhei khase andawo.
Kuaise yama haochu uwoma, bi ijinyo kuaine. Ede bi Ezhan made zhoujin mutun uzheghazhi mejieghasei kielieye.
Bi Mexihai miende nie kunyi tanine. Hhei 14 nien qien ji 3 cen asiman jiere qila khireiwo. Beyere hhantu khireiwu beyese likai gie khireisei bi ulie mejiene, zinie Huda mejiene.
Bi intu kunyi tanine. Beyere hhantu khireiwu beyese likai gie khireisei bi ulie mejiene, zinie Huda mejiene.
Hhei qientande qila khireise kielie daku kielienyi sonosuwo. Enei kun kieliese ulie olukui wo.
Ene kunde oluzhi bi kuainema, goyadene oluzhi zholiennisene chugo yama ulie kuaine.
Bi kieliesanshi zhenni wo, ingiese bi kuaine gieliuzhe guazi pusho. Ingieliuzhe bi goyane ulie kuaine, pse kunla mase uzhezhi chenliesansene gofende mii uzhene.
Made uzheghasan tebie famashi bi goyane kondakuse ayizhi mii beye jiere nie eghesun teizho. Eneshi Ibilisi peisan wo, mii zayalazhi ese kondaghazho.
Ene shiqinde oluzhi bi Ezhande ene eghesunyi mii jierese widagha giezhi 3 hui xiahua giese
hhe made kieliewo, "Mii nenjien chade kuruzho. Mii nenli kunni zholienni jiere onqienshine." Ingiese bi goya zholiennine kuaikude hende xiqi bizhi Mexihani nenlii goya jierene huighane giezho.
Bi Mexihani yenyinde oluzhi zholien, shizheghaku, kunnan, heiku, chijia bikude bayasuzho. Bi yan shihoude zholienshi yan shihoude khidun wo.
Bi ene nie guazi kunshi ta biisan wo. Shijishan ta indan mii jieshao giekuni wo. Bi yama pushoma, hhezighan famatu shitu wo giesanlase goujida bixin uwo.
Bi tai dunda hende rennai giezhi ghudureqi, fugie shiqin, nenlitu shiqinni giezhi bishi shitu bikui zhenmin giewo.
Zinie bi tande achan ese danlasan ene shiqinse chugo bi tande psedu jiohuilase bixinde giezhou? Mii ene codasanyi ta rouliesha.

Ede bi zhunbei giezhi ji 3 hui tai hhende echine giezho. Tande yama achan ulie danlane, bi keresanshi tai dunxi pusho, tai zhughe wo. Kewosila ada anadene oluzhi baer cunjikui pusho, ada ana kesiladene oluzhi baer cunjikui wo.
Bi tande oluzhi bayasuzhi bisanlane ogizhi lien goyane man ogiku duran wine. Bi tande ye olon orese ta made ye choghon orenu?
Bi tande achan ese danlasei man mejiekui woma, niezhan kunla kieliese bishi nie jienzha kun wo, piendakughala tai bareizho giezho.
Bi tai hhende peizhi echighasan alinie kunyi tungo giezhi tai pienyi zhanjiwo?
Bi Qidoi tai hhende echighazhi hhere hhantu hhe nie gaijiui echighawo. Qido tai pienyi zhanjiwu? Bijien wilie giese nie zhugheghala ese giezhi nie korolonghala ese yozhou?
Ta sumulase bijien izhi tai melie goyane huizho giezhou? Bijien Mexihai miende Hudai melie kieliezho. Mii orentula, bijien giesanlashi man tai hendaghane giezho.

Bi echikude bi xiwon giesande ta ese daizhi ta xiwon giesande bi ese daisei mejiekuse ayizho. Zhenjinduku, dubilieku, piqi shuaiku, goyadene oluku, sugieku, xienhua kielieku, goyane undude uzheku, londaku shiqin winekuse ayizho.
Bi pse echikude bi zunjisan Huda tai melie mii shizheghakuse ayizho. Eqighandei olon kunla zui fanjizhi zannanni giezhi lon kijiezhi hu giedene ulie geisande bi nango giekuse ayizho.
Eneshi bi ji 3 hui tai hhende echine giezho. Ingiese "jien zhasan shiqinlai ghua, ghuran kunni ganzhenghala shidaghane".
Bi ji 2 hui tai hhende irekude hhezighan melieshida zui fanjisan kunji psedu soyuji kunlade jingao giezhi daosan mutun ede bi tai hhende uwokude pse jingao gieye, bi pse irese jiedui ulie rouliene.
Ingiekushi Mexiha mii tungo giezhi kieliesan zhenjini ta ereizho. Mexiha tande zholiende ulie giene, khidunde giene.
Hhei zholiennii yenyinzhe shizijia jiere ghada fugughawoma, Hudai nenlighala amitu wo. Bijien hhere hhantu zholien woma, tai hhende echikude Hudai nenlighala hhere hhantu amiturane.
Ta xinyan dunda udu daozhoye giezhi goyane jiencha gie. Goyane nie kaoyen gie. Ersa Mexiha tai sudoro bikui ta ulie mejienu? Enei mejie dase ta kaoyen giezhi dao dazho.
Bi xiwon giese bijien kaoyen giezhi daokui ta mejiene.
Bijien Hudase onxian giezhi tai yama codasei ulie gieghane. Bijien kaoyen giezhi daokui uzheghaku pusho. Kunla uzhese bijien shibai gieliuzhe tai gounii gieghane giezho.
Bijien yan shiqindeliuzhe zhendaoni duizhi gie dane, hhende oluzhi giene.
Bijien zholien bizhi ta khidun bikude bijien bayasuzho. Ta onqientu gholu giezhi bijien ingiezhi onxian giezho.
Ingiese bi tai hhende wikude ene kielienyi tande huaikushi bi tai chanlakudei zhao Ezhan made ogisan qienlighala tande gundude ulie giene giezho. Ene qienli kunni bixindaghaku pusho, hendaghaku wo.
Gaijiula, zuihoude kielieye, ta bayasundu. Onqientu kun gholuzhi bijien surughasei chenlie. Maodun bu khizhezhi heqishi. Ingiese oreku winetu, pinnantu Huda chan tanre hhantu wo.
Ta zhughesene nieniedene kielien asa.
Shentula man tande kielien asazho.
Ezhan Ersa Mexihani nenjien, Hudai oreku, Shenlinni laiwon gieku chan tanre hhantu bi gie!
Jialatai
Shitu danlasan bi Baolo xin huaizho. Bi shitu danlakushi kun peisan pusho, kunni tungo giesanye pusho, Ersa Mexiha pse hhei fugusan kun dundase aminne olughasan Ada Hudai tungo giezhi peisan wo.
Bi mare hhantulasan gaijiularene man Jialataini jiohuilade kielien asaye.
Mai Ada Huda, Ezhan Ersa Mexiha tande nenjien, pinnan ogi gie!
Huda mai Adai isighala Mexiha ene doghun duyase mai andaghane giezhi mai zuide oluzhi goyane sheiwo.
Kuaikui chanqi izhi Hudade ogi. Amine!
Mexihani nenjienyi tungo giezhi tai urusan Hudase ta deigo likai giedene psedu gouxioxini daghase bi ghanirazho.
Shijishan psedu gouxioxi uwo, niezhan kunla tai londaghazhi Mexihani gouxioxii geine giezho.
Bugon bijien, asiman jierese iresan qienxienliuzhe bijien tande chonjisan gouxioxii buxiantui chonjise hhei indan kharakui wo.
Bijien melieshida kieliezhi daozho, ede bi pse kielieye. Kienliuzhe ta jienliesan gouxioxii buxiantui tande chonjise hhei indan kharakui wo.
Ede bi kunlai kuaighanu, Hudai kuaighane? Bi kunlai bayasughane giezhou? Bi dou kunlai bayasughane giese bishi Mexihani hoji pusho.
Gaijiula, bi chonjisan gouxioxishi kunse iresan pusho bikui ta mejie.
Hheshi bi kunlase jienliesan pusho, kunla sughasanye pusho, Ersa Mexiha mejieghasan wo.
Bi melieshida Yutaijiode matugie udu daosanyi ta chenliezhi daozho. Bi Hudai jiohuini hende heizhi widaghane giezho.
Yutaijio fanmiende bi goya minzune nie nasuntu kunlase zui fama wo, mii xienrenla zunjisan xigonde zui rexin wo.
Ingiezhoma, Huda nenjienghalane mii oluku melie sunghuzhi urudene
niman kunlade Ersai chonjighane giezhi kewonne made bayasuzhi uzheghazho. Ingiekude bi kunlare shanlian ese gie,
mase melie shitu danlasan kunlade asane giezhi Yelusalende ese khirei, deigo Alabode echidene pse Damashigede khareiwo.
Ingie 3 nien daodene bi Yelusalende khirei, Jifai tani, hhere hhantu 15 qien souwo.
Zinie Ezhanyi jiuni Yagebuse chugo psedu shitulai nieda ese chanlawo.
Bi tande huaisanshi man shuhua wo. Bi Hudai melie ghudan ulie kieliene.
Khuinashi bi Xiliya, Jilijia oronde echiwo.
Hhe xienzide Mexihai xianxin giesan Yudayani jiohuila mii chanlazhi ese daozho.
Hhela zinie melieshida mai heisan kun ede hhe melieshida widaghane giesan xinyanni chonjizho giesei chenliedene
mii yenyin jiere Hudai kuaizho.
14 nien daodene bi Banabaghala Qidoi uduru pse Yelusalende khireiwo.
Bi khireikushi Huda made mejieghazho. Bi hhezighan lindaolai konkonji chujieghedene bi niman kunlade gouxioxi chonjisei kieliezhi minbai olughakushi bi melieshida, ede belien ese holuse giezho.
Mare hhantu echisan Qidoshi Xila kun woma, hhei biizhi hetoune ese gieghazho.
Enei kieliekushi niezhan jia gaijiula ghulazhi orozhedene konkonji Mexiha Ersai miendedu bijienyi ziyui uzhedene bijienyi hoji danlaghane giezho.
Bijien gouxioxini zhendaoi tai dunda beighane giezhi hhelade goujida ese ranjiwo.
Hhezighan lindao danlasanla bi chonjisan daolide yama ese jiaizho. Hhela eqighandei yan kun bikui made yama zoin uwo, Huda mienzighala ulie uzhene.
Khareidene Huda Bedurude hetoune giesan kunlade gouxioxini chonjiku renwuni ogiku mutun madeye hetoune ese giesan kunlade chonjiku renwui ogisei hhela uzhe khizhewo.
Bedurui sudoro wilie giezhi hhei hetoune giesan kunlade shitu danlaghasan hhe mii sudoroye wilie giezhi mii niman kunlade shitu danlaghawo.

Jiohuini tuhuade sanasan Yagebu, Jifa, Yaheiya enela Huda made ogisan nenjienyi chenren giedene bi Banabaghalade borun khane ogizhi lienshou gholu, bijien niman kunlai dunda echi, hhela hetoune giesan kunlai dunda echikui tunyi oluwo.
Hhela zinie bijienyi yoqiu giezhi nanxin kunlai jilazhi banman gie giezho. Ene shiqinyi yenlai bi xiacha giezhi giezho.
Khuinashi JifaAnqiyade irekude ulie giekui giese bi danmien hhei fandui giewo.
Yagebui hhense irechen kunla ese kuzhekude Jifa niman kunlare hhantu ijiezho. Hhela irese ijinyo hetoune gie giesan Yutaini Mexihai xianxin giesan kunlase ayidene tui gholodowo.
Psedu Yutai kunla hhei daghazhi jiazhon giezho, lien Banabaye shandan giedene hhelai daghazhi jiazhon giezho.

Bi chanlase hhelai giesan gouxioxini zhendaoghala buxianshi dajialai melie Jifade kieliewo, "Chishi nie Yutai kun bidene Yutai kunnughunyi ulie daghadene niman kunnughunyi daghase matugie niman kunlai biizhi Yutai kunnughunyi daghaghane?"
Matanshi nangha pusho, olusanse Yutai kun enbene.

Kunyi gounide sanakushi guijinni zunjikughala pusho, Ersa Mexihani xianxin giekughala bikui matan mejiene. Matanye Mexiha Ersai xianxin giekushi guijinni zunjikughala pusho, Mexihai xianxin giekughala gounide sanaghaku wo. Kiemada guijinni zunjizhi gounide sanasei uwo.
Matan Mexihai tungo giezhi gounide sanaghane giedene goyaneye zuiren gholuse Mexihashi mai zui fanjighachen onu? Kenjin pusho!
Bi cheisanne pse erchan giese goyaneshi zuiren bikui zhenmin giewo.
Bi guijinni tungo giezhi guijinse fugudene Hudade amiturawo.

Bi Mexihaghalai hhantu shizijia jiere ijin ghadawo. Ede amiturasanshi bi pusho, Mexiha mii sudoro amiturazho. Bi beye jiere amiturasanshi made orezhi made oluzhi goyane sheisan Hudai kewonni xianxin giesanghala amiturazho.
Bi Hudai nenjienyi ulie widaghane. Guijinni tungo giezhi gundanni irezhoshi Mexiha belien duya ijiewo.
Jialataini guazi kunlaya! Kien tai miiwo? Ersa Mexihani shizijia jiere ghadazhi qinchude tai melie beilawo.
Bi tande jianie shiqin asaye, ta Shenlinni jienliesanshi guijinni zunjikughala onu gouxioxini sonosudene xianxin giekughala wo?
Ta Shenlinghala kaishi giedene beyeghala jieshu olughanu? Tashi intu guazi onu?
Ta imeghei shouku giesanshi belienni onu? Bebelieghanji onu?
Huda tande Shenlinni ogizhi tai dunda nenlitu shiqin giesanshi ta guijinni zunjikughala onu gouxioxini sonosudene xianxin giekughala wo?
Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun, "Iburaheimu Hudai xianxin giedene Huda hhei gounide sanazho."
Ingiese xianxin giesanlashi Iburaheimui houdei bikui ta mejie.
Niman kunlai xianxin giekughala Huda gounide sanakui jinwun jiere melie kieliezho. Ingie eqighanse Iburaheimude gouxioxini chonjizhi kieliezho, "Chii tungo giezhi soyuji minzulade fuqi irene."
Ingiese xianxin giesan kunla xianxin giesan Iburaheimure hhantu fuqi jienliene.
Guijinni zunjikude kouisan kunla man kharaku doura wo. Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun, "Guijinshu jiere jilasanlai man ulie zunjizhi ulie giesanlai man kharane."
Guijinni kouizhi kiemai Hudai melie gounide sana daku qinchu wo. Jinwun jiere kieliezho, "Gou kun xianxin giekughala amiturane."
Guijin xianxin giekughala buxian wo. Jinwun jiere kieliesan mutun, "Guijinni zunjisan kunla guijinni kouizhi amiturane."
Jien mutun jiere gualasanlai kharane giezhi jinwun jiere jilasan mutun Mexiha matande oluzhi kharakui shouizhi guijinni kharakuse matai shuiwo.
Ingiedene Iburaheimude ogisan fuqi Mexiha Ersai tungo giezhi niman kunlade kuruwo, matan xianxin giekui tungo giezhi dain giesan Shenlinni jienliewo.
Gaijiula, bi nie pinchanku bifanyi kielieye. Kun kielien yenjise kiema widagha daji jiai dane.
Huda Iburaheimu, hhei houdeide dain giekude olon kunyi zhiizhi chii houdeila giezhi ese kieliedene niekozii zhiizhi chii houdei giezho. Hheshi Mexiha wo.
Mii isishi ingiezho. 430 nien daodene iresan guijin melieshida Huda yenjisei widagha dazhi dain giesei widagha dane.
Hudai jiachan guijinse irezhoshi dain giesanse ese irezho, ingieliuzhe Huda Iburaheimude dain giesei tungo giezhi ogizho.
Qinse guijinshi yan wo? Guijinshi Iburaheimude dain giesan houdei iretula zuini mejieghane giezhi jiaisan wo. Guijinshi qienxienlai tungo giezhi dundadu kunyi khai jingo giezhi jinjisan wo.
Dundadu kunshi shonfanmienyi daibio giezhoma, Hudashi nie wo.
Ingiese guijin Hudai dain giesanghala zodui giezhou? Kenjin uye! Amin ireghaku guijinni ogizhoshi kunla hhei tungo giezhi gounide sanawo.
Ingiezhoma, soyuji kunlai zuide qienji jiezho giezhi jinwun jiere kieliezho. Ingiedene Ersa Mexihai xianxin giezhi iresan dainni xianxin giesan kunlade ogizho.
Xianxin gieku iretula matai guijin doura khazhi xianxin gieku xienjizhi khizhetula uzhezho.
Ingiese guijinshi Mexiha iretula mai uduruku loushi wo. Ingiedene xianxin giekughala mai gounide sanaghazho.
Ede xianxin gieku irese matan hhe uduruku loushii doura uwo.
Ta man Mexiha Ersai xianxin giekughala Hudai kewosi gholuwo.
Xilii jienliezhi Mexihare hhantulasan ta man jierene Mexihai musizho.
Ta Mexiha Ersai miende man nie wo. Yutai kun, niman kun, ziyutu kun, hoji, ere kun, eme kunla yama chabie uwo.
Tashi Mexihanughunshi Iburaheimui houdei wo, dain giesanzhe caichanni jienliechen wo.
Bi kieliese jiachanshi man jienliechennughun woma, hhe kewosi xienzide hojilare yama chabie uwo.
Adani jinjisan shihou kuzhetula hhe izhi qiezhechen kun, gonjisan kunyi doura wo.
Matanye niekielien wo. Matan kewosi bikude ene duyani langan daoli matai gonjizhoma,
shihou onqienji kuzhese Huda kewonne peizhi eme kunyi tungo giezhi guijin doura ireghadene
guijin douradu kunlai shuizhi khizhe matande kewosi danlaku qienlii ogiwo.
Tashi kewosi wo, Huda Kewonne ruhherni peizhi mai zhughede teise matan Hudai Aba! Ada giezhi urune.
Ingiese chishi pse hoji pusho, kewon wo. Kewon enbese Huda renjisan jiachanyi jienliechen enbene.
Eqighandei ta Hudai tani dakude hhezighan yenlai Huda pushotulade hoji danlazhoma,
ede ta Hudai tanine, pse tashi Huda tanisan wo. Ta matugie pse hhezighan yama zoin witu bixin langan daolide hoji danlane giezhi daghazho?
Ta udu, sara, jieqi, nienjienni chigharade zunjizho.
Ingiese bi tande zhughe chilazhi khishulasan belien gholukuse ayizho.
Gaijiula, bi tai xiahua gieye, bi ta mutun gholusan mutun taye bi mutun gholu. Ta mii ese kuighazho.
Ta mejiene, bi giemerekuzhe caigie tande tou 1 hui gouxioxi chonjiwo.
Beyemi tande achan ogiwoma, ingieliuzhe ta mii gajide ese uzhezhi ese duisadene kharei Hudai qienxien mutun, Mexiha Ersa mutun jienliewo.
Hhe xienzide ta hende bayasusan ede khala echiwo? Hhe xienzide ta nudunne waidene made ogiku duran bikui bi tande ganzhen bei shidane.
Ede bi tande zhendaoi kieliese tai duitou gholuwu?
Hhezighan kunla tande rexinde giezhoma, zhughedeni gou muji uwo. Tai mase gholodoghazhi goyadene rexinde gieghane giezho.
Gou mujighala tande rexinde giese gou wo. Enei zinie bi tai hhende bikude gieku pusho, chanqi giese olune.
Mii kesilaya, Mexihai yanzi tai sudoro gholutula bi tande oluzhi pse kewosi oluku kui shouizho.
Bi ede tanre hhantulane giezhi kouqine bienjighadene goude kieliekui hende duralakushi tande oluzhi zhughedemi nanran uwo.
Ta enezighan guijinni shunjine giesan kunla, made nie kielie, guijinde matui kieliesei ta ulie mejienu?
Jinwun jiere huaizho, Iburaheimude ghua kewon wo. Nieshi hoji bierei olusan wo. Nieshi ziyu bierei olusan wo.
Hoji bierei olusanshi beyei kouizhi oluzho, ziyu bierei olusanshi dain giesei kouizhi oluzho.
Eneshi bifan wo. Ghua biereishi ghua yenjisan kielien wo. Nie biereishi Hhazhire wo, Xinaishanse irezhi olusan kesilashi hoji wo.
HhazhireAlaboni Xinaishanni daibio giezho, edeku Yelusalenghala niekielien wo. Hhe kesilarene manshi hoji wo.
Da nie biereishi asiman jieredu Yelusalenni daibio giezho. Hhe ziyu wo, matai ana wo.

Jinwun jiere huaizho, "Kewosi olu dachen, kewosi witu bierei, chi bayasu! Kewosi olusan tendunni ese shouisan bierei, chi bayasuzhi jiuli! Zhanguiji witu biereini kesila zhanguiji bisan biereini kesilase olon wo!"
Gaijiula, tashi Isaghei mutun Huda dain giedene iresan kewosi wo.
Hhe shihoude beyese olusan Shenlinse olusei heizho. Edeye niekielien wo.
Ingiezhoma jinwun jiere matugie kieliezho? Hoji biereiji hhei kewonni tou khireigha. Hoji biereini kewon ziyu biereini kewonghala hhantu jiachanni jienliese ulie olune giezho.
Gaijiula, ingiese matanshi hoji biereini kewosi pusho, ziyu biereini kewosi wo.
Mexiha matanyi ziyude oluzhi matanyi andaghawo. Ingiese ta beizhi undanla. Hojini jiaban tai pse kunzhi bu gie gie.
Ta chenliendu, bi Baolo tande goude kielieye. Ta hetoude kouise Mexiha tande yama haochu uwo.
Bi pse jien hetoune giesan kunlade jingao gieye. Tande guijinni man zunjiku zheren wine.
Ta enezighan guijinni kouizhi gounide sanane giesanla, Mexihaghala gonxi widazhi nenjiense likai giewo.
Bijien Shenlinde kouizhi xianxin giekughala gounide sanakui panjizhi sagheizho.
Mexiha Ersai miende hetoune gie, ulie gie yama zhunyo uwo. Zhunyonishi orekughala khizhesan xianxin gieku wo.
Ta izhi giesan gou woma, ede ta zhendaoni shunjikui kien duiwo?
Ingiezhi surughasanshi tai urusan hhe pusho.
Goujinie kunieghe nie duizi ghurunyi faighane.
Ta pseshikui ulie sumulakui bi Ezhanyi miende hende xianxin giezhoma, kien tai daolon giese hhei faine.
Gaijiula, bi izhigie hetoune giekui chonjizhoshi mii yangiezhi dou heine? Qingiezhoshi shizijia kunni hokurughaku widawo.
Bi xiwon giese tai daolon giesanla goyane atala gie!
Gaijiula, tai ziyude uruzhoma, ene ziyuni nefuxin gieku jihui bu gholughadene nieniene oreku zhugheghala ushila.
Soyuji guijin man goyadene mutun giebeidene ore giesan ene nie aman kieliende bouizho.
Ta xioxin giezhi nieniene bu zhouzhi bu yenji, pse man widane.
Bi kielieye, ta Shenlinni daghazhi gie, ingiese beyeni nefuxinni ulie giene.
Beyeni nefuxin Shenlinghala zodui giezho, Shenlinye beyeghala zodui giezho. Ene ghuala nieniene zodui giezhi ta duralasan shiqinni ulie gieghane.
Tai Shenlin uduruse guijin doura uwo.
Beye giekulai minminji mejiene, lon kijieku, zannanni, hu gieku,
nigiedai beiiku, fashu shuaiku, chou bareiku, zhenjinduku, henjiku, piqi shuaiku, zinie goyane guiku, danlinraku, danpai gholughaku,
dubilieku, jiu ochi sudoku, nouiku, pse intu shiqinla wo. Bi eqighanse tande jingao giesan mutun ede pse tande jingao gieye. Enezighan shiqinlani giesan kunla Hudai gojiai jienlie dane.
Shenlinni jiegoshi, oreku, bayasuku, pinnan, rennai, goude gieku, gou zhughe, kekaoni,
renyi, goyane kunzhi gieku wo. Intu shiqinlai guijin gonji dane.
Mexiha Ersani kunla beyeji nefuxin gieku duranne hhantu shizijia jiere ghadawo.
Matan Shenlinni kouizhi udu daose Shenlinni kouizhi giekuni wo.
Matan goyane undude bu uzhezhi nieniene bu hokughazhi nieniene bu dubilieye.
Gaijiula, nie kun zui fanjise ta Shenlini kouisan kunla renyitu zhugheghala hhei khareizhi daozhegha. Pse goyane miikui xioxin gie.
Ta nieniene achanyi banjizhi danjindu. Ingiezhi giese Mexihani guijinni chengun olughane.
Kun yama pushodene goyane hen wo giese goyane piendazho.
Jien kun goya giesan wilielane jiencha gie, ingiese bayasuku zinie goyade wo, kunlade uwo.
Jien kun goya zherenne goya danji.
Hudai kielienyi surusan kun surughasan kunde goude dunxilai man ogikuni wo.
Goyane bu pienda, Hudai meilade bu uzhe. Kun tareisanshi yan woshi ghurasanshi yan wo.
Zuitu beyene shunjizhi tareise zuitu beyese qida olukui ghurane, Shenlinni shunjizhi tareise Shenlinse chanqiku amin ghurane.
Matan gouni giekude fanqi bu giezhi zhazhen giema, heshitu shihou kuzhese ghurakui wine.
Ingiese matande jihui bikude dajialade gouni giekui wo, xianxin giesan nie gie kunlade genjia ingiezhi giekui wo.
Uzhe, bi qinsi tande huaisan uru matu fugie wo.
Hhezighan mienzii kuaichen kunla tai biizhi hetoune gieghakushi zinie Mexihani shizijiai yenyin jiere heikuse ayizho.
Hhezighan hetoune giesan kunla goyalane guijinni ulie zunjidene tai hetoune gieghakushi tai beyei tungo giezhi goyane kuaine giezho.
Bi zinie matai Ezhan Ersa Mexihani shizijiase chugo psedulai ulie kuaisejiu. Shizijiai tungo giezhi bi fugusan mutun duyare gonxi widazho. Duyaye fugusan mutun mare gonxi widazho.
Hetoune gie, ulie gie yama zhunyo uwo. Zhunyonishi shini kun wo.
Jien ene daoli mutun giesan kunlade, Hudai Isilie bexinlade Huda pinnan, ubali xiikui ogi gie!
Enedu khuinase kiemada mii jiohoro bu gie, mii jiere Ersani hou wine.
Gaijiula, mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihani nenjien tai zhughede bisejiu. Amine!
Ifuso
Hudai isighala Mexiha Ersade shitu danlasan BaoloIfusoni Mexiha Ersai shixinji daghasan shentulade xin huaizho.
Mai ada Huda, Ezhan Ersa Mexiha tande nenjien pinnan ogi gie!
Mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihani ada Hudai kuaindu. Hhe Mexihai miende matande asiman jiereshiku yanyanji ruhhertu gounii ogizho.
Duyai zhayaghaku melie orekughala Mexihai miende matai sunghuzhi goyane melie zhiguishighazhi jienjien witui gholughane giezho.
Goya isighalane bayasuzhi Ersa Mexihai tungo giezhi matai goyane kewosi danlaghakui eqie jinjiwo.
Oresan kewonne nenjienghalane matande belien ogiwo. Ingiese Hudai famatu nenjienni matai kuaighane giezho.
Mexihai miende fugie nenjienghalane Kewonne chusunyi jiageghala matai shuizhi codasanni mienliewo.
Ene nenjienyi soyuji agheli cunminghala hhantu matande pojiezhi olon ogiwo.
Matande jihuane mimii mejieghawo. Eneshi Hudai gou duran wo. Mexihai miende chenjighane giesan wo.
Ene jihuashi shihou kurukude asiman, zemin jieredu yanyanjilai man Mexihai miende hhantulaghane.
Pse matan Mexihai miende nexianyi jienliewo. Eneshi duranghalane yanniliuzhe giesan Huda goya jihuaghalane eqie jinjisan wo.
Ingiekushi bijien zui melieshida xiwonni Mexihai jiere teisan Yutai kunlai Hudai famani kuaighane giezho.
Taye zhenzhenji daoli, jiushi tai jiuiku gouxioxii chenliedene Mexihani xianxin giese Huda dain giesan Shenlinni tande ogizhi zhanzi taiwo.
Ene Shenlinshi matan jiachanni jienlieku yajin wo, matai shuizhi Hudai bexin gholughane, hhei famani kuaighane.
Ingiese ta Ezhan Ersai xianxin giezhi soyuji shentulade oresei bi chenliedene
onxian giekude tai jilazhi ese beidene tande oluzhi Hudade mafan kieliezho.
Bi tande mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihai Huda, famatu Ada aghelitu ruhher pse mejieghaku ruhherni tande ogizhi ta hhei tani,
tai zhugheni nudunlai gieghereghazhi hhe tai uruzhi iresan xiwonshi yan bikui, pse shentulai dundadu hhei famatu jiachan matu olon bikui ta mejie,
pse Huda fugie lilianghalane matan xianxin giesan kunlade xienjighasan hhei nenli matu fugie bikui mejie giezhi onxian giezho. Ene nenlishi
Mexihai jiere giesan tebieji fugie lilian wo. Hhei fugusan kun dundase aminne olughazhi asiman jiere goya borun miendene soughazhi
yanyanji gonjisan, qienli bareisan, nenlitu, lindao danlasan, zinie edeku pusho, houshidedu yan nierelase da famashighawo.
Pse soyujilai Mexihai kon doura teizhi hhei jiohuini qiorun danlaghadene soyujilai gonjighazho.
Jiohuishi hhei beye wo. Soyujilai dunda soyujilai hulunshighasan Mexiha jiohuini hulunshighazho.
Eqighandei ta codasan dunda zui dundane fuguzho.
Hhe shihoude ta ene duyai xigonyi daghazhi asimanyi doghun lilianyi gonjisan hhei daghazhi zui dunda udu daozho. Hhe jiushi kielienyi ulie chenliechen kunlai sudoro wilie giesan ruhher wo.
Eqighandei matan man hhela mutun mai beyei nefuxinyi daghazhi udu daozho. Zui gieku duran, sumuladanni daghazhi giezho. Matan kunlare niekielien wo, olu bouzheghase Huda faichen kun wo.
Ingieliuzhe Hudade olon ubali xiiku wine, hhe matande oresan fugie orekughala
matan codasan dunda fugukudeni matanyi Mexihare hhantu aminne olughawo. Tai jiuikushi nenjienghala wo.
Mexiha Ersai miende matanyi Mexihare hhantu aminne olughadene asiman jiere hhere hhantu soughawo.
Ingiezhi giekushi Mexiha Ersai miende matande renyide ogisan hhei nenjien zhenzhen olon bikui jianlaiku kunlade man uzheghane giezho.
Tai jiuikushi nenjienghala wo, xianxin giedene jiuiwo. Eneshi goyase iresan pusho, Huda ogisan mure wo.
Giekughala pusho, pse goyane kuaine.
Matanshi Huda giesan wo, gou wilie gieghane giezhi Mexiha Ersai miende zhayaghasan wo. Eneshi Huda matande matugie udu dao giezhi eqighan jihua gie goudaghasan wo.
Ingiese ta jila, beyeghala kieliese eqighandei tashi niman kun wo. Hhezighan beye jiere kunni khaghala hetoune giesan kunla tai hetoune ese giesan kun giezhi uruzho.
Hhe shihoude tande Mexiha uwo, Isilie kun ese danlaghazho, Huda yenjisan kielienghala gonxi uwo, duyade yama xiwon uwo, Hudaye uwo.
Eqighandei Hudase gholodosan ta ede Mexiha Ersai miende hhei chusunde kouizhi Hudare chadashiwo.
Mexihashi matanyi heqishighachen wo. Hhe beyene fugughazhi Yutai kun niman kunyi dundadu danni unaghazhi chouni widaghawo.
Yutai kunni guijinni minlin, kuichenlai widaghadene goyane sudoro Yutai kun, niman kun ghualai nie shini kun gholughazhi heqishighawo.
Shizijiai tungo giezhi chouni widaghazhi ghualai nie beye gholughadene Hudare goudaghawo.
Da iredene heqishighaku gouxioxii ta gholodedu niman kunlade chonjizhi ogiwo, chadadedu Yutai kunladeye chonjizhi ogiwo.
Ingiedene Mexihai tungo giezhi matan man nie Shenlinghala Hudai shida echi shidane.
Ingiese ede tashi niman kun, wigo kun pusho, shentulare nie gojia kun gholuzhi mechini kun wo.
Tashi shitu, xienzhilani jichu jiere beighasan gie wo, Mexiha goyaneshi gieni jichu tashi wo.
Mexihai kouizhi nie gie man lienjidene fugiedazhi Ezhanni zhiguitu dajien gholuzho.
Mexihai kouizhi taiye hhantu beighazho. Ene gieshi Huda Shenlinyi tungo giezhi souku oron wo.
Ingiese Mexiha Ersai yenyinghala ta niman kunlade oluzhi bafanzi sousan bi Baolo tande oluzhi onxian giezho.
Huda tande oluzhi nenjienghalane made nie tebieji renwu ogisei ta kenjin chenliezhi daozho.
Huda mimii made qinsi mejieghawo. Enei bi eqighandei jiendanghan huaizhi daozho.
Ta onshise bi Mexihani mimii dunjiresanyi mejiene.
Ene mimii isii Huda ede Shenlinyi tungo giezhi zhiguitu shitu, xienzhiladene mejieghasan mutun eqighanku xienzidedu kunde ese mejieghazho.
Ene mimishi niman kunla gouxioxii tungo giezhi Mexiha Ersai miende hhantu caichanyi jienliechen danlazhi nie beyeni iyanzi gholuzhi hhantu Huda dain giesanyi jienliene.
Hudai nenjienghala bi gouxioxide hoji danlazho. Huda nenlighalane made ene nenlini ogizho.
Shentulai dundadu zui ganise da gajitu made Huda nenjien ogizhi Mexihani mejiezhi baragha daku olonnii niman kunlade chonji giezho.
Pse soyujilai zhayaghasan Hudai sudoro eqighanse izhi niuighasan mimitu jihuai olon kunlade man minbai olugha giezho.
Ingiekushi ede jiohuii tungo giezhi asiman jiere gonjisan, qienli bareisanlade Hudai yanyanji aghelilai mejieghane giezho.
