Eneshi mai Ezhan Mexiha Ersai tungo giezhi gholusan Hudai chanqiku jihua wo.
Matan Mexiha Ersai sudoro hhei xianxin giezhi danzine fugiedaghazhi ulie inxin giedene Hudai melie echine.
Ingiese bi tai xiahua gieye, bi tande oluzhi shouku giewo giezhi yuchou bu gie. Eneshi tai kuaikui wo.
Ingiese bi Adai melie xiutuliezhi onxian giezho.
Hheshi asiman, zemin jieredu soyuji jiawulade man niere ogisan wo.
Hhe zhao goya olon fama, Shenlinne tungo giezhi tai sudorodu xianxin gieku zhugheni lilianghala khiduzhegha gie.
Xianxin giekughala Mexiha tai zhughede souzhi tai oreku dunda genzi bareighazhi undanlagha gie.
Ingie tande nenli bizhi soyuji shentulare Mexihani oreku matu aghui, fudu, undu, gun bikui goude mejieghadene
hhei oreku kunni sumulakuse daosanyi tande mejieghazhi Hudai hulunshighakughala tai hulunshigha gie.
Nenlini matanyi dunda ochirazhi matan xiahua giezhi sumulasanse pse olon chenjighasan Hudade
jiohui, Mexiha Ersai tungo giezhi zuzubeibei chanqi izhi kuaikui ogi. Amine!
Ingiese Ezhande oluzhi bafanzi sousan bi tai sidaghaye, ta yan giese zhao Huda tai urusan mutun gie.
Yandeliuzhe goyane meilade uzhezhi renyide gie. Rennai giezhi oreku zhugheghala nieniedene ranji.
Heqighala nieniene lienjizhi Shenlin tonjie gieghasanni xiacha giezhi barei.
Tai urukude nie xiwonde urusan mutun nie beye, nie Shenlin,
nie Ezhan, nie xianxin gieku, nie xili gieku,
nie Huda wo. Hheshi soyujilai ada wo, soyujilai jiere soyujilai dunda soyujilai sudoro wo.
Matan jien kunde Mexiha ghughazhi ogisan nenli wine.
Ingiese jinwun jiere kieliezho, "Hhe undude khireikude olon duitoulane barei khireiwo, kunlade nenlilai ogiwo."
Hhe khireiwo giezhi ene kielienshi yan isi wo? Hhe xien doura, jiushi zemin jiere bouzhesan pushonu?
Bouzhesan hheshi zui undu asimande khireisan Hhe wo. Ingiezhi giekushi soyujilai hulunshighane giezho.
Kun dunda niezhanlade shitu, xienzhi, gouxioxi chonjichen, mushi, loushi danlaku nenlini ogisanshi Mexiha wo.
Ingiezhi giekushi Mexihani wiliede oluzhi shentulai goude zhunbei gieghadene Mexihani beyeni hendaghane giezho.
Izhi ingiezhi giezhi matan dajiala Hudai kewonyi xianxin giezhi taniku jiere nie gholudene fugiedazhi Mexihani hulunnide daine.
Ingiese matan pse kewosi ulie danlazhi kunlai doghun muji, piendaku guijijighala yanyanji xiejioni inxianyi shouizhi eneman, hheman ulie gojioludene
oreku zhugheghala shuhua kieliezhi go fanmiende touzi danlasan Mexiha mutun hendane.
Mexihai kouizhi nie beyei sidasunla man chigharade lienjizho. Go iyanzi zoinlane khizheghazhi nie beyeni oreku dunda fugiedazhi hendaghazho.
Ingiese bi enei Ezhanni miende tande khidunde kielieye. Pse niman kunla mutun qingiezhi udu bu dao. Hhelai sumuladan yama oronde uwo,
zhugheni kharalazho. Hhela yama ulie mejiezhi zhughene khiduzheghase Huda ogisan aminse danlinrazho.
Hhela shizhekui mejie dazhi hu giedene nefuxinghala yanyanji zannanni giene.
Ta Mexihase surusanshi intui pusho.
Zhendao Ersai sudoro wo. Ta Ersa Mexihani chenliezhi hhense suruse
khuichen kunni teizhi eqighanku xigonlai widagha. Eneshi nefuxin miidene qida olusan wo.
Ta zhughe, sumulakune shinishighazhi
Hudai yanzi mutun zhenzhenji gundan, ganjinde zhayaghasan shini kunni musi.
Ingiese ta pse ghudan bu kielie. Jien kun kunlade shuhua kielie. Matanshi nie beye jieredu iyanzi wo.
Hokuse zui bu fanji, hokuzhi naran bu puda.
Pse Ibiliside jihui ogine.
Ghulachenla pse bu ghula. Goyade iresei nanxin kunlade ghughazhi ogine giezhi qinsi zhendande wilie gie.
Zannan kielienni nie amanda bu khizheghazhi heshide kunlade banjiku kielien kielie. Ingiese chenliesan kunde haochu wine.
Hudai Shenlinni yuchou bu giegha. Hhe shuiku udude oluzhi tai jiere hhei zhanzii taizho.
Yanyanji henjiku, piqi shuaiku, hokuku, nouiku, kufurei fanjiku, pse mouxiennilai man tai dundase widagha.
Huda Mexihai miende tai rouliesan mutun taye renyitu zhugheghala ubali xiizhi nieniene roulie.
Ingiese ta Hudai daghazhi suru, tashi Huda oresan kewosi wo.
Mexiha matande orezhi matande goyane sheidene Hudade ogisan andatu dunxi, mure danlazhi Hudade ogisan mutun taye yan giese oreku zhugheghala gie.
Lon kijieku, yanyanji zannanni gieku, tanxin giekulai tai dunda qiizhi da ulie olune. Shentula ingiezhi giese heshi uwo.
Shizheku kielien, hu kielieku kielien, zannan kielienlai bu kieliedene mafan gieku kielien kielie.
Ta goude mejie, lon kijiechen, zannanni giechen, tanxin giechenla Mexiha Hudaghalai gojiai jiachanni jienlie dane. Tanxin gieku nigiedade beiikughala niekielien wo.
Enezighan shiqin jiere Hudai hokuruku hhezighan kielien ulie chenliechen kunlai jiere irene. Yama oronde witu kielienghala kiema tai bu piendagha.
Ingiese ta hhelare bu hhantula.
Ta eqighandeishi kharani woma, edeshi Ezhanyi miende gon wo. Ta yan giese gonni kewosi mutun gie.
Gonni jiegoshi yanyanji gouni, gundanni, zhenni wo.
Ezhan bayasuku shiqinshi yan wo giezhi kaoyen gie.
Yama haochu witu, khara shiqin giesan kunlare bu hhantula, khareidene hhezighan shiqin giesan kunlai kheila.
Hhela beimiende giesan shiqinlai qiise ungien hularane.
Manlai chujiegheghasanshi gon wo. Gon dunda khizheghasanlai man chujieghene. Ingiese kieliezho, "Unturasan kunya, xierei! Fugusanse bosizhe, Mexiha chii zhouine."
Ingiese ta xioxin giezhi gie. Aghelitu kun mutun gie, ben kun mutun bu gie.
Jihuini goude barei, edeku gonyin doghun wo.
Ingiese ben kun bu danlazhi Ezhanni isishi yan bikui mejie.
Jiu ochizhi bu sudo, jiu kunni hu gieghane. Khareidene Shenlinghala goyane durugha.
Shige, zanmeige, ganjin donghala nieniedene doula. Zhughesene don giezhi Ezhande doula.
Yan shiqindeliuzhe mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihani niereghala chan ada Hudade mafan kielie.
Mexihai zunjiku zhugheghala nieniene shunji.
Biereila, Ezhande shunjiku mutun zhanguijidene shunji.
Mexihashi jiohuini qiorun biku mutun zhanguijishi biereini qiorun wo. Mexihashi ene beye, jiushi jiohuini jiuichen wo.
Jiohui Mexihade matugie shunjiku mutun biereiye yandeliuzhe zhanguijidene qingiezhi shunji.
Zhanguijila, Mexiha jiohuide orezhi goyane sheisan mutun biereidene ore.
Hhe ingiezhi giekushi Hudai kielienyi tungo giezhi usughala jiohuini waghazhi zhiguishighadene
famashighazhi goyadene khughoghane giezho, yama zannan jienjien chuchutu intui wizhi zhiguitu yama maobin witui gholughane giezho.
Niekielien wo, zhanguijiye beyedene oreku mutun biereidene orekuni wo. Biereidene orese goyadene orezho.
Kiemada goya beyene henjichen kun uwo, kharei guizhunde zhaogu giezhi Mexiha jiohuini zhaogu giekughala niekielien wo.
Matanshi hhei beye jieredu iyanzi wo.
Ingiese kun ada anasene likai giedene biereighalane hhantulazhi ghuala nie beye gholune.
Eneshi fugie mimi wo. Bi Mexiha, jiohuighalai zhiizhi kieliezho.
Ingieliuzhe ta jien kunlaye goyadene oreku mutun biereidene ore. Biereiye zhanguijine zunji.
Kewosila, Ezhanyi miende ada ananughunne chenlie. Eneshi indanji wo.
Ada anane zunji, ingiese chade gouni irezhi duyade oloncha agine. Eneshi dain giesanyi deilasan ji 1 gie minlin wo.
Adala, kesilane ho bu kughadene Ezhanni gonjiku banfa, pse sughakughala lai.
Hojila, Mexihanughunyi chenlieku mutun ayi pugharaku zhugheghala shixinji duyai ezhannughunne chenlie.
Zinie kunlai bayasughane giezhi kunlai melie bu gie. Khareidene Mexihade hoji danlazhi zhughesene Hudai isii zunji.
Kunni ushilaku mutun bu giedene Ezhanne ushilaku mutun bayasuzhi gie.
Bugon hoji danlasan, ziyutu kun, Ezhan jien kun giesan gou shiqinde jianli ogikui ta jila.
Ezhanla, hojiladeneye ingiezhi giezhi hhelai pse bu ayigha. Ta hhelade asiman jiere niekozi Ezhan bikui jila. Hhe kunlade pienxin ulie giene.
Zuihoude kielieye, ta Ezhanyi miende hhei fugie liliande kouizhi khiduzhe.
Zhan eghikude baohu gieku Hudai 1 tao jienni musi. Ingiese Ibilisini piendakui duii shidane.
Matan kunlare ese eghinduzho. Gonjisan, qienli bareisan, ene khara duyani lilian, asiman jieredu doghun ruhherlare eghinduzho.
Ingiese zhan eghikude baohu gieku Hudai 1 tao jienni musi. Ingiese ta ene doghun duyade duitoulai duizhi eghindu baludene bei shidane.
Bei undanlazhi nurundene zhendaoni pixilie, gundannii zhughei baohu gieku majia danlaghazhi musi,
heqishighaku gouxioxini heini chan zhunbei giedene kon jiere musi.
Enense chugo pse xianxin giekuni baohu gieku banba danlaghazhi barei. Ingiese Ibilisini khantu gunjienlai man xiniegha shidane.
Jiuikui toukui danlaghazhi zho. Shenlinni boujienyi barei, eneshi Hudai kielien wo.
Yan shihoudeliuzhe Shenlinde kouizhi olon onxian giezhi xiahua gie. Enende oluzhi jinxin giezhi chan zhazhen giezhi soyuji shentulade xiahua gie.
Madeye oluzhi onxian gie. Bi kieliekude Huda made heshini kielien ogizhi fugie danzighala gouxioxii mimii jianjizhi minbai olugha gie.
Ene gouxioxide oluzhi mii sozilawoma, bishi Hudai daibio enbene. Bi indan kieliekui danzine fugiedaghazhi jianjigha giezhi onxian gie.
Mii qinkon, bi yan giesanlai Tuijigu man tande mejieghane. Hheshi nie oresan gaijiu wo, Ezhande oluzhi shixinji giesan wiliechi wo.
Bi zhomen hhei tai hhende peizhi echighakushi bijienyi qinkonyi tande mejieghazhi tai zhughei nanranshighane giezho.
Ada Huda, Ezhan Ersa Mexiha pinnan, oreku, xianxin giekui gaijiulade ogi gie.
Ulie bienjiku zhugheghala mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihade oresan soyuji kunlade man nenjien ogi gie!
Feilibi
Mexiha Ersani hoji BaoloQimotaighala Feilibide sousan Mexiha Ersai miendedu soyuji shentu, lindao, gonjialade xin huaizho.
Mai ada Huda, Ezhan Ersa Mexiha tande nenjien, pinnan ogi gie!
Bi niefanie tai sumulakude bi zunjisan Hudade mafan kieliezho.
Bayasuku zhugheghala ta dajialade oluzhi izhi onxian giezho.
Ingiekushi ta kaishi giesan hhe uduse eli kutula gouxioxii chonjizhi hhantu wilie giezho.
Tai dunda gou wilieni kaishi giesan hhe ene wilieni Ersa Mexihani udu kuzhese onchen giekui bi hende xianxin giezho.
Bi ingiezhi tai man sumulase indanji wo, ta mii zhughede wine. Bi bafanzi soukude, pse gouxioxide oluzhi huizhi ganzhen beikude Huda made ogisan nenjiende ta man hhantulazho.
Bi Mexiha Ersai zhugheghala tai matugie sanasanyi Huda made ganzhen beine.
Bi onxian giese tai oreku erlinji pandon gieku jiere yebeiye olodo,
yanshi zui gouni bikui fenjizhi Mexiha ireku udude ganjin, yama ulie sugieghachen kun danla,
Ersa Mexihani kouizhi gou wilielai olon giedene kuaiku, zanjikuni Hudade ogi giezho.
Gaijiula, made penjisan shiqin kharei gouxioxii ondaghasanyi bi tande mejieghaku duran wine.
Bi Mexihade oluzhi bafanzi sousei hongunni soyuji budui, psedu kunla man mejiewo.
Mii bareise dabufun gaijiula Ezhanyi goude xianxin giedene goujida ulie ayizhi danzine fugiedagha Hudai daolii chonjizho.
Niezhanla dubiliezhi zhenjinduzhi chonjizho, da niezhanla gou zhugheghala Mexihai chonjizho.
Enezighan kunla Huda mii nanpei giezhi gouxioxii huighasei mejiedene oreku zhugheghala giezho.
Hhezighan kunla Mexihai chonjise zinie goyadene oluzhi shixinji ese giezho. Mujishi bi bafanzi soukude olon shouku gieghane giezho.
Ingieseye yan xiangan wo? Huai mujiye oluzho, gou mujiye oluzho, yan gieliuzhe Mexihani chonji keighase bi bayasuzho. Bi pse bayasukushi
tai onxian gieku, pse Ersa Mexihani ruhherni banman giekui tungo giezhi mii andaghakui bi mejiene.
Bi hende panjizhi xiwon giesanshi mii yan shiqindeliuzhe ulie shizheghazhi eqighanku mutun edeye danzine fugiedaghazhi fugu amituliuzhe mii jiere Mexihani zhiguishighakui wo.
Mii kieliese bi amitushi Mexihade oluzho, fuguseye haochu wine.
Ingieliuzhe bi amiturazhi wilie giezhi jiego goushi bi alinie sunghukui ulie mejiene.
Ghuala mii jiai beizho. Bi duyase likai giezhi Mexihaghala hhantulaku duran wine. Enense pse gouni uwoma,
bi tande oluzhi duyade biku genjia biyo wine.
Bi ingiezhi hende xianxin giese duyade feiliezhi tanre man hhantu soukui mejiene. Ingiese tai xinyan jiere hendazhi bayasukui wine.
Ingie bi tai hhende pse echikude mii tungo giezhi Mexiha Ersa giesan shiqinde kuaikui genjia olodoghane.

Zhunyonishi tashi asiman gojiani kun wo giezhi tai giekula Mexihani gouxioxi mutun izhishi. Ingiese bi tai uzhele irenu, ulie ireliuzhe tande nie muji bizhi beizhi undanladene gouxioxini xinyan fanmiende hhantu xiacha giezhi
tai fandui giesan kunlase goujida ulie ayikui bi mejiene. Ta ulie ayise hhelai widaku, pse tai jiuikui hhelade zhenmin giezho. Enelashi man Huda giesan wo.
Tande ogisan nenjienshi zinie Mexihai xianxin gieku pusho, hhende oluzhi shouku giekuye enbene.
Ta eghindusan zhanshi bi eghindusanghala niekielien wo. Eqighandei ta mii jiere chujieghezhi daozho, ede bi eghindusei ta chenliezho.
Ingiese Mexihai miende tande sughaku kielien, orezhi sidaghaku, Shenlinghala laiwon gieku, pse renyi, ubali xiiku bise
tai sumuladan nie gholuzhi nieniedene orezhi nie zhughe gholu. Ingiese bi hende bayasune.
Yan shiqinniliuzhe zinie goyadene oluzhi bu gie, minshenni tanxin bu gie, goyane meilade uzhezhi kunlai goyasene fugiede uzhe.
Zinie goyane shiqinni bu gui, kunlai shiqinniye gui.
Ta zhughene Mexiha Ersai zhughe mutun gholugha.
Hhende Hudai yanzi winema, goyane Hudaghala pindane giezhi xiacha ese giedene
Kharei goyane yanyanjilai bendazhi hojini yanzi gholuzhi kun mutun oluwo. Kunni yanzi mutun irese
Goyane meilade uzhezhi fugutula shunjiwo, da shizijia jiere fuguwo.
Ingiese Huda hhei zui unduni gholughazhi hhende yanyanji nierese fugie nierei ogiwo.
Ingie asiman jieredu, zemin jieredu, zemin douradu yanyanjila man Ersani nierede xiutuliezhi
Jien kunlai amanla Ersa Mexihashi Ezhan wo giezhi chenren giedene Huda Adade kuaikui ireghawo.
Ingiese mii orentula, bi tanre hhantu bikude ta chan chenliesan mutun ede bi tai hhende uwokude genjia qingiezhi ayi pugharazhi tai jiuikui shiqinni xiacha giezhi chenjigha.
Tai sudoro wilie giezhi goya gou isine gieghane giezhi tande duranji gieku nenli ogisanshi Huda wo.
Ta yan shiqin gieliuzhe boxin bu kielie, bu jianjindu.
Tande yama kheilaku wizhi ganjintu kun gholu. Ta Hudade yama maobin witu kewosi danlazhi duyade doghun, wirulasan kunlai dunda gon fai.
Aminni daolii xienjizhi khizhegha. Ingiese bi Mexihani udude goyane belien ese holuzhi belien wilie ese giezho giezhi kuaine.
Bi tai xianxin giekude oluzhi goyane sidagha gieku teizi jiere mure danlaghazhi chusunne pojieliuzhe bayasuzhi da tanre hhantu bayasune.
Taye qingiezhi bayasu, da mare hhantu bayasu.
Bi Ezhan Ersai kouizhi Qimotaini tai hhende ghujighande peizhi echighaye giezho. Tai qinkonlai mejiezhi bi zhughene nanranshighane giezho.
Mare hhantu tande shixinji gonxin giesan kun hhense chugo nieda uwo.
Psedu kunla man zinie goyane shiqinyi guine, Ersa Mexihani shiqinyi ulie guine.
Ingieliuzhe Qimotaini kunyi ta mejiene. Hhe goya adane mutun mii uzhezhi mare hhantu gouxioxide oluzhi wilie giezho.
Ingiese bi goyane shiqinni jiegoi mejiese deigo hhei peizhi echighane giezho.
Ingie oloncha ulie beidene biye echikui Ezhanyi miende xianxin giezho.

Ingiezhoma, bi sumulase Ibafuqini tai hhende khareizhi echighaku biyo wine giezho. Hheshi mii gaijiu, lienshou, mare hhantu zhan eghindusan kun wo. Ta hhei peizhi bi xiyo bikude banman gieghale irezho.
Hhe ta dajialai hende sanazhi, da hhe giemeresei ta mejiese hhe hende nango giezho.
Shuhua hhe giemerezhi fugukude kuruwoma, ingieliuzhe Huda hhende ubali xiizhi madeye ubali xiizho. Pse bi genjia yuchou giene.
Ingiese bi genjia jindazhi hhei peizhi echighaye. Ta hhei chanlase bayasune, mii yuchou giekuye choghonshine.
Ta Ezhanyi miende hende bayasuzhi hhei jienlie. Imutu kunlai zunzhun gie.
Ta made banman gie dasande hhe banman giezhi Mexihai wiliede oluzhi chabudu aminni widawo.
Mini gaijiula, zuihoude kielieye, ta Ezhanni miende bayasu. Bi xianxianji kielienyi pse huaise chijia uwo, tande haochu wine.
Ta hhezighan doghunni giesan kunlai fangula. Hhela nogheini xianli, beyene otolusan kun wo.
Zhenzhenji hetoune giesanlashi matan enezighan Hudai Ruhherde kouizhi libai giesanla wo, Mexiha Ersai kuaizho, beyede ese kouizho.
Biye beyede koui shidane. Kunla sumulase beyede kouine giese bi genjia ingiezhi gie shidane.
Mii oluzhi neimudude hetoune giewo. Bishi Isilie minzu, Bienyamin painughun wo. Zhenzhenji Xibolai kun wo. Guijinghala kieliese bishi Falisai kun wo.
Rexinni kieliese bi jiohuini heizhi daozho. Guijinni yoqiughala kieliese made yama kheilakui uwo.
Ingieliuzhe eqighandei made gouni wo giesanlai ede bi Mexihani yenyinghala man gou wini danlaghazho.

Zinie ene pusho, bi soyujilai gou wini danlaghakushi bi zunjisan Ezhan Mexiha Ersani tanikui zui zhunyoni danlaghazho. Bi hhende oluzhi soyujilane bendazhi hhagha mutun uzhekushi Mexihani goyadene ireghazhi
hhere hhantulane giezho. Made bisan gounishi guijinse iresan pusho, bi Mexihani xianxin giekughala Huda ogisan wo.
Bi Mexihani tanizhi hhei aminne olusan nenlii mejieku duran wine. Pse hhere hhantu ku shouizhi hhei fugukui daghaku duran wine.
Ingie bi fugusanse aminne oluse giezho.
Eneshi bi ijin chengun oluwo, ijin onqienshiwo giesan pusho. Mexiha Ersa made agighasanyi bi agine giezhi izhi holuzho.
Gaijiula, bi goyane agiwo giezhi ulie sumulane. Bi zinie nie shiqin giezho, daosan shiqinyi matadene meliedekui agine giezhi
mubiode daine giezhi holuzho. Ingie Huda Mexiha Ersai miende mii urudene ogine giesan asiman jieredu jianlini linlane giezho.
Ingiese matanyi dundadu hen kunla man ingiezhi sumulakui wo. Tande buxiantu xianfa bise Huda eneiye tande mejieghane.
Matan yan chendude kuruse zhao ene chenduzhe gieye.
Gaijiula, ta man mii daghazhi suru. Pse bijien tande surughasan yanzii daghazhi giesan hhezighan kunlai ta goude uzhe.
Bi chan tande kieliezho, ede pse wilazhi kielieye, olon kunla Mexihani shizijiai duitou mutun giezho.
Hhelani jiegoshi widakuni wo. Hhelani hudashi goyani kieli wo. Hhela goya shizhekune ulie mejiedene kuaine, sumulasanlashi duyani shiqin wo.
Matanshi asiman gojiani kun wo, hhense nie jiuichen irekui sagheizho. Hheshijiu Ezhan Ersa Mexiha wo.
Hhe yanyanjii goyadene shunjighasan fugie nenlighala matanyi bixin beyeni goya famatu beyene mutun niekielien gholughane.
Ingiese bi orezhi sanasan gaijiula, tashi mii bayasuku wo, mii mienzi wo. Bi oresanla, ta Ezhanni kouizhi beizhi undanla.
Bi Yuyajiede xiahua gieye, pse Xindujide xiahua gieye, ta ghuala Ezhanni miende tonjie gie.

Mii zhenzhenji gou lienshou, bi chiiye xiahua gieye. Chi ene funilade banman gie. Hhela gouxioxini wiliede mare, pse Gelimien, psedu lienshoulare hhantu khishulazhi daozho. Hhelai nierei aminni jilasan benzi jiere huaizho.
Ta Ezhanni miende chan bayasu. Bi pse kielieye, ta bayasu.
Jien kunlade renyine mejiegha. Ezhan chadashiwo.
Yamade munan bu giezhi yan shiqindeliuzhe onxian gie, xiahua giezhi kere, mafan gieku zhugheghala ta keresanlane Hudade kielie.
Ingiese kun lijie gie daku Hudai pinnan Mexiha Ersai sudoro tai zhughe, sumulakui baohu giene.
Gaijiula, zuihoude kielieye, ta chan zui gouni, kunla kuaikui sumula. Jien zhenni, zunjiku, gundanni, ganjinni, oreku, gou minshen enelai sumula.
Ta mase surusan, jienliesan, chenliesan, chanlasanlai izhigie gie. Ingiese pinnantu Huda tanre hhantu wo.
Bi Ezhanni miende hende bayasukushi ta mii zhaogu giekui ede pse jila irewo. Shijishan ta izhi mii zhaogu giene giezhoma jihui ese irezho.
Bi ingiezhi kieliekushi made yama chaisan pusho. Bi yan qinkondeliuzhe zhigan giekui suruwo.
Bi nanxinde matugie giekui mejiene, bayande matugie giekuiye mejiene. Chuduku, oliesuku, bayanni, chaiku, yan shiqin yan qinkondeliuzhe matugie gieku banfai bi suruwo.
Made lilian ogisan hhende kouizhi bi yanniliuzhe gie shidane.
Ingiezhoma, bi kunnan bikude ta mare hhantu danjizho, ingiese gou wo.
Feilibi kunla, bi gouxioxi chonjizhi qiizhi Maqidunse likai giekude baer ogiku shiqin jiere tanse chugo psedu jiohuila mare hhantu ese danjisanyi taye mejiene.
Bi Qiesalonijiade bikude ta touchan erchanji bi injikulai ta khughozhi ireghawo.
Bi tanse mure kerene gie ese giezho. Zinie ta giesan wiliede haochu olodoghane giezho.
Made yanyanji wine, da feiliezho. Ta Ibafuqii tungo giezhi made khughosanlai bi jienliedene kuruzho. Eneshi Huda bayasuzhi jienlieku andatu mure wo.
Bi zunjisan Huda famatu bayansene Mexiha Ersai miende tai yanyanji injikulai ogizhi kurughane.
Matanyi ada Hudade chanqi izhi kuaikui ogi. Amine!
Mexiha Ersai miendedu jien shentulade kielien asa. Mare hhantuku gaijiula tande kielien asazho.
Shentula man, tebieshi Kaisa hongunni kunla tande kielien asazho.
Ezhan Ersa Mexihani nenjien tai zhughede bi gie!
Geloxi
Hudai isighala Mexiha Ersade shitu danlasan Baolo, Qimotai gaijiughala
Geloxidedu shentulade, Mexihani shixinji daghasan gaijiulade xin huaizho. Nenjien, pinnanni mai ada Hudase tande ogi gie!
Bijien tande oluzhi onxian giekude mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihani ada Hudade chan mafan kieliezho.
Eneshi bijien chenliese ta Ersa Mexihai xianxin giezhi soyuji shentulade orezho.
Xianxin gieku, orekushi tande asiman jiere sunjisan xiwonse irezho. Ene panjikushi ta melieshida zhenzhenji daoli, jiushi gouxioxise chenliesan wo.

Tai hhende iresan ene gouxioxi qienxiade chonji kurudene olodozhi jiego khizhezho, zhen ta gouxioxini chenliedene Hudai nenjienni zhenzhenji dunjireku hhe uduse qiizhi tai dunda jiego khizhesanghala niekielien wo.
Ene gouxioxini bijien oresan, hhantu hoji danlasan Ibafuse ta suruwo. Hhe tande oluzhi Mexihade shixinji wiliechi danlazho,
pse Shenlin tande ogisan orekui bijiende kieliezho.
Ingiese bijien tai xioxii chenliesan hhe uduse tande oluzhi ese beidene onxian giezho. Bi xiahua giese tai ruhher fanmienni shiqinni soyuji agheliji lijie giekui qiendaghazhi Hudai isii mejie.
Ingiedene ta udu daokude Ezhanyi pei shidaku mutun giezhi yandeliuzhe hhei bayasugha, yanyanji gou wilie jiere olon jiego khizheghazhi Hudai olon tani.
Zhao hhei famatu fugie nenlizhe tande olon nenli bizhi bayasuku zhugheghala yan shiqindeliuzhe zhazhen giezhi rennai gie,
gieghantu gojiade shentulai caichanni xianshou gieku zigeni tande ogisan Adade mafan kielie giezho.
Ada kharanii qienlise matai jiuizhi khizhedene goya oresan kewonne gojiade ireghawo.
Hhei kewonni tungo giezhi matanyi shuizhi zuini mienliewo.
Mexihashi chanla daku Hudai yanzi wo, soyuji zhayaghasanlase tou 1 giede olusan wo.
Hhei kouizhi asiman, zemin jieredu soyujilai man zhayaghawo. Chanlaku, chanla daku, honshan danlasan, ezhan danlasan, gonjisan, qienli bareisanlai man hhei tungo giezhi, hhende oluzhi zhayaghawo.
Hhe soyujilase melie wine. Soyujila hhei kouizhi beizho.
Hheshi beyeni qiorun wo, ene beyeshi jiohui wo. Hheshi keitou wo, fugusan kun dundase xien aminne oluzhi soyujilai touzi gholuwo.
Huda bayasuzhi hulunnine man hhei sudoro teizhi
hhei tungo giezhi soyujilai goyarene goudaghawo. Mexiha shizijia jiere usurusan chusunghala zemin asiman jieredulai man heqishighawo.
Eqighandei ta Hudare danxinrazhi sumulaku jiere Hudare duitou gholuzhi doghunni giezhoma,
ede Huda Mexihai beyei fugukui tungo giezhi tai goyarene goudaghawo. Ingiekushi tai zhiguitu, jienjien witu, yama kieliekui witui gholughazhi hhei melie beilaghane giezho.

Ta indan xinyanne izhi goude bareizhi undanlagha. Ta chenliesan gouxioxini panjikuse likai bu gie. Ene gouxioxini qienxiani soyuji zhayaghasanlade man chonji kurughawo. Bi Baoloye ene gouxioxide hoji danlazho.
Ede bi tande oluzhi bayasuzhi ku shouizho. Mexiha beyedene, yejiushi jiohuide oluzhi ese shouizhi baraghasan kuini bi beye jierene shouizho.
Huda tande oluzhi made ogisan renwughala bi jiohuide wiliechi danlakushi Hudai kielienyi man chonjizhi khizheghane giezho.
Ene mimii melieshidaku olon shidaini kunlade niuighazhoma, ede shentuladene mejieghawo.
Ene mimi niman kunlai dunda zhengiejia fama bikui Huda shentuladene mejieghane giezhi duralawo. Ene mimishi tai sudoro bisan Mexiha wo, jiushi famanide echighaku xiwon wo.
Bijien hhei chonjizhi olon aghelighala jien kunyi jingao giezhi jien kunde surughakushi jien kunyi Mexihai miende hendaghazhi Hudai melie beilaghane giezho.
Bi enende oluzhi mii sudoro fugiede wilie giesan nenlide kouizhi xiacha giezhi khishulazho.
Bi tande, Laojijiani kunlade, pse soyuji mii chanlazhi ese daosan kunlade oluzhi matugie xiacha giesanyi tande mejieghaku duran wine.
Hhelai sidaghazhi orekughala nieniedene lienji giezho. Qinchude liojie gieku nenlighala Hudai mimini goude mejie giezho. Hheshi Mexiha wo.
Hhei sudoro soyuji agheli, erlinni boubeilai man ghurazho.
Bi ene kielienlai kieliekushi kienyiliuzhe seighan kielienghala tai ulie miighane giezho.
Bi tai hhende uwoma, zhughemi tanre hhantu wo. Ta goude giezhi Mexihai khidunde xianxin giekui uzhese bi bayasuzho.
Ta Mexiha Ersani Ezhan wo giezhi jienliese hhende kouizhi gie.
Ta surusan mutun hhei sudoro genzilazhi fugieda. Xianxin giekui undanlaghazhi mafan gieku zhughe olodogha.
Ta xioxin giezhi kiema tai kunni erlinji piendaku seighan kielienghala bareizhi bu echigha. Eneshi Mexihai daghasan pusho, kunni xigon, duyai langan daolini daghazho.
Hudai soyuji tejienla kunni beyeghala iresan Mexihani jiere man wine.
Ta hhei sudoro hulunshizho. Hheshi soyuji gonjisan, qienli bareisanlai qiorun wo.
Pse hhei sudoro ta kunni khaghala ese giesan hetoune giezho. Mexihani tungo giezhi hetoune giedene nefuxintu beyeni widaghawo.
Ta xilii jienliezhi hhere hhantu bulazhi hhei fugusan kun dundase aminne olughasan Hudai nenlii xianxin giezhi hhere hhantu aminne oluwo.
Ta melieshida codasan dunda, pse hetoune ese giesan zui gieku beyei yenyinzhe fuguzhoma, Huda tai codasanlai man mienliezhi tai Mexihare hhantu aminne olughawo.
Guijin jiere mai zhazhi kunzhi giezhi jilasanlai moizhi widaghawo. Shizijia jiere ghadazhi widaghawo.
Gonjisan, qienli bareisanlai barei iredene uqilaini widagha shizheghazhi kunlai melie beilazhi shizijiai tungo giezhi injiwo.
Ingiese ijieku, ochiku, jieqi, chuyi, hhamuraku udu jiere kunlai goyalane bu kieliegha.
Enelashi jianlai irekuni xiujie wo, zhennishi Mexihanughun wo.
Kunla nanxighan goyane meilade uzhezhi qienxienlani beiikughala tai jianlii bu qianlagha. Imutu kunla goya chanlawo giesande miizho. Nefuxinghalane hanhanji goyane fugiede uzhene,
qiorunghala ese lienjizho. Hhense jinlian khizhezhi nie beyei go mouzi sidasunlai man lienjighazhi zhao Huda osighasan mutun osizho.
Ta Mexihare hhantu fuguzhi duyai langan daolise andazhoma, yale dou duyanughunyi daghazhi giesan mutun bu barei, bu ijie, bu shigha giesan guijinlai shunjine?
Enelai nie injise zoin man wida khine, zinie kun fenfulazhi surughasan wo.
Uzhese enezighan guijinlashi suibiende beiiku, goyane guide meilade uzheku, goyane zayalaku jiere agheli winekui xianli, shijishan kunni nefuxinni daruku jiere yama zoin uwo.
Ingiese ta Mexihare hhantu aminne oluse asiman jiereshiku shiqinni erei. Hhende Mexiha Hudai borun miende souzho.
Ta zemin jiereshiku shiqinni bu sumuladene asiman jiereshiku shiqinni sumula.
Ta ijin fuguzhi tai amin Mexihare hhantu Hudai sudoro niuizho.
Mexihashi matai amin wo. Hhe xienjikudei ta hhere hhantu fama dunda xienjine.
Ingiese tai sudoro bisan zemin jieredu zui gieku duranlai fugugha, jiushi lon kijieku, zannanni, nefuxin, doghunnii sumulaku, tanxin gieku wo. Tanxin giese nigiedai beiizho.
Enelai yenyin jiere Hudai hokuku kielien ulie chenliechen kunlai jiere bouzhene.
Taye eqighandei enelai dunda udu daokude ingiezhi giezhoma,
ede ta hokuku, piqi shuaiku, doghunni, kufurei fanjiku, shizheku kielienlai man widagha.
Ta nieniedene ghudan bu kielie. Ta khuichen kun, pse hhe giedanlai teidene
shini kunni musizho. Ene shini kun hhei zhayaghasan Ezhanyi yanzizhe hhei tanizhi izhi shinishizho.
Enende Xila kun Yutai kun, hetoune giesan kun ese giesan kun, yeren, unhua witu kun, hoji, ziyutu kun, enelai ulie fenjine. Mexihashi soyuji wo, soyujilai dunda wine.
Tashi Huda sunghusan, zhiguitu, oresan kun wo. Ingiese ta ubali xiiku, gou zhughe, meilade uzheku, renyi, rennai giekui musi.
Ene kun hhe kunde boxin kieliekui bise aghuide sumulazhi nieniene roulie. Ezhan tai matugie rouliezhoshi taye qingiezhi kunlai roulie.
Enelase chugo orekui musi. Oreku manlai lienjighazhi hulunshighane.
Mexihani pinnan tai zhughei gonji gie. Ene pinnande oluzhi tai uruzhi nie beye gholughawo. Taye chan mafan kielie.
Ta Mexihani kielienyi zhughedene zhengiejia olonde teizhi soyuji aghelighala nieniedene surughazhi nieniene jingao gie. Mafan gieku zhugheghala shige, zanmeige, ganjin donghala Hudade doula.
Ta yan kieliezhi yan gieliuzhe Ezhan Ersani niereghala gie. Hhei tungo giezhi ada Hudade mafan kielie.
Biereila, zhanguijine shunji, ene Ezhanyi miende heshi wo.
Zhanguijila biereidene ore, hhelai bu zayala.
Kewosila, yandeliuzhe ana adanughunne chenlie, eneshi Ezhan bayasukui wo.
Adala, kesilane bu hokugha, pse hhelade zhughe widane.
Hojila, yandeliuzhe duyani ezhannughunne chenlie. Yan giese kunlai bayasughachen kun mutun zinie kunlai nudun melie bu giedene Ezhanni zunjizhi shixinji gie.
Ta yan giese kunlade gieku mutun bu giedene Ezhande gieku mutun zhughesene gie.
Ingiekushi ta Ezhanni hhense jianli wo giezhi jiachanni jienliekui mejiene. Ta shunjisanshi Ezhan Mexiha wo.
Gou wini giesan kunde gou wini irene. Ezhan kunde pienxin ulie giene.
Ezhanla, hojiladene gundande gie. Tandeye asiman jiere Ezhan bikui ta mejiene.
Ta jinxin giezhi mafan giekughala izhi onxian gie.
Pse bijiende oluzhiye onxian gie. Huda bijiende daoli chonjiku wijienyi keighazhi Mexihai mimini jianjigha gie. Bi ene yenyinde bafanzi souzho.
Ingiezhi onxian giema, bi indan kielieku kielienghala daolini man kielie khizheghane.
Ta jihuini goude bareizhi aghelighala xianxin ese giesan kunlare laiwon gie.
Ta kielien kieliese dansunghala andatughaku mutun chan renyide kielie. Ingiese jien kunde matugie huida giekui mejiene.
Mii qinkonlai Tuijigu man tande mejieghane. Hheshi nie oresan gaijiu wo, shixinji giesan wiliechi wo, mare hhantu Ezhande hoji danlazho.
Bi zhomen hhei tai hhende peizhi echighakushi bijienyi qinkonyi tande mejieghazhi tai zhughei nanranshighane giezho.
Hhere hhantu echiku dou nie oresan, shixinjitu gaijiu Aniximu wine. Hheshi tai hhendedu kun wo. Hhe ghuala enendedu shiqinlai man tande kieliene.

Mare hhantu bafanzi sousan Yalidagu, Banabani gujiu Make, Yushidu giezhi urusan Ersa enela tande kielien asazho. Makeni kieliese, tande fenfulazhi daozho. Hhe tai hhende irese ta hhei jienlie. Yutaini Mexihai xianxin giesan kun dunda zinie enela mare hhantu Hudai gojiade oluzhi wilie giezhi mii zhughei nanranshighazho.

Mexiha Ersade hoji danlasan tai hhendeduku kun Ibafu tande kielien asazho. Hhe chan tande oluzhi xiacha giezhi onxian giese ta Hudai isi jiere man hulunshizhi xianxin gieku duruzhi beizhi undanlase giezho.
Hhe tande, pse Laojijia, Xilapolini gaijiulade oluzhi olon khishulazho, enei bi hhende ganzhen bei shidane.
Oresan deifu Lujia, Jimaghala tande kielien asazho.
Laojijiadedu gaijiulade, pse Ninfade, hhei giededuku jiohuide kielien asa.
Ta ene xinni onshidene Laojijiani jiohuide ogizhi hhelade onshigha. Laojijiase iresan xinni taye onshi.
Ezhanse jienliesan renwuni ijinyo onchen gie giezhi Yajibude kielie.
Bi Baolo qinsi huaizhi kielien asazho. Bi bafanzi sousanyi ta jila. Nenjien tanre chan hhantu bi gie!
1 Qiesalonijia
Baolo, Seila, Qimotai ghurelie Ada Huda, Ezhan Ersa Mexihai xianxin giesan Qiesalonijiai jiohuide xin huaizho. Tande nenjien, pinnan ogi gie!
Bijien ta ashighalade oluzhi Hudade chan mafan kieliezho. Onxian giekude tai qiizhi kieliezho.
Bijien mai Ada Hudai melie tai izhigie jilazhi kieliezho. Ta xianxin giekughala giesan wilie, orezhi khishulasan, pse mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihai panjizhi rennai giesei jilazhi onxian giezho.
Huda oresan gaijiula, tai sunghusei bijien mejiene.

Bijien tande gouxioxini chonjikude zinie kielienghala giesan pusho, nenli, Shenlin, hende xianxin gieku zhugheghala giesan wo. Bijien tanre hhantu bikude tande oluzhi matugie giesei ta goyalane qinchu wo.
Ta bijien, Ezhan mutun qingie giezhi heikui fugiede shouiliuzhe Shenlin banman giedene daolini bayasuzhi jienliewo.
Ingiese Maqidun, Yagaiyani orondedu xianxin giesan kunlade yanzi uzheghawo.
Ezhanyi kielien tai hhense chonji khizhezhi zinie Maqidun, Yagaiyade pusho, gochude man chonji kuruwo. Ta Hudai xianxin giesan xioxii gochui kunla man mejiese bijien yama kielieku biyo uwo.
Ta matugiezhi goude bijienyi jienliesei, pse nigiedalai bendadene amitu, zhen Hudai shunjisei hhela goyane kielienduzho.
Pse ta asiman jierese ireku Hudai Kewonni sagheizho giene. Hheshi Huda fugusan kun dundase aminne olughasan Ersa wo, jianlai ireku Hudai hokurukuse matanyi jiuine.
Gaijiula, bijien tai oronde irese zoin ulie qiikui pusho. Enei ta goyalane qinchu wo.
Ta mejiesan mutun bijien Feilibide bikude kunla bijienyi heizhi shizheghawoma, ingieliuzhe mai Huda ogisan danzighala kunla hende fandui gieliuzhe Hudai gouxioxii tande kieliezhi ogiwo.
Bijien tande surughazhi kieliekude codasei, ganjin witu zhughe, piendakughala ese giezho.
Khareidene bijien kieliekude Huda bijienyi chenren giezhi gouxioxini deilaghasan kun wo giezhi kunlai bayasughane ese giezho. Mai zhughei uzhesan Hudai bayasughane giezho.
Bijien seighan kielienghala ese kieliezho, tanxin gieku zhugheghalaye ese giezho. Enei ta mejiene, Hudaye ganzhen beine.
Bijien Mexihani shitu danlachenlade tai melie qienli winema, goyane taye hao, kunlaye hao kuaighane ese giezho. Bijien tai dunda renyi zhugheghala ana kesilane qiezheku mutun giezho.
Bijien tande hende orezhi zinie Hudai gouxioxini ogiku pusho, lien goya aminneye ogiku duran wo. Tashi bijien ingiezhi oresan wo.
Gaijiula, bijien khishulazhi shouku giesei ta mejiene. Bijien tande Hudai gouxioxini chonjikude ta kiemade achan ulie ogine giezhi xieni udu wilie giezho.
Ta xianxin giesan kunlade bijien giesanshi zhigui, gundanni wo, yama kieliekuni uwo. Enende ta ganzhen bei, Hudaye ganzhen beine.
Ada kesiladene giesan mutun
bijien tande sidaghazhi surughazhi goude fenfulasei ta mejiene. Ingiezhi giekushi goyane gojiade, famade urusan Huda tai heshide gieghane giezho.

Bijien pse Hudade chan mafan kielieku dounie yenyinshi ene wo. Ta bijiense Hudai kielienyi jienliekude kunni kielien wo uye giedene Hudai kielien wo giezho. Hhe shuhua Hudai kielien enbene. Ene kielien ta xianxin giesan kunlade zoin wine.
Gaijiulaya, Yudaya orondedu Mexiha Ersai xianxin giesan Hudai jiohuini kunlai Yutai kunlase heisanyi shouisan mutun taye goya kunlase heisanyi shouiwo.
Ene Yutai kunla Ezhan Ersai, xienzhilai alazhi bijienyi tou khireighawo. Hhela Hudai ese bayasughazhi jien kunlare duitou gholuwo.
Hhela bijienyi niman kunlade ulie chonjighazhi ulie jiuighane giezho. Hhelai zui izhi olodozhi duruse Hudai hokuku zuihoude hhelani jiere bouzhewo.
Gaijiula, bijien zhanshi jiere tanse danxinrase beye danxinrazhoma, zhughe ese danxinrazho. Bijien tai chujiegheku hende duralazho.
Ingiese bi Baolo 1 lianhui tai uzhele echine giese Ibilisi bijienyi duiwo.
Mai Ezhan Ersa pse irekude bijien hhei melie panjiku, bayasuku, kuaighaku jianlishi yan wo? Ta pushonu?
Tashijiu bijienyi kuaiku, bayasuku wo!
Ingiese bijien bazilie dadene goyane Yajiende feilieye giezhi jiejin gie,

Qimotaini tai hhende peizhi echighawo. Hheshi mai gaijiu wo. Bijienre hhantu Mexihani gouxioxii chonjizhi Hudade wilie giesan kun wo. Hhei echighakushi tai khiduzheghazhi xianxin gieku jiere zhichi gieghane giezho.
Ingiese enezighan heiku shiqin dundase tai nieda ulie gojiolughane giezho. Matande heiku shiqin jinjisei ta goyalane mejiene.
Bijien tanre hhantu bikude matande heiku shiqin irekui tande melieshi kieliezhi daowo. Ede qintui gholusei ta mejiene.
Ingiese bi pse bazilie dadene Qimotaini peizhi tai xianxin gieku matugiezho giezhi daqinlaghale echiwo. Hhe miichen tai miizhi bijien khishulasan wilielani belien gholughakuse ayizho.

Ingie Qimotai jian tai hhense iredene tai xianxin gieku, oreku gouxioxini bijiende kieliewo. Da kieliezhi ta chan bijienyi bayasuzhi jilazho. Bijien tai chujieghene gieku mutun taye bijienyi chujieghene giezho.
Ingiese gaijiula, bijiende kunnan, heiku olon biliuzhe ta xianxin giesan yenyin jiere bijien bayasuzho.
Ta Ezhanyi miende beizhi undanlase bijien ede amiturawo.
Bijien mai Hudai melie tai yenyin jiere hende bayasuzho. Eneni Hudade matugie mafan kieliene?
Bijien tai ochirazhi uye kurusan tai xianxin giekuni kurughane giezhi xieni udu Hudai hende xiahua giezho.
Mai Ada Huda, mai Ezhan Ersa moni keighadene bijienyi zhijie tai hhende echigha gie.
Pse bijien tande olon oreku mutun Ezhan tande oreku zhughei ologhan ogizhi durughadene tai nieniedene oregha gie, jien kunladeye oregha gie.
Ingiese zhughei tai khiduzheghazhi mai Ezhan Ersa soyuji shentularene hhantu irekude mai Ada Hudai melie zhiguitu yama kielieku witu gholugha gie.
Ingiese gaijiula, zuihoude kielieye, Ezhan Ersai miende bijien tai xiahua giezhi tande sughazhi kielieye. Ta bijiense surusan mutun Hudai bayasughazhi gie. Ta ijin giezhoma, pse ologhoni izhigie gie.
Bijien Ezhan Ersai qienlighala tande yan minlin ogisei ta mejiene.
Hudai isishi ene wo, tai zhiguini gholughane giezho. Lon kijieku, pse qimutu zuilase gholode beighazhi
jien kunde goya beyene hanshiliezhi ganjin, zhiguide giekuni mejieghane.
Hudai tani dasan niman kun mutun lon gieku nefuxinni daghazhi hu ulie gieghane.
Ene shiqin jiere xianxin giesan gaijiulade piendazhi pienyi bu zhanji. Bijien melieshi tande kieliezhi hende jingao giesan mutun Ezhan qimutu zui fanjisan kunlai faine.
Huda matanyi urukushi ganjin wini bu giezhi, zhiguide gie giezho.
Ingiese ene sughasei ulie chenliechen kunshi kunni ulie chenlieku pusho, tande goya Shenlinne ogisan Hudai uye chenliezho.
Gaijiulade oreku shiqinni kieliese tande xin huaiku biyo uwo. Nieniedene orekuni ta goyane Hudase suruzho.
Ta Maqidunni gaijiulade man shuhua ingiezhi giezho. Gaijiula, bijien tande xiahua gieye, ta pse ologhonni gie.
Bijien tande fenfulasan mutun ta xiacha giezhi udune nanrande daogha. Goya shiqinlane gonji. Khaghalane wilielai gie.
Qingiese ghadanedu kun ta giesanlai uzhese zunzhun giene, taye kiemade ulie kouine.
Gaijiula, bijienyi duranshi hhe fugusan kunlai shiqinni ta mejiese gou wo. Ingiese hhe xiwon wichen kun mutun zhughetai ulie otune.
Matan Ersa duya ijiedene aminne olusanyi xianxin giese Ersai xianxin giedene duya ijiesan kunlai Huda Ersaghala hhantu udurukuiye xianxin giene.
Bijien Ezhanyi kielienyi tande kielieye. Ezhan pse irekude matan amitu kun hhe fugusan kunlase melieshida dane.
Nie minlin xiaise fugie qienxien waradazhi Hudai labai shenqi dunda Ezhan asiman jierese qinsi irene. Ingiekude Mexihani xianxin giedene fugusan kun xien aminne olune.
Ingiedene bijien amitu kunyi hhelare hhantu olien jiere deila echi asiman jiere Ezhanyi ochirane. Ingiedene chanqi Ezhanre hhantu soune.
Ingiese ta enezighan kielienghala nieniedene surughazhi kielie.
Gaijiula, ene shiqin giezhe fashen giekui tande xin huaiku biyo uwo.
Ezhanni udushi ghughei xienidei ireku mutun mejie dakude irekui ta qinchu wo.
Kunla "Pinnan wo, yama shiqin uwo." giezhi kieliekude menzhali hhelade zeinan kuzhi irene. Biereila kewosi olukude otuku niekielien wo. Kiema anda dane.
Gaijiula, ingieseye ta kharanide uwo. Hhe ireku udu tande ghughei mutun ulie irene.
Ta manshi gonni kewosi, uduni kewosi wo. Matanshi xieninughun pusho, kharaninughunye pusho.
Ingiese matan kunla mutun bu hhunturadene goude jinxin gieye.
Hhunturachen kun xienidei hhunturane. Sudochen kun xienidei sudone.
Matanshi udunughun wo, indan jinxin gieye. Xianxin gieku, oreku kuijiani musizhi jiuiku xiwonni toukuini zhoye.
Huda mai sunghuse faine ese giezho. Mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihai tungo giezhi jiuine giezho.
Ersa Mexiha matande oluzhi duya ijiese bugon matan amitu kun, fugusan kun man hheghala hhantu udu daoghane giezho.
Ingiese ta chan gieku mutun nieniedene surughazhi kieliezhi nieniene hendagha.
Gaijiula, bijien tai xiahua gieye, tande oluzhi khishulasan kunlai zunji. Hhela Ezhanyi miende tai gonjizhi sughazho.
Hhela giesan wilieni yenyinghala ta hhelade orezhi goude zunzhun gie. Ta nienierene heqishi.
Gaijiula, bijien pse tande sughazhi kielieye, hhe lansunlade jingao gie, danzi widasan kunlade hunlazhi kielie, zhoreliesan kunlai fei, soyuji kunlade rennai gie.
Ta kienliuzhe ijinyo doghunnide doghunni bu kharei. Nieniedene, ashighalade gouni giekude chan xiacha gie.
Ta chan bayasu,
bu beidene onxian gie,
yan shiqindeliuzhe mafan kielie. Eneshi Mexiha Ersai sudoro tande olusan Hudai isi wo.
Shenlinni wiliei bu danla.
Hudai kielienyi kieliese uzhezhi bu xinie.
Yandeliuzhe shiizhi uzhe, gounii barei,
shiheni doghunnise gholode bei.
Pinnan ogisan Huda qinsi tai zhengiejia zhiguitu gholugha gie. Mai Ezhan Ersa Mexiha irekude tai ruhher, jinshen, beyei man bouizhi yama kieliekui widagha gie.
Tai urusanshi kekaoni wo. Hhe ijinyo chenjighane.
Gaijiula, bijiende oluzhi onxian gie.
Zhughesene jien gaijiulade kielien asa.
Bi Ezhanyi niereghala tande minlin xiaiye. Ene xinni soyuji gaijiulade man onshizhi chenliegha.
Mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihai nenjien tanre hhantu bi gie!
2 Qiesalonijia
Baolo, Seila, Qimotai ghurulie mai Ada Huda, Ezhan Ersa Mexihai miendedu Qiesalonijiai jiohuide xin huaizho.
Mai Ada Huda, Ezhan Ersa Mexiha tande nenjien, pinnan ogi gie!
Gaijiula, bijien tande oluzhi Hudade chan mafan kieliese indanji wo. Tai xianxin gieku zhughe fugiedazhi, nieniedene oreku zhugheye olodozho.
Bijien Hudai jiohuilade tai kuaizhi kieliezho. Ta olon heiku, kunnanni penjikude rennai giezho, xianxin giekuni goude bareizho.
Eneshi Huda gundande panjikui zhenmin giezho. Hudai gojiade oluzhi tai shouku gieghazhi Hudai gojiade peighane giezho.
Hudashi gundanni wo. Tai biisan kunlai Huda biikughala bouin giene.
Ta shouku giesan kunlai bijienre hhantu pinnanshighane. Ezhan Ersa nenlitu qienxienghalane asiman jierese khan dunda xienjikude
Hudai tani dasan kun, mai Ezhan Ersani gouxioxini ulie shunjichen kunlai faine.
Ezhan enelai faizhi meliesene, famatu nenlisene likai gieghadene chanqi widaghane.
Ezhan ireku hhe udude hhei shentula, jien xianxin giesan kunla man hhei ghudure wo giezhi kuaine. Taye hhelai dunda wine. Bijien ganzhen beisanyi ta xianxin giewo.
Enende oluzhi bijien tande chan onxian giezho. Mai Huda tai urusan mujide tai peigha gie. Huda nenlighalane tai gounide olusan duran, pse xianxin giekughala giesan wilielani man chengun olugha gie.
Ingiese mai Ezhan Ersai niere zhao mai Huda, Ezhan Ersa Mexihai nenjienghala tai jiere famashine, taye hhei jiere famashine.
Gaijiula, mai Ezhan Ersa Mexiha pse irekude, matan hhei melie hhantulakude oluzhi tai xiahua giezhi kielieye.
Ezhanni udu ijin kuzhewo giezhi kunla kieliese ta suibien bu gojioluzhi bu jinda. Hhelade kenen Shenlin mejieghazho, loushila jianjizho, pse shitulai xin wo giezhi maochun giene.
Hhela yan banfaghala piendaliuzhe goyane bu piendagha. Hhe uduse melie panjio gieku shiqin wine. Pse zuihoude widaku hhe fugie zuitu xienjizhi khizhene.
Hhe irese kunla huda wo giezhi urusanlase, kunla beiisan shihenilase duizhi goyane hhelase fugiede uzhene, da mechide souzhi goyane Huda wo giene.
Bi tanre hhantu bikude kieliesan ene shiqinlani ta jila danu?
Ede hhe fugie zuituni yan duisei ta mejiene. Shihouni kuzhese hhei xienjizhi khizheghane.
Hhe fugie zuitu ijin jizide wilie giezho. Duisan hhe widatula ingiezhi giene.
Ingiedene hhe fugie zuitu xienji khizhene. Ezhan Ersa amanne hoghala hhei widaghane, ireku gonqighala hhei fugughane.
Hhe fugie zuitu irese Ibilisini wiliei giezhi yanyanji nenlitu shiqin, ghudureqi, jia fugie shiqin giene.
Pse widaku kunlai jiere yanyanji gou wini piendaku shiqinlai giene. Enela jiuiku zhendaode xiqi wizhi ese jienliezho.
Ene yenyin jiere Huda hhelade codaku zhughe olon ogizhi jiani xianxin gieghawo.
Ingiedene zhendaoni xianxin uye giezhi gou winide xiqi bisan hhe kunlade man zui jinjine.
Ezhan oresan gaijiula, tande oluzhi bijien Hudade chan mafan kieliekuni wo. Huda eqighanse tai sunghuzhi Shenlinghala zhiguishighadene zhendaoni xianxin gieghazhi tai jiuiwo.
Bijien chonjisan gouxioxighala Huda tai uruzhi jiuiwo. Ingiese mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihani famai tande ireghane giezho.
Ingiese gaijiula, ta beizhi undanla. Bijien kielien, xinghala tande sughasan daolini ta goude barei.
Mai Ezhan Ersa Mexiha goyane, matande orezhi nenjienghalane mai chanqi sidaghazhi kieliesan, pse gou xiwon ogisan mai Ada Hudaghala
tai sidaghazhi kielie gie. Pse ta shiheni gou wilie giezhi gou kielien kieliekude tande nenli ogi gie.
Gaijiula, zuihoude kielieye, ta bijiende ingiezhi onxian gie, tai dundashiku mutun Ezhanyi kielienyi gochude ghujighan chonji keidene famashigha gie.
Mouxien kun, doghun kunlase bijienyi jiui gie. Ene xinyanshi dajianughun pusho.
Ezhanshi kekaoni wo, tai khiduzheghazhi doghunnise bouine.
Bijien Ezhanyi miende tai xianxin giezho. Bijien tande fenfulasanyi ta giezho, ihouye giene.
Ezhan tai zhughei uduruzhi Hudai orekude, Mexihani rennai giekude echigha gie!
Gaijiula, mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihani niereghala tande minlin xiaiye, langande giezhi bijien chonjisan daolini ulie zunjisan gaijiulase gholodo.
Bijienyi daghazhi indan matui giekuni ta goyane mejiene. Bijien tai dunda bikude langanrazhi ese giezho.
Kunlai budanyi belien ese ijiezho. Tande achan ulie ogine giezhi xieni udu wilie giezhi khishulazhi ku shouizho.
Eneshi bijiende qienli wikuni pusho, taye bijien mutun gie giezhi bijien tande yanzi uzheghawo.
Bijien tai hhende bikude kien wilie ulie giene giese budan bu ijie giezhi tande minlin xiaizhi daowo.
Bijien chenliese tai dunda niezhan kunla langanrazhi wilie ulie giene. Da ulie gonjiku shiqinyi gonjine.
Bijien Ezhan Ersa Mexihani miende ene izhun kunlade minlin xiaizhi sughazhi kielieye, undande wilie giezhi goya budanne ijie.
Gaijiula, ta gouni giekude zhughene bu sularagha.
Kien bijienni ene xin jieredu kielienyi ulie chenliese hhei zhiidene laiwon bu giezhi shizhegha.
Ingieliuzhe hhei duitou bu danlagha. Gaijiune mutun uzhezhi sughazhi kielie.
Pinnan ogisan Ezhan qinsi yan shiqindeliuzhe suishisui tande pinnan ogi gie. Ezhan chan ta ashighalare hhantu bi gie!
Bi Baolo qinsi huaizhi kielien asazho. Mini alinie xin jiereliuzhe bi nierene ingiezhi huaizhi hao giezho.
Mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihani nenjien tanre man hhantu bi gie!
1 Qimotai
Mai jiuichen Huda, matan xiwon giesan Mexiha Ersai minlinyi zunjizhi Mexiha Ersade shitu danlasan Baolo
xinyan jiere made zhenzhen kewon danlasan Qimotaide xin huaizho. Huda Ada, mai Ezhan Mexiha Ersa chade nenjien, ubali xiiku, pinnan ogi gie!
Bi Maqidunde echikude chade goude fenfulazhi Ifusode feilieghakushi niezhan kunla psedu daolii surughase bu surugha giezho.
Pse yama genzi witu guhuade, ulie baraku xienrenlai niere jilasande hhelai izhigie bu miigha giezho. Ene shiqinlade zi jianjindune, xinyanghala chengun oluku Hudai jihuade yama zoin uwo.
Bi surughasan daolini mujishi oreku wo. Ene orekushi ganjin zhughe, gou lianxin, jia witu xinyanse khizhezho.
Niezhan kunla enezighanse wiruladene yama biyo witu jianjindukude echiwo.
Hhela jinwun loushi danlane giezhoma, goya yan kieliesanne ulie mejiene, kenjin giezhi ijien qilasanneye ulie mejiene.
Guijinni heshide injise gouni bikui matan mejiene.
Guijinni gou kunde ese jinjizho. Mouxien kun, kielienyi ulie chenliechen, zhigui witu, zui fanjichen, zannanni giechen, hharamu giechen, ana adane alachen, kun alachen,
lon kijiechen, tunxinlien giechen, kun huichen, ghudan kieliechen, jiani fayen giechen, pse olusan daolini duizhi yanyanji giechen kunlade jinjizho.
Ene olusan daolishi famatu gouxioxise iresan wo. Enei indan doulaku Huda made jiuizhi ogiwo.
Made nenli ogisan mai Ezhan Mexiha Ersade bi mafan kieliezho. Hhe mii xianxin giedene nanpei giezhi goyadene wilie gieghazho.
Eqighandei bishi Mexihai sugiechen, heichen, qifulachen wo. Ingieliuzhe Huda made ubali xiikushi bi xianxin ese giekude mejie dazhi giezho.
Mai Ezhan made nenjien texien olon ogizho. Ingiese Mexiha Ersai miende made xinyan, oreku olodozhi moizho.
Mexiha Ersa duyade zuirenlani jiuile irewo giesan ene kielienyi xianxin giezhi man jienliekughon wine. Bishi zuiren dunda zui mouxienni wo.
Eneshi Ezhan made ubali xiisan yenyin wo. Mexiha Ersa bi ene zui mouxien kunni jiere hende rennai giezhi yanzi uzheghakushi khuinashi xianxin giechen kunlade chanqiku amin ogine.
Hhe chanqiku Honshan, ulie fuguku, chanla daku, zi niekozi Hudade zhigui, kuaikui chanqi izhi ogi. Amine!
Mii kewon Qimotaiya, zhao melieshida kunla Hudai kielienyi deilazhi chade kieliesan mutun bi ene minlinni chade ogiye. Hhe kielienghala gou zhan eghi.
Xinyanne goude bareizhi lianxin bu ghudanduzhi zhan eghi. Niezhan kunla lianxinne ghudandudene xinyanni ghaluwo.
Hhelai dunda Ximinai, Yalishanda wo. Bi hhelai ijin Ibiliside jiuiwo. Ingiese hhelai kufurei ulie fanjikuni surughane giezho.
Ingiese bi chade sughazhi kielieye. Xien soyuji kunlade oluzhi xiahua giezhi onxian gie. Deilazhi kunlade qitao giezhi Hudade mafan kielie.
Honshanlade, qienli bichen kunlade ingiezhi gie. Ingiese matan xienliande donzhende giezhi nanran pinnande udu dao shidane.
Eneshi gouni wo. Mai jiuichen Huda bayasune.
Hhe kunlai man jiuizhi zhendaoi mejieghaku duran wine.
Hudashi nie wo. Huda, kunghalai dundaye zinie dundadu kun wo. Hheshijiu Mexiha Ersa wo, kunye enbene.
Hhe soyuji kunlade oluzhi goyane shuiku jiage danlawo. Heshini shihou kuzhese ene shiqinde zhenmin giewo.
Ene shiqinde oluzhi mii nanpei giezhi chonjichen kun, shitu danlaghazho. Niman kunlade loushi danlaghazhi xinyan, zhendaoni surughazho. Eneshi ghudan pusho, shuhua wo.
Ingiese mii xiwonshi ere kunla hokuzhi bu jianjindudene zhiguitu khane zhadeighazhi alinie orondeliuzhe onxian gie.
Oqitu kunlaye heshighan dabala. Shizherezhi jinchende musi. Usunne bienjizhi antan, zhubaoghala, fugie jiagetu jienghala bu dabala.
Goyane gouni giekughala dabala. Ingiezhi giese goyane Hudai zunjine giezhi kieliesan oqitu kunlade heshi wo.
Oqitu kunla indan goude shunjizhi nanrande surukuni wo.
Oqitu kunla surughane, ere kunyi gonjine giese bi tunyi uwo. Oqitu kunla indan nanranshigha.
Bi ingiezhi kieliekushi Huda xien Adanyi zhayaghadene Hhawai zhayaghawo.
Miisanshi Adan pusho, biereini miidene zui dunda oroghawo.
Ingieliuzhe oqitu kunla goyane guizhi xianxin gieku, oreku, zhiguini izhi giese kewosi laizhi jiuine.
Kien jiohuini lindao danlaku duralase gou wilieni neiizho. Ene kielien oluzho.

Lindao danlachen kun goyane kunlai yama ulie kielieghane, zi niekozi biereide zhanguiji danlane, goyane kunzhi giene, jinxin giene, kunla man zunzhun giene, zhochenlai goude jienliene, kunlade goude surughane,
jiugui ulie danlane, kun ulie eghine, renyi wo, kunlaghala ulie zhenjindune, baerni ulie neiine,
giene goude gonjizhi kesilane yan shiqindeliuzhe goude zunzhun gieghazhi shunjighane.
Nie kun giene gonji ulie mejiese Hudai jiohuini matugie guine?
Munie xianxin giesan kun lindao danlase ulie olukushi goyane fugiede uzhedene Ibilisini faiku dunda orokuse ayizho.
Lindao danlase ghadaneshiku kun dundaseye gou minshen kerene. Ingiese kunlai ulie sugieghane, Ibilisini onde ulie oroghane.
Jiohuide gonjia danlane giechen kunye niekielien wo. Hhei kunla zunjine, ghudan ulie kieliene, jiu hende ulie ochine, baerni tanxin ulie giene,
gou lianxinghala xinyanni mimii goude bareine.
Ene kunlai xien shiizhi uzhene. Kunla yama kieliekui uwoshi cai gonjia danlaghane.
Biereilaye niekielien wo. Hhelai kunla zunjine, hhela xienhua ulie kieliene, goyane kunzhi giene, yan shiqindeliuzhe shixinde giene.
Gonjia danlachen kun nie biereide zhanguiji danlazhi kesilane, gielane goude gonjikuni wo.
Gonjiani wiliei goude giesan kun gou minshende khireine. Pse Mexiha Ersani xianxin gieku xinyan jiere danzi fugiedane.
Bi chii hhende eqighan ireku duran winema, ene xinni chade huaise
bi udazhi ireliuzhe Hudai giede matugie giekui mejiene. Ene gieshi chanqiku Hudai jiohui, zhendaoni tuhua, jichu wo.

Matanyi xinyanni mimi chijia wo. Enende yama kieliekuni uwo. Hhe kunni beyeghala khizhewo. Shenlin ganzhen beizhi hheshi gundanni wo giezho. Qienxienla hhei chanlawo. Hhei olon minzulade chonjidene Duyani kunla xianxin giewo. Famani dunda jienlie khireiwo.
Ihou kuse kunla miiku ruhherni, sheitan surughakuni daghazhi xinyanse likai giene giezhi Shenlin mindamin kieliezho.
Ene sughakushi ghudanchii jianise irezho. Ene izhun kunlai lianxinshi qiemughala shirasan niekielien wo.
Hhela bierei bu agi, oqin bu dafala giezho. Niezhan ijiekulai bu ijie giezhoma, ijiunishi Huda zhayaghasan wo. Zhendaoni xianxin giezhi minbai olusan kunla Hudade mafan kieliedene ijiekuni wo.
Huda zhayaghasanshi man gouni wo, Hudade mafan kieliedene jienliese ulie kerekuni nieda uwo.
Hudai kielienji onxian giekughala zhiguishizho.
Chi ene shiqinlai gaijiulade surughase xinyanni daoli jiere, chi daghasan gou daoli jiere fugiedazhi Mexiha Ersai gou hoji gholune.
Duyani bixin kielien, yama ibari witu chonjisan kielienlase pii. Hudai miende zhughene donlien gie.
Beyedene donlien giese haochu choghon woma, Hudai miende donlien giese gofanmiende haochu olon wo. Duyade gouni ogine, houshideye gouni ogine giesan
ene kielienshi shuhua wo, ashighala jienliekughan wine.
Enende oluzhi matan khishulazhi xiacha giezho. Ingiekushi mai xiwon chanqiku Hudade wo. Hheshi soyuji kunlai jiuichen, tebieshi xianxin giesan kunlai jiuichen wo.
Chi enezighan shiqinlai kunlade fenfulazhi surugha.
Chi nasunchighanshi kunlai meilade bu uzhegha. Kielien kielieku, gieku, oreku, xinyan, ganjin fanmiende xianxin giechen kunlade yanzi uzhegha.
Bi iretula chi libai giekude jinwunni kunlade onshiku, jianjiku, surughakuni xiacha gie.
Huda chade ogisan nenjienni suibiende bu uzhe. Ene mureshi zhanlaola chii jiere khane teizhi onxian giekude Hudai kielienyi deilazhi ogisan wo.
Enezighan shiqinlade zhughene teizhi goughande giedene goyane hendasanyi ashighalade uzhegha.
Chi goyane xioxin gie, kunlade surughakuniye xioxin gie. Chi enelai izhi zhazhen giezhi giese chi, chii kielienyi chenliesan kunlai man jiuine.
Oqio kunlai hende bu kielie. Goya adane wo giezhi goude kielie. Nasuchighan kunlai goya jiune mutun kielie.
Oqiolusan biereilai anane mutun kielie. Nasunchighan oqitu kunlai eghechijiune mutun zhughene ganjinde teizhi goude kielie.
Yama witu guafulai laba giezhi zhaogu gie.
Guafude kewon sunzi bise xien giedene xioshun olukui sughazhi ada anane qinni beigha. Eneshi Hudai bayasughakui wo.
Yama witu guafula Hudade kouizhi xieni udu onxian gienema,
hhe zhonmun xianshou giesan guafula amitu woma, fugusan niekielien wo.
Chi ene shiqinlai hhelade fenfulazhi hhelade yama kielieku witui gholugha.
Kun qingune ulie gonjizhi tebieshi giene ulie gonjise xinyanni bendazho, xianxin ulie giesan kunde dou ulie kune.
Guafui denji giese nasunni bixishi 60 olune, nie ere kunde bierei danlasanni sanane.

Pse gou wilieni giesan zhenji kerene. Bilazhi kieliese, kesilai laizhi fugiedaghawo, zhochenlai jienliewo, Hudai xianxin giesan kunlai konni waghazhi ushilawo, kunnan penjisan kunlade banman giewo, yanyanji gou wiliede lilian khighawo.
Nasunchighan guafulade denji giezhi bu ogi. Enelade nefuxin Mexihade orekuse olodose loujide khireine giene.
Ingiese hhelade zui jinjikushi deiqikude yenjisan kielienne bendazho.
Pse hhela go gielade han toreizhi langan xigon gholuwo. Zinie langanraku pusho, da xienhua kieliezhi ulie gonjiku shiqinyi gonjine, ulie kielieku kielienlaiye kieliene.
Ingiese mii duranshi nasuchighan biereila jiehun giedene kewosi oluzhi gie lai. Duitou matai sugiekuni ereizhi bu olu gie.
Ede niezhan guafula ijin guidaose khireidene Ibilisini daghawo.
Xianxin giesan biereilani jiawude guafu bise jiohuide achan bu ogi. Ingiese yama wiku guafude jiohui banman gie shidane.
Jiohuini goude gonjisan zhanlaoni indan shonpeide zunjikuni wo. Yuqishi xinku giezhi daoli jianjisanlade, sughasanlade genjia giekuni wo.
Enei jinwun jiere kieliezho, "Fughe tughon yanchikude zuilun bu zhogha." Pse kieliezho, "Wiliechi gunzi bareise indanji wo."
Zhanlaoni zhase ghua ghuran kunni zhenjii kere, pse bu jienlie.
Kien zui fanjise dajialai melie kheila. Ingiese psedu kunlaye ayine.
Bi Huda, Mexiha Ersa, sunghusan qienxienlai melie tai goude fenfulaye. Enezighan kielienlai pienxin bu giezhi goude zunji. Yan shiqin giese gundande gie.
Khane teidene onxian giezhi zhanlao xienjikude suibiende bu gie. Kunla fanzui giekude bu hhantula. Goyane ganjinde bei.
Chii wide oluzhi pse chan giemerekude oluzhi gon usu bu ochidene jiuye gouji ochi.
Niezhan kunlai zui minxien wo, xien panjine. Niezhan kunlai zui khuinashi cai xienjighazhi khizhene.
Niekielien wo. Gou wilielaye minxien wo. Minxien uwoliuzhe niuigha dane.
Hoji danlasan kunla man loubanne zhughesene goude zunjikuni wo. Pse Hudai nierei, matan sughasan daolii kunla sugiene.

Hhei loubanshi xianxin giesei enbese gaijiu wo giezhi meilade uzhese ulie olune. Khareizhi genjia goude zunji. Qingiezhi goude giese xianxin giesan kunlade, oresan gaijiulade haochu wine. Enezighanni chi kunlade goude kieliezhi sugha.
Kien mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihani gou kielienni, xienliantu daolini ulie jienliezhi pseshiku daolini chonjise
hhe goyane fugiede uzhezhi yama ulie mejiene, zhonmun uroui asazhi jianjindukude xiqi wo. Ingiese dubiliene, jianjindune, beimiende sugiene, hu inxin giene.
Hhelai zhughe fuzhi sudoroni zhendao uwo, izhi ulie beidene onghonodune. Hhela jiomunni baer zhenjiku banfa danlaghazho.
Ingiezhoma, kun zhigan giese jiomunshi haochu fugieni wo.
Matan duyade yama agizhi ese irezho, fuguseye yama agizhi echi dane.
Matande ijieku musikui bise indan zhigan giekuni wo.
Facailane giesan kunlai miizhi onde orone. Yanyanji bixin, heiku duranla hhelai miidene qida oluku, barakude anda bouwo.
Baerni tanxin giekushi shiheni doghunni genzi wo. Kunla baerde oluzhi xinyanse likai giedene yanyanjide munan giezhi zhugheni hende otuzho.
Ingiezhoma, chishi Hudai kun wo, enezighan shiqinlase piidene gouni, xienlian, xinyan, oreku, rennai, renyini dagha.
Chi xinyandene gou zhan eghizhi goyadene chanqiku aminni barei. Chii zhen enende urusei wo. Chi olon ganzhen beisan kunlai melie ene xinyanni goude chenren giewo.
Bi soyujilade amin ogisan Hudai melie, Benjiu-Biladode goude ganzhen beisan Mexiha Ersai melie chii fenfulaye.
Chi mai Ezhan Ersa Mexiha pse xienjighatula ene minlinyi onqiende zunjizhi yama kheilaku witui gholugha.
Heshini shihou kuzhese hhe indan doulakuni, zinie qienli winetu, honshan dundadu Honshan, ezhan dundadu Ezhan Mexiha Ersai xienjighazhi uzheghane.
Zinie hhe ibeizi ulie fugune, kun shigha daku gon dunda souzho. Kiema hhei chujieghezhi ese daozho, ye chujieghe dane. Zunzhun gieku, pse chanqiku qienlini hhende ogi. Amine!
Chi ene duya jieredu bayan kunlai fenfulazhi goyane fugiede bu uzhe gie. Undan witu baerni bu koui, zinie shihenii zhengiejia olonde ogizhi mai xianshou gieghasan Hudade koui gie.
Pse hhelai gouni giegha. Gou shiqinyi olon giegha. Dafande giezhi chan kunlade ogi gie.
Ingiese goyadene oluzhi jianlaide boubei sunjizhi undan jichu daidene zhenzhenji aminyi barei shidane.
Qimotaiya, chade kouisanlai chi goude baohu gie. Pse duyani ibari witu kielienlase, goyane zhendaoi mejiene giezhi jianjindukulase pii.
Niezhan kunla imutui daghadene xinyanse wirulawo. Hudai nenjien tanre hhantu bi gie!
2 Qimotai
Hudai isighala Mexiha Ersade shitu danladene Mexiha Ersa dain giesan aminde oluzhi wilie giesan Baolo
oresan Qimotai kewondene xin huaizho. Ada Huda, mai Ezhan Mexiha Ersa chade nenjien, ubali xiiku, pinnan, ogi gie!
Bi xieni udu onxian giekude ese beidene chii sumulazhi Hudade mafan kieliezho. Hheshi bi xienrenlane mutun gou lianxinghala beiisan Huda wo.
Chi wilasan nughusunyi bi sumula irese hende chii chujiegheku duran wo. Ingiese bi hende bayasune.
Chii zhenzhenji xinyanni bi jila irezho. Ene xinyanshi chii wineinei Loi, anachii Yunijini zhughenughun wo, chii zhughede bikui bi hende xianxin giezho.
Ene yenyin jiere bi chii qixin gieye. Bi khane chii jiere teizhi onxian giekude Huda ogisan nenjienni khan mutun ondagha.
Ingiekushi Huda matande ayiku zhughe ese ogizho, nenli, oreku, goyane gonjiku zhughe ogizho.
Ingiese chi mai Ezhande ganzhen beizhi bi Ezhanyi yenyin jiere fanren gholuse shizhene bu gie. Matan Hudai nenlighala gouxioxide hhantu shouku gieye.
Huda mai jiuizhi zhiguide urukushi matan giesanghala pusho, hhe goya jihua, nenjienghalane giesan wo. Ene nenjienshi Mexiha Ersai tungo giezhi duyai zhayaghasanse melie matande ogisan wo,
ede mai jiuichen Mexiha Ersa irese man mejieghawo. Hhe fugukui widaghazhi gouxioxighala ulie fuku aminni qinchude mejieghawo.
Ene gouxioxide oluzhi mii peizhi chonjichen, shitu, loushi danlaghawo.

Ene yenyin jiere bi enezighan kui shouizhoma, shizhene ulie giene. Ingiekushi bi kiende kouisanne mejiene. Pse hhe niudu kurutula bi hhende jiuizhi ogisei hhe baohu gie shidakui bi hende xianxin giezho.
Chi Mexiha Ersai tungo giezhi iresan xinyan, oreku zhugheghala mase chenliesan olusan daolini yanzi mutun gie.
Chi mai sudoro sousan Shenlinghala chade jiuizhi ogisan boubeini ghurazhi goudagha.
Yaxiya kunla man mii benda jiesei chi mejiene. Hhelai dunda Feijilu, Heimoqini wine.
Ezhan Anisefui nie gie kunde ubali xii gie. Hhe mii zhughei chan bayasughazho. Mii jieliughala sozilase ye ese shizhezho.
Da Lomade bikude mii hende ereidene ereizhi oluwo.
Ezhan hhe udude hhende ubali xii gie. Hhe Ifusode matugiezhi mii ologhonni ushilasei chi qinchu wo.
Ingiese mii kewonya, chi Mexiha Ersai nenjien jiere khiduzhe.
Chi olon ganzhen beisan kunlai melie mase chenliesanlai kekaoji kunlade jiuizhi ogizhi pse hhela kunlade surugha gie.
Chi Mexiha Ersade hen budui danlazhi mare hhantu ku shoui.
Kien budui danlase goya shiqinghalane jiohoro ulie gieghazhi hhei budui danlaghasan kunyi bayasughane.
Kien bisai giekude zhao guijinzhe ulie giese ji 1 min danla dane.
Khishulasan zhonjia kun indan xien taranni ghurane.
Bi kieliesan kielienlai goude sumula. Ezhan chade yan shiqindeliuzhe agheli ogine.
Ersa Mexihai jila. Hheshi fugusan kun dundase aminne olusan wo, Dawudeni houdei wo. Eneshi bi chonjisan gouxioxi wo.
Bi ene gouxioxide oluzhi fanren mutun mii banlazhi ku shouiwo. Ingieliuzhe Hudai daolii banla dane.
Ingiese Huda sunghusan kunlade Ersa Mexihase iresan jiuiku, chanqiku famai ireghane giese bi yandeliuzhe rennai giezho.
Ene kielienshi zhenzhenji xianxin giekuni wo, "Matan hhere hhantu fuguse hhere hhantu aminne olune.
Matan rennai giese hhere hhantu honshan danlane. Matan hhei ulie tanise hheye mai ulie tanine.
Matan kekao uwoliuzhe hhe dou kekao wo. Hhe goyane ghudandu dane."
Chi enezighan shiqinlai hhelade qixin gie. Kielien jiere bu jianjindu giezhi Hudai melie hhelade fenfula. Ene yama haochu uwo, zi chenliesan kunlai qida olughane.
Chi xiacha giezhi yama shizhekui wizhi Huda chenren giesan wiliechi gholu. Zhendaoni ulie codaghazhi goude jianji.
Yama genzi witu duyani kielienlase gholodo. Ene izhun kielien kunlai yebeiseye Hudase gholodoghane.
Hhelai kielien neizhen niekielien wo, yefuseye fugiedane. Hhelai dunda Ximinai, Feilitu wine.
Hhela aminne olusan shiqin daowo giezhi kieliedene zhendaose wirulawo. Ingiezhi ezighan kunlai xianxin giesei qida olughawo.
Ingieliuzhe Hudai khidun jichu tashi undan wo. Jiereni, "Ezhan kienshi hhenughun bikui mejiene." pse, "Kien Ezhanyi nierei waradase gou winise likai gie." giezhi huaizho.
Bayan giede injisan ighalashi gon antan, miengughala giesan pusho, muzha, wazhaghala gieseiye wine. Niezhanlai zhunyonide injine, niezhanlai ibannide injine.
Kien goyane ganjinrazhi enezighan doghunnilase likai giese guizhunni igha gholune. Zhiguitu gholughazhi danxin jiese Ezhan injise heshi wo, yanyanji gou shiqin giekude zhunbei giene.
Chi nasuchighan kunni nefuxinni piizhi ganjin zhugheghala Ezhanse waradachen kunlare hhantu gundanni, xinyanni, orekuni, heqini dagha.
Yama ulie mejieku benni jianjindukuse gholodo. Ene zinen kunni jianjinduzhi hendaghane.
Ezhanni hojila ulie jianjindukuni wo. Indan jien kunlade renyide duidai giezhi goude surughazhi rennai giekuni wo.
Fandui giesan kunde renyide sughakuni wo. Ingiese kenen Huda hhelade geizhen gieku zhughe ogise zhendaoni mejiene.
Ibilisi bareidene Ibilisini kielienyi chenliesan hhela xiereidene Ibilisini onse andane.
Duya barakude chijia shihou kuzhekui chi mejie.
Hhe shihoude kunla zi goyane guine, baerni neiine, goyane kuaizhi fugiede uzhene, suibiende sugiene, ana adane kielienyi ulie chenliene, kunlai gouni matane, xienlian witui giene,
zhughede orekui uwo, kunlai ulie rouliene, doghun kielienghala beimiende kieliene, goyane kunzhi ulie giene, yedou no wo, gouni giekude xiqi uwo,
kunlai ghudandune, ulie sumulazhi hu giene, goyane bi wo giezhi undude uzhene, hu nadukude Hudase olon orene,
jiomunni gieku yanzi winema, jiomunni nenlii chenren ulie giene. Chi imutu kunlase gholodo.
Hhelai dunda kunlai giede zhomuji oro naozi witu biereilai shunjighachen kun wine. Ene izhun biereila zuini beiliezhi yanyanji nefuxin hhelai miizho.
Hhela chan suruzhoma, izhi zhendaoni minbai olu dane.
Eqighandei Yani, Yanbighala matugiezhi Musai duiku mutun enezighan kunlaye qingiezhi zhendaoni duizho. Hhelai zhughe qida oluwo, xinyannishiye jiani wo.
Ingieliuzhe hhelanughun chenji dane. Hhelai benni hhe ghua kun mutun olon kunlai melie khizhene.
Ede bi surughasan, bi gieku yanzi, mii ibeiku fanxian, xinyan, rennai gieku, oreku, khidunde beiku,
da bi Anqiya, Igenien, Lusidede shouisan kui, mii heisan shiqinlai chi man uzhezhi mejiewo. Mii heisan zhenzhenji fugie wo! Ingieliuzhe Ezhan mii enelase jiuizhi likai gieghawo!
Shijishan Mexiha Ersai sudoro xienliande udu daone giesan kunla man heikuni shouine.
Doghun kun, piendachen kun yebeiseye doghunshine. Hhela kunlai piendazho, kunlaye hhelai piendane.
Ingieliuzhe chi surusanne, xianxin giesanne goude barei. Chade surughasan kunlai chi qinchu wo,
pse chi gaxienzise zhiguitu jinwunni mejiene. Ene jinwun chi Mexiha Ersai xianxin giese jiuiku hhe aghelii ogine.
Jinwunshi man Huda kunyi zhughei gojiolughazhi gieghasan wo. Kunlade surughakude, kheilakude, geizhen gieghakude, olusanyi gieghakude zoin wine.
Ingiezhi giese Hudai kunni hen kun gholughazhi yanyanji gou wilie giekude zhunbei gieghane.
Hudai melie, jianlai amitu kun, fugusan kunyi panjiku Mexiha Ersai melie, pin Ersa xienjiku, pse hhei qienlighala chade hende fenfulaye.
Chi Hudai kielienyi chonji. Shihou heshi winu uwoliuzhe izhigie gie. Kunlade sughakude hende rennai giezhi geizhen giegha, kheila, pse sughazhi kielie.
Ingiezhi kieliekushi hhe shihou kuzhese kunla olusan daolini ulie chenliedene duranghalane goya chenlieku xiqi bitu kielienyi jianjiku loushilai ereizhi olodoghane.
Dou zhendaoi ulie chenliezhi kharei hu kieliesan guhuani daghane.
Ingieliuzhe chi yandeliuzhe jinshenshighan, ku shouikuse bu ayi, gouxioxii chonjichen kunyi wiliei giezhi goya renwune onchen gie.
Ede mii Hudade khughone giezhi zhunbei giezho, duyase likai gieku ghujinlazho.
Bi nie gou zhan ijin eghiwo, holuku moni holu baraghawo, xinyanniye izhi bareizho.
Ede gundanni jianlii made liuizho. Gundanghala panjiku Ezhan hhe udude made ogine. Zinie made ogikui pusho, Hhe pse xienjikui panjichen kunladeye ogine.
Chi jinlianji ghujighan mii enende ire.
Jima duyani shei dazhi mii benda jiedene Qiesalonijiade echiwo. GeleshiJialataide echiwo. QidoDamataide echiwo.
Zinie Lujia bighala hhantu wo. Chi irekude Makei uduru ire. Hhe bi chonjiku wiliede zoin wine.
Bi Tuijigui peizhi Ifusode echighawo.
Chi irekude Teloyani Jiabuni giede bi jiesan jienyimi, pse hhezighan shu, tebieshi hhe ghoni arasun shulai agidei ire.
Tun giesan kun Yalishanda olon doghun shiqin giezhi mii heiwo. Ezhan zhao hhe giesan mutun hhende bouin giene.
