Ghazhade eghesun, osun osise yama zoin widazho, kharaku ghujinlazhi zuihoude siderane.
Bijienyi orentula, ingiezhi kieliezhoma, tai qinkonla goudazhi jiuikuse chadashisei bijien hende xianxin giezho.
Hudashi gundan wituni pusho. Ta giesan wilie, pse hhei nierede oluzhi oresanlai ese matazho. Eneshi ta eqighandei shentulai zhaogu giezhi edeliuzhe ushilazho.
Bijien xiwon giese ta kienliuzhe panjisanla man gholutula niekielienji rexinde giezhi zuihoude kuru.
Ingiese ta ulie langanshizhi hhezighan xianxin giedene rennai giezhi dain giesanyi jienliesan kunlanughunyi surune.
Huda Iburaheimude dain giekude goyasene fugienii zhiizhi fayen giekui uwoshi goyane zhiizhi fayen giezhi kieliewo,
Bi ijinyo chade fuqi olon ogizhi houdeilaichii hende olodoghane.
Ingiese Iburaheimu oloncha rennai giedene dain giesei jienliewo.
Kun fayen giekude goyasene fugienii zhiizhi fayen giene. Ene fayenyi ganzhen beighazhi soyuji zhenjindusei widaghane.
Hhezighan dain giesei jienliesan kunlade Huda goya isine ibeizi ulie bienjighakui pse qinchude mejieghane giezhi dain giedene pse fayen giezhi bouzhen giewo.
Ene ghua shiqin ulie bienjine. Huda ghudan ulie kieliene. Ingiese matan Hudai miende piile iresan kunla hende bayasuzhi melie beilasan xiwonni goude barei shidane.
Matande bisan ene xiwon hoxian matanyi ruhherde olusan chon beighaku gougoui xianli, khidunji undan wo. Dajienyi sudorodu menlienzi sudoro matanyi oroghane.
ErsaMaijixide mutun chanqiku zui fugie buwa gholudene matande oluzhi tou 1 giede sudorodu menlienzi sudoro orowo.
Ene Maijixideshi Salenni honshan wo, pse Zui Undu Hudai buwa wo. Iburaheimu honshanlai eghi injidene khareizhi irekude Maijixide hhei jienliezhi gouni kieliezho.
Iburaheimu eghinduzhi zhanjisan soyujilasene ushireini hhende ogizho. Maijixidei niereni tou 1 gie isishi gundan honshan wo, pse Salen honshan wo, jiushi pinnantu honshan wo.
Hhende ada, ana jiawu uwo. Hhei aminde qiorun, uzhu uwo. Hhe Hudai kewonyi xianli, chanqi buwa danlazho.
Ta nie sumula, ene kun matu fama wo! Famatu xienren Iburaheimu qianlazhi iresanne ushireini hhende ogiwo.
Liwini houdei dunda buwa danlachen kunla bexinlase ushirei ghura giezhi guijinde minlin ogizho. Ene bexinshi Iburaheimuse khizhesan hhelai gaijiuliuzhe buwala hhelase yen qingiezhi ghurazhoma,
Maijixideshi hhelare nie jiawu pusho, khareidene Iburaheimuse ushirei ghurazhi Hudai dainni jienliesan Iburaheimude onxian giezho.
Fugieni ganide onxian giese yama kieliekui uwo.
Ushirei ghurasan buwala fugunema, Maijixide jinwun jiere kieliesan mutun chanqi ulie fugune.
Ingiezhi kielieseye olune. Ushirei ghurasan Liwi goyane Iburaheimui tungo giezhi ushirei ogizho.
Ingiekushi MaijixideIburaheimui jienliekude Liwi xienrenne yasunde wo.
Isilie kunla Liwi paini buwai zhidui doura guijinni jienliewo. Ene zhiduni tungo giezhi hulunshise yale Hharuneni zhidui ese daghadene Maijixidei zhidui daghasan da nie buwai khizheghazho?
Buwani zhidui geise guijinniye ijinyo geine.
Ede kieliesan hheshi da nie painughun wo. Hhe paini kunla sidagha gieku teizi shida wilie giezhi nieda ese daozho.
Matanyi Ezhan Yuda paise khizhesanyi man mejiene. Ene paini kieliekude Musa buwai shiqinyi qiizhi ese daozho.
Maijixide mutun pse nie buwa khizhese ene shiqinla genjia qinchu oluwo.
Hhe buwa danlakushi Liwi paise khizhene giesan guijinghala pusho, ulie widaku aminni nenlighala wo.
Jinwun jiere hhende ganzhen beizhi kieliezho, "Chishi Maijixide mutun chanqiku buwa wo."
Niemande kieliese melieshidaku minlin zholien, yama zoin wise widaghawo.
Guijin yamai ese hulunshighawo. Pse niemande kieliese matande gou xiwon irezho. Ene xiwonyi tungo giezhi matan Hudai shigha shidane.
Pseshi Ersa buwa danlakude Huda fayen giezhi danlaghazho. Psedu buwalashi fayen giezhi danlaghasan pusho,
zinie Ersashi fayen giezhi danlaghasan wo. Huda hhende kieliezho, "Ezhan fayen giezho, pse ulie bienjine. Chishi chanqiku buwa wo."
Ersani fayen giezhi buwa danlaghase hheshi genjia gou yenjisanni baoran gholuwo.
Eqighandei buwa danlasan shuzi olon bikushi hhela man fugune. Ingiese izhigie buwa danla dazho.
Zinie Ersa chanqi wine. Ingiese hhei buwai wiliei chanqi ulie arunzhane.
Hhe chanqi amiturazhi hhelade oluzhi xiahua giezho. Ingiese jien hhei tungo giezhi Hudai melie iresanlai hhe jiuizhi uzhu kurugha shidane.
Intu zhiguitu, doghunnii wiku, zannannii wiku, zuirense ghugha keisan, asimanlase undudasan zui fugie buwa matande jian heshi wo.
Hhe psedu buwala mutun niudunie goyane zuide sidagha giedene khuinashi bexinlani zuide sidagha gieku biyo uwo. Hhe goyane 1 huide sidagha giedene enei man chenjighawo.
Guijinghala zui fugie buwa danlasanlade man zholienni winema, guijinni khuina Huda fayen giezhi chanqi hulunni gholusan Kewonne buwa danlaghawo.
Ede kieliesan zhunyonishi matande intu nie zui fugie buwa wine. Hhe asiman jieredu famatu Hudai baozoi borun miende souzho.
Ganjin oronde, yeshijiu zhenzhenji zhanfande wilie giezho. Ene zhanfanshi kun daisan pusho, Ezhan daisan wo.
Jien zui fugie buwalashi mure ogizhi sidagha gieghane giezhi danlaghasan wo. Ingiese matanyi ene nie zui fugie buwaye yama ogiku dunxi kerene.
Hhe zemin jiere bise buwa ulie danlakushi guijin mutun sidagha giechen buwala wine.

Enezighan buwala giesan wilieshi asiman jieredu shiqinni yanzi wo, xiujie wo. Musa ganjin zhanfanni daine giekude Huda jingao giezhi kieliesan mutun, "Chi xioxin giezhi yanyanji giekulai bi chade ulade uzheghasan yanzi mutun gie."
Ersa ede genjia zhiguitu wiliei jienliewo. Hheshi genjia gou yenjisanyi dundadu kun wo. Eneshi genjia gou dain jiere jinjisan wo.
Ji 1 gie yenjisande yama ese chaizhoshi ji 2 gie yenjisanyi kereku biyo uwo.
Huda hhelai kheilazhi kieliezho, "Uzhe, bi Isilie kun, Yuda kunlare shini yenjisanyi jinjiku udu khuzhene. Eneshi Ezhan kieliesan wo.

Ene yenjisanshi bi hhelai xienrenlaini khai laizhi Aijise uduruzhi khizhekude Hhelare jinjizhi yenjisanghala buxian wo. Hhela mii yenjisanyi izhi ese zunjizho. Ingiese biye hhelai ese gonjiwo. Eneshi Ezhan kieliesan wo.

Hhezighan udu daose bi Isilie kunlare jinjiku yenjisanshi ingiezho. Bi guijinne hhelai sumulakude teizhi zhughedeni huaine. Bi hhelade Huda danlane. Hhela made bexin danlane. Eneshi Ezhan kieliesan wo.
Jien kunla giebeizi, gaijiuladene chi ezhanni tani giezhi surughaku biyo uwo. Zui ganise zui fugienide kurutula man mii tanine.
Bi hhelai codasanyi rouliene. Hhelai zuini pse ulie jilane."
Shini yenjisan giezhi kieliese melieshiku khuichenrazho. Khuichenrazhi bixindasanla deigo man widane.
Tou 1 gie yenjisan kieliende beiiku guijin, duya jiereshiku beiiku zhiguitu oron wine.
Nie dai goudaghasan ganjin zhanfanni tou 1 gie giei zhiguitu oron giezhi uruzho. Sudoro zhula teizi, shire, Hudade ogiku ginan wine.
Ji 2 gie menlienzi khuina nie gie wine, zui zhiguitu oron giezhi uruzho.

Sudoro antanghala giesan xianlu shire, pse antanghala man bouisan yenjisan kielienni xianzi wine. Xianzi sudoro mana ginan zhonlosan antan gongon, Hharuneni niazi faizhi daosan zhugun, ghua yenjisan tashi banzi wine.
Xianzi jiere famatu ghua Jilubo wine. Zui widaghaku teizii huizho. Ede enelai nienieji kielie dane.
Enelai ingiezhi zhunbei gie goudaghazho. Buwala ganjin zhanfanni tou 1 gie giede chan orozhi libai gieku wilie giezho.
Ji 2 gie giede zinie zui fugie buwa niehon 1 hui orozhi chusun bareidene goyai zuide oluzhi, pse bexinla mejie dazhi fanjisan zuide oluzhi sidagha giene.
Enelai tungo giezhi Shenlin mejieghakushi tou 1 gie gie bikude zui zhiguitu oronde echiku moni da ese keighazho.
Eneshi edeku yanzi wo. Mure ogizhi sidagha giese libai giesan kunyi lianxinni hulunshigha dane.
Hhezighan ijieku, ochiku, yanyanji waghakulashi mienzide jinjisan guijin wo, arunzhazhi shinishighaku shihou kurune.

Mexiha iredene ireku gou shiqinni zui fugie buwa danlazhi genjia fugie, genjia hulunshiku ganjin zhanfanni tungo giezho. Ene ganjin zhanfanshi kunni khaghala daisan pusho, ene zhayaghasan duyanughunye pusho.
Hhe iman, fughe tughuchai chusunyi ulie injizhi goya chusunne injidene 1 huide zui zhiguitu oronde orozhi chanqi zui shuikui chenjighawo.
Iman, jieniui chusun, pse siniu tughuchai funiesunyi ganjin witu kunyi jiere xireighazhi beyei arughazhi ganjinraghase
Mexiha chanqiku Ruhherni tungo giezhi goyane goujida zannan wizhi Hudade ogise hhei chusun fugughaku shiqinse tai lianxinni zhiguishighazhi tai chanqiku Hudai genjia ulie shunjighanu?

Ene yenyin jiere hhe shini yenjisei dundadu kun danlazho. Hhe fuguzhi kunla tou 1 giede yenjisan doura fanjisan zuini shuiwo. Ingiedene hhezighan uruzhi iresan kunlade dain giesan chanqiku jiachanni jienlieghawo.
Kiende fugukude kielieku kielien bise bixi kielien liuisan kun fugusei kunla zhenmin gie.
Kun fuguse yenjisan kielien caigie zoin wine. Yenjisan kun amitushi yenjisan kielien yama zoin uwo.
Ingiese tou 1 gie yenjisanniye chusunghala jinjizho.
Musa guijin mutun bexinlade soyuji minlinni jianjidene hulan noghosun, osun ganganni bareizhi fughe tughucha, imanni chusun, usui guijinshu, pse bexinlai jiere xireighazhi
Ene chusunshi Huda tanre jinjisan yenjisan kielienyi zhenji wo. giezhi kieliezho.
Niekielien wo. Chusunni ganjin zhanfan, yanyanji libai giekude injiku dunxi jiere xireighazho.
Guijin mutun chabudu soyujilai chusunghala ganjinraghazho. Chusun ese usuruzhoshi zuini mienlie dane.
Ingiese asiman jieredu yanzi mutun giesan dunxilai bixi ingiezhi ganjinraghazhoma, asiman jieredu dunxilai genjia gou sidagha giekughala ganjinraghane.
Mexiha zhenzhenji zhiguitu oronni xiujie, yejiushi kun khaghala giesan zhiguitu oronde ese orodene asimande orozhi ede mai oronde Hudai melie khizhezho.
Hhe goyane izhigie sidagha gieku biyo uwo. Zui fugie buwa niehonnie goyane chusunyi ese bareizhi psedu chusunyi bareizhi zui zhiguitu oronde orokughala buxian wo.
Qingiese hhe duyai zhayaghasanse bixi izhigie ku shouinema, ede goyane 1 huide sidagha giezhi zuini widaghane giezhi duyai zuihoukude xienjizhi khizhewo.
Jien kunla 1 hui fugukushi jinjisan wo. Fuguse panjine.
Mexihaye olon kunlai zuini danjine giezhi goyane niefade sidagha giewo. Jianlai ji 2 hui xienjizhi khizhezhi zuini danjikughala gonxi widene hhei hende sagheisan kunlai jiuine.
Guijinshi jianlai ireku gounii xiujie wo, zhenzhenji yanzi pusho. Ingiese niehonnie niekielienji sidagha giekughala Hudai melie iresan kunlai jiedui hulunshigha dane.
Hulunshigha shidase libai giesan kunlai 1 huide ganjinraghazhi pse lianxinni zui wine giezhi ulie giene. Ingiese sidagha gieku eqighan ulie beinu?
Ingieliuzhe enezighan sidagha gieku niehonnie kunni zuini jila ireghane.
Jieniu, imanni chusun zuini widagha dane.
Ingiese Mexiha duyade irekude Hudade kieliezho, "Sidagha gieku dunxi, murelai chi ese keredene mii beyeni mure danlaghane giezhi zhunbei giewo.
Sideraghaku sidagha, shuiku sidaghade chi xiqi uwo.
Ingiekude bi kieliewo, 'Huda, jinwun jiere mii zhiizhi huaisan mutun bi chii isii giele irezho.'"
Jiere Mexiha kieliezhi "Sidagha gieku, mure, sideraghaku sidagha, shuiku sidaghani chi ese kerezho, xiqiye uwo." giezho. Enezighanshi guijin mutun ogisan wo.
Ingiedene kieliezho, "Uzhe, bi chii isii giele irezho." Ingiekushi hhe melieshikui widaghazhi khuinashikui chenjighane giezho.
Ene isi mutun Ersa Mexiha beyene 1 huide sidagha giezhi matanyi zhiguishighawo.
Jien buwala niudunie beidene wilie giezhi niekielienji sidagha giezhoma, eneghala zuini ibeizi widagha dane.
Zinie Mexiha 1 huide zui shuiku sidagha giezhi chanqi zoin khizheghazho. Ingiedene Hudai borun miende souzhi
hhei duitoulai hhei kon doura teitula sagheizho.
Hhe 1 hui sidagha giedene zhiguishisan kunlai chanqi hulunshighawo.
Shenlinye matande ganzhen beizhi kieliezho,
Ezhan kieliezho, Hhezighan udu daose bi hhelare jinjiku yenjisanshi ingiezho, Bi guijinne hhelai zhughede teizhi sumulakudeni huaine.
Pse kieliezho, "Hhelai zuini, mouxiennilai pse ulie jilane."
Enezighan zuini mienliese pse zuide sidagha gieku biyo uwo.
Ingiese gaijiula, matan Ersani chusunyi tungo giezhi fugie danzighala zui zhiguitu oronde oro shidane.
Hhe matande nie shini, amitu moni keighazhi sudorodu menlienzighun daoghawo. Ene sudorodu menlienzishi hhei beye wo.
Matande Hudai giede gonjisan nie famatu buwa wineshi
matai doghun lianxinni Ersai chusunghala arughazhi zhughei ganjinraghadene beyeni ganjin usughala waghase matan shixinji zhughe, khidunde xianxin giekughala Hudai melie echiye.
Matande dain giesan hheshi kekaotui wo. Ingiese matan chenren giezhi xiwon giesei ulie gojiolughazhi goude bareiye.
Matan nieniene dahoshen giezhi oreku, gounii giekui sumulaye.
Hhezighan ulie hhantulazhi gon olusan kunlai bu daghadene nieniedene surughazhi kieliezhi hhantulaye. Hhe udu chadashisei mejiese genjia ingiezhi gieye.
Matan zhendaoi mejiekui jienliesenu nanxighan zui fanjise pse shuiku sidagha uwo,
zinie ayizhi panjiku, pse duitoulai sideraghaku fugie khanni sagheizho.
Musai guijinyi fanjisan kunlai ghua, ghuran kun ganzhen beise ubali ulie xiizhi fugughanema,
Hudai kewonyi taizhi goyai zhiguishighasan yenjisan chusunyi yamacha ese teizhi nenjienni ogisan Shenlinni uru giesan kunlai, ta nie sumula, hhelai genjia gundude ulie fainu?
Bouchoushi bi giekui wo, bi kharulune. Pse, "Ezhan bexinlane panjine." Enei kien kieliesei matan mejiene.
Chanqiku Hudai khade orose ayine.
Tai eqighandei gon zhouidene jiurezhi olon ku shouizhi rennai giesei sumula.
Niezheifa tai dajialai melie shizheghazhi heizho. Niezheifa qimutu kunnan shouisan kunlare lienshou gholuzho.
Hhezighan khasan kunlade ta ubali xiizho. Tai caichanlai kunla qianlakude ta bayasuzhi shouikushi goyade genjia gouni, chanqiku caichan bikui mejiene.
Ingiese ta fugie danzine bu benda. Intu zhughede fugie jianli ogine.
Ta Hudai isii gie baraghazhi dain giesei jienliene giese rennai gieku biyo wine.
Jinwun jiere, "Pse goujicha beise irene giesan hhe irene, ulie udane.
Gou kunmi xianxin giekughala amiturane. Khuina tuise bi hhende xiqi uwo." giezhi kieliezho.
Matanshi khuina tuidene widachen kun pusho, xianxin gieku bizhi jiuisan kun wo.
Xianxin giekushi xiwon giesan shiqinni bawo wo, chanla daku shiqinni ghanghanaghakui wo.
Eneghala Huda eqighanku kunlai renjizho.
Xianxin giekughala matan alanshi Hudai kielienyi tungo giezhi zhayaghasei mejiene. Ingiezhi chanlasanshi chanla dakuse zhayaghasan wo.

Xianxin giekughala Hhabi Hudade sidagha giesan Jiabi giesanse gou wo. Hhei xianxin giekughala Huda mureini jienliezhi Hhabishi gou kun wo giezhi renjiwo. Hhe fuguzhoma, xianxin giekughala edeliuzhe kielien kieliezho.

Xianxin giekughala Idileisii jienlie echise hhe fugukui jingo ese giewo. Kunla hhei ereizhi olu dakushi Huda hhei jienlie echizho. Hhei jienlie echiku melie hhe Hudai bayasughase gou minshenyi jienliewo.
Xianxin gieku wise Hudai bayasugha dane. Hudai melie irechen kun ijinyo Huda winekui xianxin giezhi hhei ereisan kunlade jianli ogikui xianxin giekui wo.

Xianxin giekughala Nuhha chanla dasan shiqinni Huda jingao giese zunjizhi fugie chonni zhunbei giedene giei kunlaini man jiuiwo. Xianxin giekughala Nuhha hhe idai kunlai zuini jinjiwo, goyai Hudai melie gounide sanawo.
Huda Iburaheimui urukude hhe xianxin giekughala minlinyi zunjizhi jianlai caichan gieku oronde khizhewoma, echikude khala echikui ulie mejiene.
Hhe xianxin giekughala dain giesan oronde soukude kunlai oronde souku mutun zhanfande souzho. Niekielienji dain giesei jienliesan Isaghei, Yagebuye qingiezho.
Eneshi hhe Huda jihua giezhi beighasan jichutu chenshii sagheizho.
Xianxin giekughala Sare kewosi laiku nasunse daoliuzhe kewosi laizho. Hhe sumulase hhende dain giesan hhe kekao wo giezho.
Ingiese hoxian nie fugusan kunse houdei oluzhi asiman jieredu hodun, haibienzini shazi mutun shuzi uwo.

Enezighan kunlade man xianxin gieku bizhi fuguwoma, dain giesei jienlie dazho. Gholose dain giesei chanladene bayasuzhi jienliene giezho. Pse goyalane duya jieredu toreichen, zhanshi sousan kun wo giezhi chenren giezho.
Intui kieliechen kunshi minminji goyadene nie gojia ereizho.
Hhela likai giesan oronne sumulazhoshi khareizhi echiku jihui winema,
hhela hende xiwon giesanshi nie genjia gou gojia, jiushi asiman jieredu wo. Hhela Hudai Huda giese Huda shizhene ulie giedene hhelade nie chenshini zhunbei giezho.
Xianxin giekughala Iburaheimui Huda shiikude Isagheini khughozhi ogiwo. Dain giesei jienliesan kun goya niekozi kewonneliuzhe khughozhi ogiwo.
Ene kewonni kieliese Huda kieliezhi daozho, "Zinie Isagheise olusei chii houdei giezhi urune."
Hhe sumulase Huda kunni fugusan kun dundase aminne olughane giezho. Hoxian hhe fugusan kun dundase kewonne uduru irewo.
Xianxin giekughala Isaghei jianlaiku shiqinde oluzhi Yagebu, Isaode onxian giewo.
Xianxin giekughala Yagebu fugukude Yusufuni kewonlade nienieji onxian giezhi zhugun tuludene Hudai beiiwo.
Xianxin giekughala Yusufu fugukude Isilie kunla jianlai Aijise khizhekui kieliezhi pse goya yasunyi matui chuli giekui fenfulawo.
Musai oluse ada, anani uzhese nie seighan kewosi wo. Xianxin giekughala honshanni minlinse ese ayizhi ghuran sara niuighawo.
Xianxin giekughala Musa fugiedadene Falaoni oqinde kewon ulie danlane giezho.
Khareidene Hudai bexinlare hhantu shouku gieliuzhe zui dunda zhanshi xianshou ulie giene.
Hhe Mexihade oluzhi uru giesei uzhedan Aijini boubeise gundude uzhezho. Hhe jianlaiku jianlini sagheizho.
Xianxin giekughala hhe honshan hokukuse ese ayizhi Aijise likai giewo. Chanla daku Ezhanyi hoxian chanlaku mutun rennai giezho.
Xianxin giekughala hhe Jiulidaosan Jie, chusun xireighaku kuichenni jinjiwo. Ingiezhi hhe alachen irese Isilie kunlai fugie kewonlai ese alaghazho.
Xianxin giekughala Isilie kunla Hunhaini daokude khosun oron daoku niekielien wo. Aiji kunla qingiezhi shiizhi daokude yenji alawo.
Xianxin giekughala Isilie kunla Yelige chenshini doludu rouise chenqian furawo.
Xianxin giekughala biozi Lahe tewulai goude jienliedene hhezighan ese shunjisan kunlare hhantu ese fuguwo.
Bi pse yan kieliene? Jijien, Balake, Cansun, Yefuta, Dawude, Samuer, pse xienzhilai shiqinni nienieji kieliese shijie ulie kune.
Xianxin giekughala hhela gojialai hanshiliewo, gundanni giewo, dain giesei jienliewo, shizini amanyi duighawo,
fugie khanni tuliekui widaghawo, khudogho renzise holu andawo, zholiennise khidunnii gholuwo, zhan eghikude lihaishiwo, niman kunlai buduilai man eghi tuighawo.
Biereila fugusan dundase aminne olusan giene kunyi jienliewo. Niezhan kunla genjia gou fuhoni jienliene giezhi hende tendun shouizhi andaku duran uwo.
Niezhan kunlai xilun gie, mabienzida, banla, kha,

Enezighan kunla xianxin giekui tungo giezhi gou minshenyi jienliewoma, dain giesei jienlie dawo.

Olien matai wiqiku mutun matande imegheni ganzhen beisan kun wine. Ingiese yanyanji achan, matai chigharade jiohoro giesan zuini xieidene rennai giezhi matai melie beilasan holukui bisai gieye.

Mai xianxin giekuni kaishi gieghazhi onchen gieghasan Ersani goude uzheye. Hhei melie beilasan bayasukude oluzhi hhe shizijiani kui shouizhi shizheghakui meilade uzhedene Hudai baozoi borun miende souzho.
Ta zuirenla fandui giesei rennai giesan Ersai ta goude sumula. Ingiese ta ulie hhechezhi zhughe ulie widane.
Ta zuighala eghinduzhoma, chusun usuruku chendude ese kuruzho.
Kewosiladene surughazhi kieliesan mutun Huda tande surughazhi kieliesan kielienyi ta matawu? Kieliezho, "Mii kewon, Ezhan gonjizhi surughasei chi meilade bu uzhe. Hhe kheilakude zhughene bu widagha.
Ezhan oresandene gonjizhi surughane. Jienliesan kesilane eghine."
Tai gonjizhi surughakude rennai gie. Huda tai kewonne mutun uzhezho. Alinie kewonde ada gonjizhi ulie surughane?
Kewon danlasanla man gonjizhi surughasei jienliezho. Tande gonjizhi surughasan uwoshi kewon pusho, zagieda wo.
Pse matanyi gonjizhi surughasan beyeni adai matan zunjizho. Matan ruhherni Adai genjia shunjizhi ulie amituranu?
Beyeni ada zhanshi jiere goyane isighala mai gonjizhi surughazho. Zinie ruhherni Ada mai gonjizhi surughakushi matande haochu ireghazhi hhei zhiguinide guzi beighane giezho.
Jien gonjizhi surughasanlashi danshi ese bayasudene nango giezhoma, khuinashi lienjizhi daosan kunlade pinnantu jiego irene, gundande udu daone.

Ta xioxin gie, pse niezhan kunla Hudai nenjiense likai giene, pse du winetu genzi khizhedene tai jiohoro giezhi olon kunlai zannanshighane.

Hhe xienzide hhei shenqi zeminyi gojiolughazho. Ede hhe dain giezhi kieliezho, "Bi pse niefa zeminyi gojiolughazhi asimanyiye gojiolughane."

Ghoni adulasan fugie yanbashi mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihai chanqi yenjisan chusunghala fugusan kun dundase aminne olughasan pinnantu Huda
yanyanji gounighala tai hulunshighazhi goyane isii giegha gie! Ersa Mexihani tungo giezhi mai dunda goyane bayasughaku shiqinyi giegha gie. Kuaikui chanqi izhi hhende ogi. Amine!
Gaijiula, bi jiendanghan tande xin huaizhi sughazhi kieliesei ta goude chenlie.
Matai gaijiu Qimotaini andaghasei ta mejie. Hhe eqie irese bi hhere hhantu tai uzhele ireye.

Nenjien tanre man hhantu bi gie!
Yagebu
Huda, Ezhan Ersa Mexihani hoji Yagebu xin huaizho. Gochude sandazhi sousan 12 gie paini kunlade kielien asazho.
Mii gaijiula, tande yanyanji chijia shiqinyi penjise hende bayasundu.
Tai xianxin giekui shiizhi daose rennai irekui ta mejiene.
Ta rennaini xiogoni man khizhegha. Ingiese ta fugiedazhi hulunshidene yama ulie chaine.
Tai dunda kiende agheli chaizhoshi soyuji kunlade dafande ogizhi ulie kheilaku Hudase xiahua gie, tande ogine.
Ta xiahua giekude xianxin giezhi goujida inxin bu gie. Inxin giechen kun haini lan mutun kei matugie feiliese qingie furane.
Intu kunla Ezhan yan ogine giezhi bu sumula.
Soyuji shiqin jiere zhuyine barei dazhi undanla dazho.
Boghoni gaijiula goya undunine kuai.
Bayan kunla goya boghonine kuai. Bayan kunla banche jieredu chizhe mutun widane.
Naran khizhe nie shase osun ghone, chizheni xiniezhi seighanni widane. Bayan kunye giesan dundane ingiezhi widane.
Chijia shiqinyi shoui shidachen kunlade fuqi wine. Shiizhi daosan kunde jianli wo giezhi aminni maghalai ogine. Eneshi Hudade oresan kunlade ogine giezhi dain giesan wo.
Kunyi shiise, "Mii Huda shiizho." giezhi bu kielie. Doghunni Hudai shii dane. Hheye kienmai ulie shiine.
Kunyi shiise goyani nefuxin miidene miighazho.
Nefuxinghala kieli fugiedase zui olune, zui fugiedase fugukui olune.
Bi oresan gaijiula, shandan bu gie.
Yanyanji gouni, onqienni nenjienlashi man jierese iresan wo. Gonqini Adai hhense irezho. Hhe goujida ulie bienjine, izhi niekielien wo.
Hhe goyane isighala zhendaoi tungo giezhi matande ada danlawo. Ingiedene matanyi hhe zhayaghasanla dundadu zui zhunyoni gholughawo.
Bi oresan gaijiula, enei mejie, kienliuzhe chenliekude ghujighan, kieliekude lalaghan, hokukude lalaghan.
Kunni hokuku Hudai gundanni khizhegha dane.
Ingiese yanyanji zannanni, olodosan doghunnilai man benda. Tai zhughede Huda zeilasan kielienni renyide jienlie. Ene kielien tai ruhherni jiui shidane.
Ta goyane piendazhi kielienyi zinie chenliechen bu gholudene zunjichen gholu.
Kun kielienyi zinie chenliedene ulie zunjise belijide goya uxinne uzheku niekielien wo.
Uzhedene yo daose goya yanzine deigo matawo.
Zinie kunlade ziyu ogisan onqientu guijinni xianxide uzhedene chenliesei uye matazhi zunjizhi giesan kunlade yan shiqin gieliuzhe fuqi wine.
Kun goyane xienlian wo giedene kielienne gonji dase goyane goya piendazho. Ene kunni xienlian yama oronde uwo.
Ada Hudai melie ganjin, zannan witu xienlianshi oliechen, guafulade kunnan bikude hhelai zhaogu giezhi da goyane baohu giezhi duyani zannanyi ulie cheiqighakui wo.
Mii gaijiula, ta mai famatu Ezhan Ersa Mexihai xianxin giese kunlade pienxin bu gie.
Bilase nie kun antan geizhi zhozhi huaralasan jien musidene tai huitande orowo. Pse nie nanxin kun po jien musidene ye orowo.
Ingiese ta hhe huaralasan jien musisan kunde kieliene, "Ene gou wizhi jiere sou." Pse nanxin kunde kieliene, "Chi hhetoro bei, pse mii kon shida sou."
Eneshi ta goya kunne pienxin giezhi doghun mujighala pandon gieku pushonu?
Bi oresan gaijiula, chenlie. Huda duya jieredu nanxin kunlai sunghudene xinyan jiere ese bayazheghawu? Da Hudade oresan kunlade dain giesan hhe gojiani hhelade ese jienlieghawu?
Ta dou nanxin kunlai jiuren gieghazho. Tai qifulazhi fayende lai echisanshi baertu kunla pushonu?
Hhelashi ta jienliesan zhiguitu nierei sugiesanla pushonu?
Jinwun jiere goyadene mutun giebeidene ore giesan ene nie zui zhunyo guijinni ta zunjizhoshi oluzhoma,
kunlade pienxin giese zui fanjizho, guijin ta fanjisande zui jinjine.
Kien guijinni man zunjidene niei fanjise soyujilai man fanjizho.
Piofen bu gie. giezhi kieliesan Huda "Kun bu ala." giezhi ye kieliezho. Ingiese piofen ese giedene kun alase guijinni fanjizho.
Ingiese ta yan kielie, yan giene giese ziyushighaku guijinghala panjiku mutun gie.
Ubali ulie xiichen kunyi ubali ulie xiikughala panjine. Ubali xiiku panjikuse injiwo.
Mii gaijiula, kunde xianxin gieku wine giezhi kieliedene yama giekui uwoshi yan zoin wo? Ene xianxin gieku hhei jiui shidanu?
Tai dunda gaijiu eghechijiulade niudunie musiku, ijiuni uwokude
ta hhelade, "Pinnande echi, musizhi khalun, ijiezhi chudu." giezhi kieliedene beyede injikui ulie ogise yan zoin wo?
Niekielien wo. Gieku witu zinie xianxin giekushi fugusei wo.
Ingiese niezhan kunla kieliene, "Chade xianxin gieku wine, made gieku wine." Chi gieku witu xianxin giekune made uzhegha. Bi giekughalane xianxin giekune chade uzheghaye!
Huda niekozi wo giezhi chi xianxin giese oluzho. Sheitanlaye hhei xianxin giedene ayizhi pugharazho.
Chi ene men kun, gieku witu xianxin giekushi yama zoin wituni chi mejieku duran winu?
Matanyi xienren IburaheimuIsaghei kewonne sidagha gieku teizi jiere teikude giekughala gounide sanasan pushonu?
Chi uzhe, hhei xianxin gieku hhei giekughala hhantu wilie giezho. Giekughala xianxin giekui hulunshighawo.
Ingiese jinwun jiere "Iburaheimu Hudai xianxin giedene Huda hhei gounide sanazho." giezhi kieliesan mutun gholuwo. Pse hhei Hudai zhanlien wo giezhi uruzho.
Ingie uzhese kunni gounide sanase giekughala wo, zinie xianxin giekughala pusho.
Niekielien wo, biozi Lahe peizhi ireghasan kunlai jienliedene psedu mo jierese echighawo. Eneshi giekughala gounide sanasan pushonu?
Ingiese ruhher witu beye fugusan mutun gieku witu xianxin giekushiye fugusan wo.
Mii gaijiulaya, ta olon kunla man loushi danlane bu gie. Loushi danlasan kunyi psedu kunlase gundude panjikui ta mejiene.
Matan dajiala go fanmiende cowu fanjine. Nie kun kielien jiere yama cowu ulie fanjise hheshi hulun kun wo. Goya hunshenne man kunzhi gie shidane.
Matan moreii amande ghada teizhi hhei hanshiliese hunshenyini kunzhi giene.
Pse chonni nie sumula, hhe fugie woma, honfen kei eghizhi chonni gojiolughaliuzhe siji niekozi ga banbaghala fanxianyi goyane isighala suibiende zhanwo giene.
Kielienye niekielien wo. Beye jieredu nie ga iyanzi woma, fugie kielien kielie shidane. Uzhe, zui gaji khanliuzhe nie linkoni sideragha shidane.
Kielienshi khan wo. Nie gou witu duya wo. Mai beye jiere teidene hunshenni zannanshighane. Dozoheini khanghala mai shenholai man sideraghane.
Kun yanyanji yewo, bunzhu, ghughei, zhaghasunlai hanshilie shidane, ede ijin hanshiliezho.
Zinie goya kielienne hanshilie dane. Kielienshi ulie beiku doghunni wo, alaku du duruzho.
Hheghala matan Ezhan, Adani doulazho. Pse hheghala Hudai yanzighala zhayaghasan kunyi kharazho.
Doulaku, kharaku nie amanse khizhezho. Mii gaijiula, ene ese oluzho.
Nie bula nudunse qien usu, kou usu khizhe shidanu?
Mii gaijiula, uhuago mutun jiere ganlan alima sou shidanu? Putou mutun jiere uhuago sou shidanu? Sou dane, kou bulase qien usu khizhe daku niekielien wo.
Tai dunda kiende agheli, jienzha wine? Hhe kun aghelise iresan renyitu zhugheghala goude giezhi kunlade zhenmin gie.
Tai zhughede hende dubilieku, zisitu zhughe bise goyane bu tungulie. Ghudanghala zhendaoni fandui bu gie.
Ene aghelishi asiman jierese iresan pusho. Duya, nefuxin, sheitanse iresan wo.
Jien dubilieku sunsigheilieku winetu oronde londaku, yanyanji doghunni gieku shiqin wine.
Zinie asiman jierese iresan aghelishi xien ganjinni wo. Pse heqi, renyi, ranji, olon ubali xiizhi gounii gie, pienxin ulie gie, jiani wikui wo.
Heqishighachen kunla heqini tareidene gundanni ghurane.
Tai dundadu sugienduku eghinduku khalase irezho? Tai sudorodu nefuxin khudoghozhi khizhesan pushonu?
Ta tanxin giesanne kerezhi echi dase kunlai alane. Dubiliezhi yama kerezhi echi dase eghinduzhi sugiendune. Ta kerezhi echi dakushi xiahua ese giezho.
Xiahua giedene kerezhi echi dakushi tai muji ese oluzho. Ta keresanne goya nefuxin jiere injine giezho.
Ta ene piofen giechen kunla, ta duyaghala zhanlien gholuse Hudaghala duitou gholusei ulie mejienu? Kienliuzhe duyaghala zhanlien gholune giese Hudaghala duitou gholuzho.
Pse ta sumulase Huda matai sudoro teisan ruhherde neiizhi dubiliekude kuruzho giesan jinwunni kielien yama isi uwonu?
Ingieliuzhe Huda ogisan nenjien genjia olon wo. Jinwun jiere kieliesan mutun, "Huda goyane undude uzhesan kunlai fandui giene. Goyane meilade uzhesan kunlade nenjien ogine."
Ingiese ta Hudai shunji. Ibilisii danla. Ibilisi tanse piine.
Ta Hudai shigha. Huda tai shighane. Zuirenla, khane ganjinragha. Zhuine barei dasan kunla, zhughene ganjinragha.
Ta yuchou giezhi nango giezhi wila. Tai xiniedunyi nango gholugha. Bayasukui yuchou gholugha.
Ta Ezhanyi melie goyane boghonide uzhe, ingiese hhe tai undudaghane.
Gaijiula, ta nieniene bu sugie. Kien gaijiune sugiezhi kieliese guijinni sugiezhi kieliezho. Ta guijinni kieliese guijinni zunjisan kun pusho, panjiku noyen gholuwo.
Guijinni jinjichen, panjichen zi niekozi wo. Hheshi kunni jiui shidaku, widagha shidaku Huda wo. Kunlai kieliezhi chishi kien wo?
Enedu, maghashijie matan khalakhala chenshide echi, niehon souzhi meimei giezhi baer zhenjiye. giezhi kieliesan kunla, chenliendu.
Ta maghashijie matui gholukui ulie mejiene. Tai aminshi yan wo? Khizhese deigo widaku tuman wo.
Ta indan ingiezhi kieliekuni wo, "Ezhan duran bise matan aminne olune, enei giene, hheiye giene."
Ingieliuzhe ta goyane undude uzhezhi kuaine. Qingiezhi kuaikushi man doghunni wo.
Ingiese kun gouni giekui mejiedene ulie giese zui fanjizho.
Ta bayan kunla chenliendu. Tai jiere bouzheku zeinande tunku giezhi fugiede wila.
Tai boubeila qida oluwo, tai jienlai ghughei ijiewo.
Tai antan, miengu xiuqirawo. Ene xiuqi tai zhaku zhenji gholune. Khan mutun tai beyeni sidera widaghane. Ta duya baraku xienzide boubei sunjizho.

Uzhe, kunla tai ghazhade wilie giesan gunzini ta ese ogizho. Ene gunzi waradazhi boxin kieliezho. Hhezighan zhonjia ghurasan kunlai boxin giesan shenqi waradazhi Qienwon Buduini Ezhanni chighinde orowo.
Ta duyade futande udu daozhi zhomen xianshou giezho. Goyane ijiezhi taghulaghadene alane giesan hhe udude zhunbei giezho.
Ta gou kunyi zui jinjizhi alawoma, hhe fandui ese giezho.
Ingiese gaijiula, Ezhan iretula ta rennai gie. Uzhe, zhonjia kun rennai giezhi eqie udan ghurai panjizhi ghazhase gou taran khizhekui sagheizho.
Taye rennai giezhi zhughene khiduzhegha. Ezhan ireku udu ghujinlazho.
Gaijiula, ta nieniedene boxin bu kielie. Pse ta panjikui shouine. Uzhe, panjiku Ezhan wijien konde beizho.
Gaijiula, ta Ezhanni niereghala kielien kieliesan xienzhilai shouku giezhi rennai giesan yanzii suru.
Uzhe, rennai giesan kunlade matan fuqi wine giezho. Eibu rennai giesei ta chenliezhi daozho. Ezhan hhende zuihoude ogisei taye mejiene. Ezhande ubali xiiku, unbasaku olon wo.
Mii gaijiula, zui zhunyonishi fayen bu gie. Asiman, zemin, yanniliuzhe zhiizhi fayen bu gie. Ta kielien kieliekude enbeneshi enbene gie, pushoshi pusho gie. Ingiese tai ulie panjine.
Tai dunda kien chijia shiqin penjise onxian gie. Kien bayasuse zanmeishi doula.
Tai dunda kien giemerese jiohuini zhanlaolani uruzhi Ezhanni niereghala hhende oluzhi tosun moizhi onxian gie.
Xianxin giezhi onxian giekughala giemeresan kunyi goudaghane. Ezhan hhei bosizheghane. Hhe zui fanjizhoshi mienliene.
Ingiese ta nieniene zuini renjizhi nieniedene oluzhi onxian giema, tai gien goudane. Gou kun onxian giese zoin fugiede wine.
Iliyashi matanre niekielienji kun woma, hhe hende onxian giezhi ghura bu bou giese 3 nienban zemin jiere ghura ese bouwo.
Khuina pse onxian giese asiman jierese ghura bouzhezhi zemin jiere zhonjia osiwo.

zuirenyi miisan mo jierese khareighachen hhe kun hhe nie kunni fugukuse jiuizhi olon zuini kha widaghasei mejiekui wo.
1 Beduru
Ersa Mexihade shitu danlasan BeduruBendu, Jialatai, Jiapadojia, Yaxiya, Bituinide sandazhi zhanshi jiere souzhi Huda sunghusan kunlade xin huaizho.
Ada Huda tai eqighanse jinjidene Shenlinghala zhiguishigha Ersa Mexihai shunjighazhi hhei chusunghala xireighazhi ganjinraghawo. Huda tande nenjien, pinnan olon ogi gie!
Mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihai ada Hudade doulaye! Hhe matande hende ubali xiidene Ersa Mexihai fugusan kun dundase aminne olughakughala matanyi erchan olughazhi zhenzhenji xiwon ogizho.
Pse ulie xiuqiraku, ulie zannantuku, ulie widaku jiachanyi tande oluzhi asiman jiere sunjizho.
Huda ta xianxin giekui tungo giezhi nenlighalane tai baohu giedene duya barakude xienjizhi khizhene giesan jiuikui tande ogine.
Ingiese ta hende bayasuzho. Ta bixi zhanshi jiere yanyanji kunnande yuchou giezhoma,
enezighan kunnan tai xinyanshi zhenni bikui mejieghane. Khande tuliesan antanliuzhe huailunema, tai xinyan antanse da guizhunde Ersa Mexiha xienjikude tande kuaiku, fama, zhiguii ireghane.
Ta Ersai chanlazhi ese daozhoma, hhende orezho. Edeliuzhe hhei chanla danema, hhei xianxin giezhi kielienghala kielie daku, hashu witu bayasukughala bayasuzho.
Ta xinyanni jiegoi jienliezho. Hheshi goyane jiuiku wo.
Ene jiuikui kieliese xienzhila xianxide chaizhi yenjiu giezhi daozho. Tande ogine giesan ene nenjienni hhela melie kieliezhi daozho.
Hhela Mexihashi kien bikui, yan xienzide irekui yenjiu giezho. Mexiha shouku giedene khuinashi fama irekui Mexihani ruhher hhelai sudoro melie kieliezho.

Hhela ene wiliei giese goyadene ese giezho, tande oluzhi giesei Huda hhelade mejieghazho. Ene gouxioxishi chonjichen kunla asiman jierese peizhi ireghasan Shenlinyi nenlighala ede tande chonjizhi ogiwo. Ene shiqinlai qienxienlaye hende uzheku duran wo.
Ingiese ta zhughedene zhunbei giezhi jinxin giedene Ersa Mexiha xienjikude tande deilazhi ireku nenjienyi goude panji.
Ta shunjiku kewosi danlazhi eqighanku mutun yama mejie dazhi nefuxin giekulai bu dagha.
Tai urusan Hudashi zhigui mutun taye yan shiqin giese zhiguide gie.
Jinwun jiere jilazhi kieliezho, "Bishi zhiguitu wo, taye zhiguishi."
Ta xiahua giekude kunni pienxin ulie giezhi kunni giekughala panjichen Ezhanni Ada giezhi uruse ta zhanshi jiere duyade bikude hhei zunjizhi udu dao.
Ta mejiene. Tai xienrenla tande chonjizhi ogisan yama zoin witu xigonse tai shuisanshi huailuku antan, miengughala pusho,
Mexihani zhiguitu chusunghala wo. Hoxian goujida uye chaizhi ese cheiqisan ghoni ghughanyi chusunyi xianli.
Huda Mexihai duya zhayaghaku melie jinjiwoma, duya barakude tande oluzhi xienjizhi khizheghawo.
Ta Mexihai tungo giezhi hhei fugusan kun dundase aminne olughazhi hhende kuaikui ogisan Hudai xianxin giezho. Ingiese ta xianxin giesan, panjisanne man Hudade kouizho.
Ta zhendaoi shunjizhi goyane ganjinraghazhi kunlade zhenzhenji orezho. Ingiese xiacha giezhi zhughesene nieniedene orendu.
Tai erchan olusanshi huailuku fureghala pusho, ulie huailuku fureghala wo. Hudai chanqi ulie widaku, amitu kielienghala wo.
Jinwun jiere kieliezho, "Kun osun niekielien wo. Kunni fama osun jieredu chizhe niekielien wo. Osun ghone, chizheye xiniene.
Zinie Hudai kielien chanqi wine." Ene kielienshi tande chonjisan gouxioxi wo.
Ingiese soyuji doghunni, piendaku, jiazhon gieku, dubilieku, sugieku enelai ta man widagha.
Yeliwa neizii neiiku mutun taye qingiezhi zhenni, pse gou daolini neii. Ruhherni ganjin neizii neii. Daolide kouizhi izhi fugiedase jiuine.
Ta Ezhan gou bikui mejiese qingiezhi gie.
Ta Ersai shida ire. Hheshi amitu tashi wo. Kunla hhei bendawoma, Huda hhazeliezhi sunghuwo.
Taye amitu tashi mutun nienieji luizhi ruhhertu gie gholu. Ingie zhiguitu buwa danladene Ersa Mexihai tungo giezhi Huda bayasuku mutun jiomuntu mure ogi.
Jinwun jiere kieliezho, "Uzhe, bi zhiguide sunghusan tashii Xiwunde teizhi jichu tashi gholughawo. Hhei xianxin giesanla jiuren ulie giene."
Ingiese ene tashi xianxin giesan tande zhigui woma, ulie xianxin giesan kunlade, "Jianrenla bendasan tashi giei zhunyo tashi gholuwo"
pse hheshi kunyi banjighaku tashi wo. Unaghaku fugie tashi wo giezho. Hhela banjikushi kielienyi uye shunjizho. Eneshi hhelai amin wo.
Ingieliuzhe tashi sunghusan bexin, honshan mutun buwa, zhiguitu minzu, bexin wo. Tai kharanise uruzhi khizheghadene goyai ghudureqitu gonqi dunda ireghasan Hudai famatuni kunlade kielieghane giezho.
Melieshida tashi bexin pusho. Ede Hudai bexin wo. Melieshida tande ubali ese xiizho. Ede ubali xiizho.
Mii orentula, tashi duyade zhanshi jiere sousan niman kun wo. Bi tande goude fenfulaye, ruhherghala eghinduku beyeni nefuxinni bu gie.
Ta niman kunlai dunda goude gie. Ingiese ta doghunni giezho giezhi sugiesan kunla ta goude giesei uzhedene Huda panjiku udude hhei kuaine.
Ta Ezhanyi yenyinghala soyuji kunni zhiduni shunji. Zui fugie qienlitu honshan,
pse noyenlai shunji. Noyenlashi doghunni giesan kunlai faizhi gounii giesan kunlai kuaighane giezhi honshan peisan wo.
Hudai isishi ta gouni giezhi bende yama ulie mejiechen kunlai amanyi duigha giezho.
Tashi ziyutui woma, ziyughala doghunni gieku jiekou bu gholughadene Hudai hoji mutun gie.
Jien kunlai zunzhun gie. Xianxin giesan kunlade ore. Hudai zunji. Honshanyi zunzhun gie.
Hoji danlasan kunla, ta zunzhun gieku zhugheghala ezhanne shunji. Zinie gou, renyitui pusho, mouxiennilaiye shunji.
Kien hanhanji shouku giedene Hudai sumulazhi rennai giese kuaikui wine.
Zui fanjidene eghikui rennai giese yan kuaikui wine? Gouni giedene shouku giekui rennai giese Hudai melie kuaikui wine.
Shouku gieliuzhe gouni giekude Huda tai uruzho. Mexihaye tande oluzhi shouku giezhi yanzi uzheghawo. Tai goyane korolon mutun yoghane giezho.
Hhe zui fanjizhi ese daozho, ghudanye kieliezhi ese daozho.
Hhei sugiekude khareizhi ese sugiewo, shouku giekude ayighaku kielien ese kieliewo, khareidene goyane gundande panjichen Hudade jiuiwo.
Hhe qinsi beyeghalane shizijia jiere mai zuini danjidene mai zui dunda udu ulie daoghazhi gounide udu daoghawo. Hhe shan deiladene ta goudawo.
Ta eqighandei miisan ghoni niekielien wo. Ede ruhhertai adulachen, baohu giechen hhei shida khareizhi irewo.
Biereila, taye qingiezhi zhanguijine shunji. Ingiese Hudai daolii ese xianxin giesan zhanguijiliuzhe ta kieliesanlai pusho, giesanlai uzhedene zhugheini gojiolughane.
Yenyinshi ta zunzhun giezhi ganjinde udu daosei hhela chanlawo.
Ta mienzide usunne bienjizhi antan zhozhi seighan jien musizhi bu dabala.
Khareidene ta renyi, undantughala sudorone dabala. Eneshi ulie xiuqiraku seighanni wo, Hudai melie zhigui wo.
Hudai kouisan eqighanku zhiguitu biereilaye ingiezhi zhanguijine shunjizhi goyane dabalazho.
SareIburaheimui shunjizhi ezhan giezhi uruzho. Ta yama ulie ayidene gounii giese Sare mutun gholuwo.

Zhanguijila, taye qingiezhi biereighalane hhantu udu daokude hhelai gonxin gie. Hhelashi zholien oqitula wo. Hhelashi tanre hhantu aminni nenjienyi jienliechen wo giezhi zunzhun gie. Ingiese tai onxian giekui ulie duine.
Zuihoude kielieye, ta man nie zhughe gholuzhi nieniedene ubali xii, nieniedene ore, renyide giezhi goyane meilade uzhe.
Doghunnide doghunnii, sugiekude sugiekui bu kharuludene hhelade oluzhi gouni kielie. Huda tai zhen enende uruzhi fuqi jienlieghane giezho.
Jinwun jiere kieliezho, Kien goude udu daoghane giezhi xianshou giene giese Kielienne gonjizhi doghun kielien bu kielie. Amanne gonjizhi ghudan bu kielie.
Doghunnise likai giezhi gouni gie, heqishikui xiacha giezhi gie.
Ezhanni nudun gou kunyi uzhene, hhei chighin hhela waradasei chenlienema, Doghunni giesan kunlade Ezhan uxinne boughane.
Ta goude gouni giese kien tai heine?
Ta gouni giedene shouku giese tande fuqi wine. Kunla ayighakuse bu ayi, ye bu jinda.
Zhughedene Mexihai zunjizhi hhei ezhan danlagha. Kunla ta zhughedene panjisei asase suishisui huida giekui zhunbei gie.
Huida giekude renyide zunzhun giezhi gie. Ta lianxin bu ghudandu. Ingiese kunla tai uru giekude ta Mexihai xianxin giezhi giesan gounii sugiesan kunla shizhene.
Gouni giezhi shouku giekushi Hudai isi enbese doghunni giezhi shouku giekuse gou wo.

Mexihaye zuini yenyinzhe 1 huide duya ijiewo. Ingiezhi gou kun gou witu kunyi deilawo. Ingiekushi Hudai melie tai echighane giezho. Beyeghala kieliese hhe duya ijiewo, ruhherghala kieliese aminne oluwo.
Hhe echidene ruhherghalane bafanzide khasan ruhherlade daoli chonjizho.
Hhelashi eqighandei Nuhha chon gieku shihoude Huda rennai giezhi sagheikude uye shunjisan kunla wo. Hhe shihoude chon jiere khizhi ususe jiuisan kun jian neiman wo.
Ene usushi xilini melie mejieghasan jihao wo, ede Ersa Mexihani aminne olughakughala tai jiuine. Hheshi beye jieredu goujiani widaghakui pusho, ulie ghudanduku lianxinghala Hudade fayen giekui wo.
Ersa asiman jiere khireizhi Hudai borun miende wo, qienxien, qienlitu, nenlitula man hhende shunjizho.
Mexiha ingiezhi beyedene shouku giezhoma, taye imutu zhugheghala goyane ku shouikui zhunbei gie. Beyede shouku giesan kun zuise gonxi sirazho.
Ingiedene feiliesan udude kunni nefuxinyi pse ulie daghazhi Hudai isi mutun udu daone.
Ta daosandei niman kunla xiqi bikulai daghazhi hu gieku, nefuxin gieku, jiu ochizhi sudoku, lon naduzhi ochiku, nigiedalai beiizhi hanzhan gieghakui pse bu gie.
Ene shiqin jiere ta hhelare hhantu qingiezhi hashu witu lon ulie giekui hhela chanladene ghudurezhi tai sugiezho.
Jianlai hhela amitu kun, fugusan kunyi panjiku Ezhanyi melie zhan jiuine.
Ene yenyin jiere fugusan kunladeye gouxioxini chonjikushi beye miende hhelai kun mutun panjine giezhoma, ruhher miende Huda mutun amituraghane giezho.
Duya baraku ghujinlawo. Ingiese ta zhughesene xioxin giezhi jinxin giedene onxian gie.
Zui zhunyonishi nieniedene shixinde ore. Oreku olon zuini khazhi widaghane.
Ta bayasuku zhugheghala nieniene giedene goude jienlie.
Ta zhao Huda tande ogisan nenjien mutun nieniene ushilazhi Huda ogisan yanyanji nenjienni gou gonjia danla.

Jianjichenla indan Hudai kielienyi jianjikuni wo. Ushilachenla indan Huda ogisan lilianghala ushilakuni wo. Ingiese yan gieliuzhe Ersa Mexihai tungo giezhi Hudade kuaikui ireghane. Kuaiku, qienlini chanqi izhi hhende ogi. Amine.
Mii orentula, shiiku khan mutun tai jiere irese goyade yama shiqin penjiwo giezhi ghudure wo giezhi bu jindadene
Mexiha mutun hhere hhantu shouku giezho giezhi bayasundu. Ingiese Mexihai famatui khizheghakude ta hende bayasuzhi jiuline.
Mexihai yenyin jiere kunla tai sugiese tande fuqi wine. Famatu ruhher, yejiushi Hudai Ruhher tai jiere wo.
Tai dunda kienliuzhe kun alaku, ghulaku, doghun shiqin gieku, ulie gonjiku shiqinyi gonjikughala shouku bu gie.
Mexihani tuji danlazhi shouku giese bu shizhedene ene nierei yenyinzhe Hudai kuai.
Panjiku shihou kuzhewo. Hudai bexinse panjizhi qiine. Matanse kaishi giese gouxioxini ulie shunjisan kunlai jiego matui gholune?
Pse, "Gou kunyi jiuiku chijiashi xienlian witu kun, zuirenla matui gholune?"
Ingiese Hudai isi mutun shouku giesan kunla izhi gouni giezhi duyai zhayaghasan kekaotu Ezhande goyane ogikui wo.
Tai dunda zhanlao danlasan kunlade bi sughazhi kielieye. Biyeshi zhanlao wo, Mexiha shouku giekude ganzhen beizhi jianlai khizheku famade hhantu xianshou giechen kun wo.
Tai dundadu Hudai ghonilai qiezhe. Hudai isi mutun hhelai zhaogu gie. Mienqian bu giedene yenyizhe gie. Baerde oluzhi bu giedene bayasuzhi gie.
Tande ogisan ghonilai gofende bu gonjizhi gieku yanzi uzhegha.
Ingiese Zui Fugie Adulachen xienjikude ibeizi ulie qida oluku famatu maghalai tande ogine.

Nasuchighan kunla, taye qingiezhi zhanlaolai shunji. Ta man nieniedene oluzhi goyane meilade uzhekui wiqin danlaghazhi pixilie. "Huda goyane undude uzhesan kunlai fandui giene. Goyane meilade uzhesan kunlade nenjien ogine."
Ingiese ta Hudai nenlitu kha doura goyane boghonide uzhe. Shihou kuzhese hhe tai undudaghane.
Ta munan giekulane man Hudade echigha, hhe tai gonjine.
Ta xioxin giezhi jinxin gie. Tai duitou Ibilisi onghonosan shizi mutun eneman hhemanji yozhi ijieku kun ereizho.
Ta xianxin giesan zhughene khiduzheghazhi hhei dui. Duyani gaijiula niekielienji shouku giesei ta mejiene.
Nenjien durusan Huda, Mexihai tungo giezhi tai uruzhi hhei chanqiku famade ireghasan hhe zhanshi jiere shouku giesan tai qinsi hulunshighazhi khiduzheghane, lilian ogizhi undanlaghane.
Qienlini chanqi izhi hhende ogi. Amine!

Bi Seilai tungo giezhi ene okho xinni tande huaiwo. Bi uzhese hheshi nie kekaotu gaijiu wo. Bi xin huaikushi eneshi Hudai zhenzhenji nenjien wo giezhi tande sughazhi kieliezhi ganzhen beine giezho. Ta ene nenjien jiere bei.
Tanre hhantu sunghusan Babilunni jiohui tande kielien asazho. Mii kewon Makeye kielien asazho.
Ta oreku zhugheghala nieniedene kielien asa. Mexihai miende bisan tande man pinnan ogi gie!
2 Beduru
Ersa Mexihade hoji, shitu danlasan Ximun-Beduru mai Huda, jiuichen Ersa Mexihai gundanni tungo giezhi bijien mutun zhiguitu xianxin gieku bisan kunlade xin huaizho.
Nenjien, pinnan Huda, mai Ezhan Ersani tanikui tungo giezhi tande olon ire gie!
Huda tebieji nenlighalane matan xienliande udu daokude keresanlai man ogizho. Goya famatu, gounighalane mai urusan hhei tanikughala ingiezho.
Enezighanyi tungo giezhi Huda zhiguitu, fugie dainni matande ogizho. Ingiedene nefuxinse iresan duyani qida olukuse tai likai gieghazhi Hudai tejiende hhantulaghazho.
Zhen ene yenyinde oluzhi ta xiacha giezhi xianxin gieku jiere gounii, gouni jiere erlini,
erlin jiere goyane kunzhi giekui, goyane kunzhi gieku jiere rennaini, rennai jiere xienliantui,
xienliantu jiere gaijiulade orekui, gaijiulade oreku jiere kunlade orekui olodogha.
Enela tande bizhi olodose mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihani taniku jiere tai yama oronde wizhi xiogo witui ulie gholughane.
Kunde ene giedun uwoshi zinie chadashikui chanlazhi gholoshikui chanla dane, sugho niekielien wo. Daosan zuinini arughasei matazho.
Ingiese gaijiula, ta genjia xiacha giezhi Huda tai urusan, sunghusanyi khidunde gholugha. Ta enei giese ulie furane.
Ingiezhi giese mai Ezhan, yeshijiu jiuichen Ersa Mexihani chanqiku gojiade sunfande orone.
Ta ijin enelai mejiezhi ede bisan zhendao jiere khidunde beizho, ingieliuzhe bi enelai chan tande jilaghaye.
Bi sumulase bi amitu xienzide enelai tande jila ireghase indanji wo.
Mai Ezhan Ersa Mexiha made mejieghasan mutun mii shihou oloncha widakui bi mejiene.
Bi duya ijiedene ene shiqinlai tai chan jilaghane giezhi bi jinlianji xiacha giene.
Bijien mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihani fugie nenli, hhe ireku shiqinlai tande kieliekushi goude bienjisan yama genzi witu guhualai ese daghazho. Bijien hhei famatui qinsi uzhezhi daozho.
Zui famatu hhense shenqi irezhi "Eneshi bi oresan mii kewon wo, bi hhende xiqi wo." giezhi hhende kieliekude hhe ada Hudase zhigui, famani jienliewo.
Bijien hhere zhiguitu ulade bikude ene shenqi asiman jierese iresanyi qinsi sonosuwo.

Matande pse xienzhila melie kieliesan genjia kekaotu kielien wine. Ta hhei zhuyi giese oluzho. Hheshi kharanide zhouisan zhula niekielien wo, ogheizhi eqiemaghaku hodun tai zhughede khizhetula zhouine.
Ta mejieku zui zhunyonishi ene wo, jinwun jieredu soyuji melie kieliesan kielienlai goyane isighala jieshi giese ulie olune.
Melie kieliesan kielienshi kunni isighala kieliesan pusho, Shenlin kunni zhughei gojiolughadene Hudai isii kielieghazho.

Eqighandei bexinlai dunda jia xienzhila khizhesan mutun jianlai tai dundaye jia loushila khizhene. Hhela ghulazhi kunni widaghaku daolini ireghane. Hhela goyai shuisan Ezhanni ulie renjizhi widakude holune.
Ingieliuzhe olon kunla hhela lon kijiezhi hu giesanyi daghane. Hhelai yenyinghala zhendaoni sugiene.
Hhela tanxin giezhi ghudanghala tai jierese haochu ereine giezho. Huda hhelade eqighanse zui jinjizho, hhelai widaghakui danwu ulie giene.
Huda zui fanjisan qienxienlai ese rouliedene dozoheini khara nokiende bendazhi panjikui sagheighazho.
Pse eqighanku duyani ese rouliedene xienlian witu kunlai duyade hunshui ireghazhi zinie gundanni chonjisan Nuhhani nie gie neiman kunyi feilieghawo.
Pse Sodoma, Emola ghua chenshide zui jinjidene sideragha funiesun gholughazhi 1 houku xienlian witu kunlade jingao giezho.
Zinie mouxien kunla hu giesande yuchou giesan gou kun Luteini jiuiwo.
Hhe gou kun hhelai dunda niudunie souzhi hhela giesan mouxiennilai chanlazhi sonosuse hhei gou zhugheni otuzho.
Ingiese Ezhan xienliantu kunyi shiikuse matugie jiuizhi gou witu kunyi feilieghadene panjiku udude faikui mejiene.
Tebieshi beyeni zannan nefuxinni daghasan kunla, pse qienlini yamacha ulie teisan kunlai genjia ingiene. Hhela jionaoghazhi goyane fugiede uzhezhi asiman jieredu famatulase ulie ayidene sugienema,
qienxienliuzhe fugie lilian, nenli bidene sugieku kielienghala Ezhanyi melie asiman jieredu famatulai ulie zhane.
Enezighan jia loushila olusanse alaku, yama sumula daku chushen mutun goya sugiesanne ulie mejiene, chushen mutun widane.
Hhela gou wini giedene goyai jiere gou wini ireghazho. Hhela udu hu giese bayasukui wo giezho. Tanre hhantu ijiekude piendakui giezhi bayasuzho. Hhelashi goujia, cheiqisan wo.
Hhela jin piofen giekui ereizho, ulie beidene zui fanjine. Bixin kunlai miine. Hhelai zhughede tanxin gieku gon oluwo. Hhelashi kharakui wo.
Hhela zhen moni bendadene Bierni kewon Balanni moni daghazhi xiemacha echiwo. Balan zhendan witu baerde xiqi bidene
goya codasandene kheilaghawo. Enzheghe kielien kielie danema, kunni shenqighala kielien kieliezhi ene xienzhi fenjiulisei danlawo.
Enezighan kunlashi usu witu bula wo, honfen kei feiliesan u niekielien wo. Zui khara oronni hhelade zhunbei giezho.
Hhela yama oronde wiku fugie kielien kieliezhi hu gieku nefuxinghala hhezighan codasan shenhose jian likai giesan kunlai miizho.
Hhela kunlade ziyu ogine giezhi dain giezhoma, goyane qida olukude hoji danlazho. Kunni yan hanshiliese yande hoji danlazho.
Kunla mai Ezhan, yeshijiu jiuichen Ersa Mexihai tanikughala duyani zannannise andadene zannanni pse hhelai jiohoro giezhi hanshiliese hhelai khuinashiku qinkon eqighankude ulie kurune.
Hhela zhen moni tanidene jienliesan zhiguitu minlinni bendase ulie mejiekuse da gou wo.
Kunla kieliesan kielien shuhua wo, hhelai jiere gholuwo, "Noghei kharei ire goya benzhesanne ijiene." "Wagha arughasan khighei pse shuwade ghoghoreine."
Mii orentula, eneshi bi tande huaisan ji 2 hui xin wo. Ene ghua xin dunda tai qixin giezhi loushi zhugheitai olodoghane giezho.
Zhiguitu xienzhila melie kieliesan kielienyi, pse tai shitulai tungo giezhi Ezhan, yeshijiu jiuichen ogisan minlinyi tai jila ireghane giezho.
Ta mejieku zui zhunyonishi ene wo, duya baraku xienzide uzhezhi xiniechen kunla khizhedene duranghalane giezhi uzhezhi xiniezhi
Ersa irene giezhi dain giesan khala wine? Mai xienrenla fugusanse eli kutula yanyanjila man wine, zui melieshida zhayaghasanghala niekielien wo. giezhi kieliene.
Hhela eqighandei Hudai kielienghala asimanni giesei, pse zemin ususe khizhezhi usughala gholusei nanxighan matazho.
Hhe shihouku duyani usughala manjidene widaghawoma,
edeku asiman, zeminni yen Hudai kielienghala feilieghazhi xienlian witu kunlai panjizhi widaghaku hhe udu kurune. Hhe shihoude asiman, zeminni khanghala tulie widaghane.
Mii orentula, enei ta bu mata, Ezhan uzhese niudushi 1000 nien wo, 1000 nienshi niudu wo.
Ezhan niezhan kunla sumulasan mutun dain giesanne danwu giezhi ulie chenjighakui pusho. Shijishan hhe tai rennai giezhi nieda ulie widaghadene jien kunlai geizhen gieghaku duran wo.
Ezhanni udu ghughei mutun irene. Hhe udude nie fugie shenqi irese asiman wida khine. Asiman jieredulai khanghala tulie widaghane. Zemin, zemin jiere giesanlai man widaghane.
Yanyanjila man ingie widase ta matunie kun danlane? Ta indan zhiguide, xienliande udu daokuni wo.
Hudai udui panjizhi ghujighan ire gie. Hhe udu kuzhese asimanyi khan tulie widaghane, asiman jieredulai tulie xiui widaghane.
Matan Huda dain giesan mutun gundanni durusan shini asiman, shini zeminni sagheizho.
Ingiese mii orentula, ta ene shiqinlai sagheise xiacha giezhi goyane bu zannanshighadene yama kheilakui wizhi Hudare heqishi.
Mai Ezhan rennai giekushi jiuiku jihui wo giezhi sumula. Zhen matan oresan gaijiu Baolo zhao Huda hhende ogisan aghelighala tande xin huaisan mutun wo.
Hhei xinla jiere man enezighan shiqinlai kieliezho. Xin jiere niezhanlai dunjireku chijiashi erlin witu, undan witu kunla psedu jinwun mutun codazhi lijie giedene goyane widaghawo.
Ingiese mii orentula, ta enei eqighan mejiese goude xioxin gie. Pse mouxien kunlai codasan tai miidene goya undanlasan oronsene anda boune.
Ta mai Ezhan, yeshijiu jiuichen Ersa Mexihani nenjien, taniku jiere henda. Kuaikui edese chanqi hhende ogi. Amine!
1 Yaheiya
Hhe dei qiikude bisan aminni kielien giezhi urusan hhei tande kielieye. Bijien hhei chenliezhi daowo, nudundene chujieghezhi daozho, qinsi uzhezhi khaghalane maqizhi daowo.
Ene amin xienjizhi bijien uzhezhi daowo. Ganzhen beizhi ene chanqiku aminni tande kielieye. Hhe Huda Adaghala izhi hhantu wo, ede bijiende xienjighazho.
Bijien chanlasan, chenliesanne tande kieliekushi tai bijienre laiwon gieghane giezho. Matanyi laiwonshi Ada, hhei kewon Ersa Mexihare laiwon giekuni wo.
Ene kielienni tande huaizhi ogikushi matanyi hende bayasughane giezho.
Hudashi gon wo. Hheni sudoro kharani goujida uwo. Eneshi bijien Ezhanse chenliedene tande chonjizhi ogisan xioxi wo.
Matan Hudaghala laiwon giezho giezhi kieliedene kharanide yose ghudan kieliezho, zhendaoi ese zunjizho.
Hhe goyane gon dunda biku mutun matanye gon dunda yose matan nienierene laiwon giezho. Pse hhei kewon Ersani chusun mai zuini man waghazhi arughane.
Matande zui uwo giezhi kieliese goyane piendazho, mai sudoro zhendao uwo.
Matan zuine renjise Huda kekao, gundan wo, mai zuini mienliene. Mai codasanlai man arughane.
Matan zui uye fanjizho giezhi kieliese Hudai ghudanchi danlaghazho. Hhei kielien mai sudoro uwo.
Mii kesilaya, bi enei tande huaikushi tai zui ulie fanjighane giezho. Kien zui fanjise Adai melie matande nie banjichen wine. Hheshi nie gundan kun, Ersa Mexiha wo.
Hhe mai zuini deilazhi fuguwo. Zi mai zuide pusho, qienxiani kunlai zuide oluzhi fuguwo.
Matan Hudai minlinyi zunjise matan Hudai tanikui mejiene.
Kien "Hhei tanine." giezhi kieliedene hhei minlinyi ulie zunjise ghudan kieliezho, zhendao hhei sudoro uwo.
Kien Hudai kielienyi zunjise Hudade zhenzhenji orezho. Ingiese matan hhei sudoro bikui mejiene.
Kien goyane Hudai sudoro beizho giezhi kieliese indan Ersa Mexiha mutun giekuni wo.
Mii orentula, ede bi tande huaisanshi shini minlin pusho. Eneshi ta dei qiikude jienliesan khuichen minlin wo. Ene khuichen minlinshi ta chenliezhi daosan kielien wo.
Ingieliuzhe bi tande nie shini minlin huaizho, Mexihai miende tai miende zhenni wo. Kharani lalaghan widazhi zhenzhenji gon zhouizhi qiiwo.
Kien goyane gon dunda wo giezhi kieliedene gaijiulane henjise da kharanide wo.
Kien gaijiuladene orese gon dunda wo. Hhei sudoro zui gieghakui uwo.
Kien gaijiulani henjise kharanide wo. Hhe kharanide yozho, khala echikune ulie mejiene. Hhe kharanide yose kharani hhei sugho gholughawo.
Kewosila, bi tande xin huaikushi Mexihai niereghala tai zuini mienliewo.
Oqio kunla, bi tande xin huaikushi ta dei qiikude bisan hhei tanine. Nasuchighan kunla, bi tande xin huaikushi ta Ibilisise injiwo.

Kewosila, bi tande xin huaikushi ta Adai tanine. Oqio kunla, bi tande xin huaikushi ta dei qiikude bisan hhei tanine. Nasuchighan kunla, bi tande xin huaikushi ta khidun wo. Tai sudoro Hudai kielien wine. Ta hhe doghunnise injiwo.
Duya, duya jieredu ojienlai bu ore. Kien duyai orese hhei sudoro Adade oreku zhughe uwo.
Duya jieredulashi man beyeni nefuxin, nudunni nefuxin, baerni kuaiku wo. Enelashi Adase iresan pusho, duyase irezho.
Ene duya, duya jieredu nefuxin giekula man widane, zinie Hudai isii zunjizhi giesan kun chanqi amitu wo.
Kewosila, ede duya baraku shihou wo. Mexihani duitou irekui ta chenliezhi daozho. Ede Mexihani duitoula olon khizhewo. Ingiese matan duya baraku shihoui mejiene.
Hhela matanyi dundase khizhi echise matannughun pusho. Matanughun enbese izhi matanre hhantu wo. Hhela khizhi echise matannughun pusho bikui zhenmin giewo.
Ta hhe zhiguituse tebieji nenjienni jienliezho. Ingiese ta man mejiene.
Bi tande xin huaikushi ta zhendaoni mejie dakui pusho, ta zhendaoni mejiene, zhendaose jiani ulie khizhene.
Kienshi ghudan kieliechen wo? Ersashi Mexiha bikui chenren ulie giechen pushonu? Kien Ada, kewonni chenren ulie giese hheshijiu Mexihani duitou wo.
Kien kewonyini chenren ulie giese hhende Adaye uwo. Kewonyini chenren giese Adaye wine.
Tai kieliese ta dei qiikude chenliesanne zhughedene ghura. Ingiese ta kewon, Adai sudoro beine.
Eneshi hhe qinsi matande dain giesan chanqiku amin wo.
Bi ene shiqinlani tande huaise tani piendachen kunlai zhiizhi huaizho.

Tai kieliese tai sudoro Ezhanse jienliesan tebieji nenjien wine. Ingiese tande kiema surughaku biyo uwo. Hhei tebieji nenjien tande man surughane. Surughasanshi jiani pusho, zhenni wo. Ingiese hhe surughasan mutun ta hhei sudoro bei.
Ingiese mii kesila, ta Ersa Mexihai sudoro bei. Ingiese Ersa Mexiha xienjikude matan hhei melie yamase ayizhi shizhekui uwo.
Hhe gundan bikuni ta mejiene. Ingiese gundande giesan kunlashi man Hudase iresan kewosi bikuiye mejiene.
Ta uzhe, Ada matande matugiezhi orezho. Huda matanyi goyane kewosi wo giezhi uruzho. Matanshi hhei kesila enbene. Duyani kunla matanyi tani dakushi Hudai tani dazho.
Mii orentula, ede matanshi Hudai kesila wo. Jianlai matan matui gholukuni da ulie mejienema, Ersa Mexiha xienjikude matan hhei zhen yanziini chanlase matan hhe mutun gholukui mejiene.
Kien hhei kouizhi enei panjise goyane Ersa Mexiha mutun ganjinraghane.
Kien zui fanjise guijinni fanjizho. Guijinni fanjise jiushi zui wo.
Ersa Mexiha zuini widaghale iresanyi ta mejiene. Hhende yama zui uwo.
Hhei sudoro beisan kun zui ulie fanjine. Zui fanjisan kun hhei uzhezhi ese daozho, taniye dane.
Kewosila, ta goyane bu piendagha. Gundande giesan kunshi Ersa Mexiha mutun gundan kun wo.
Zui fanjisan kunshi Ibilisinughun wo. Ibilisi dei qiisanse zui fanjizho. Ibilisini giekuni widaghane giezhi Hudai Kewon irezhi daozho.
Hudase iresan kesila zui ulie fanjine. Hhelai sudoro Huda ogisan fure wine. Hhelashi Hudase iresan kesila wo, ingiese zui fanji dane.
Kienshi Hudai kesila, Ibilisii kesila bikui ingiezhi mejiene. Gundande ulie giezhi gaijiuladene ulie orese Hudanughun pusho.
Matan nieniedene orekuni wo. Eneshi ta dei qiikude chenliesan daoli wo.
Jiabini bu dagha. Hheshi Ibilisinughun wo. Jiune alazho. Yangiezhi alazho? Hheni giekushi mouxienni wo. Jiuni giekushi gouni wo.
Gaijiula, duyai kunla tani henjise ta bu ghanira.
Matan gaijiulade orese fugukuse amitude iresei mejiene. Ulie orechenla fugukude beizho.
Kien gaijiulani henjise kun alaku niekielien wo. Kun alasan kunni sudoro chanqiku amin wikuni ta mejiene.
Ersa Mexiha matande oluzhi aminne sheiwo. Ingiese matan yanshi orekuni mejiene. Matanye indan gaijiulade aminni sheikuni wo.
Kiende baer olon bidene nanxin jiulani uzhedene zhughene khidunde giezhi ulie gonjise Hudade oreku zhughe hhei sudoro matugie wine?
Kesila, matan orese zi amande bu kieliedene xindun giezhi shixinde gieye.
Ingiezhi giese matanshi zhendaose iresei mejiene. Matan zhughedene gui gieliuzhe mai zhughe Hudai melie undan wo. Hudashi mai zhughese pse fugie wo. Yan shiqinyiliuzhe man mejiene.
Mii orentula, mai zhughede gui ulie giese Hudai melie yama ayikui uwo,
pse hhense yan xiahua giese yan ogine. Matan hhei zunjizhi hhe bayasukui giezho.
Hhei minlinshi matan hhei kewon Ersa Mexihai niereni xianxin giekuni wo. Pse hhe ogisan minlin mutun nieniedene orekuni wo.
Kien Hudai minlinyi zunjise hhe Hudai sudoro beizho. Hudaye hhei sudoro beizho. Huda mai sudoro beisei hhe ogisan Shenlinghala mejiene.
Mii orentula, ta ruhherlani man xianxin giezhi ulie olune. Hhelashi Hudanughun enbenu pusho bikui ta shiizhi uzhekuni wo. Duya jiere ede olon jia xienzhi khizhezho.
Hudai ruhherni ingiezhi mejiene, Ersa Mexiha kun gholudene iresei chenren giese hheshi Hudase iresei enbene.
Ersa Mexihani chenren ulie giese hheshi Hudase iresan pusho. Eneshi Mexihani duitouni ruhher wo. Hhe irene giekuni ta eqighanse chenliezhoma, ede ijin duya jiere wo.
Kewosila, tashi Hudanughun wo. Tani sudoro bisan hhe duyade bisan hhense hen wo. Ingiese ta jia xienzhilase injiwo.
Hhelashi duyanughun wo. Duyani shiqinyi kieliese duyai kunla hhelani kielienni chenliene.
Matanshi Hudanughun wo. Hudai tanichen kun mai kielienni chenliene. Hudanughun pushoshi manughunni ulie chenliene. Ingiezhi hhelashi zhenni onu piendachen bikui mejiene.
Mii orentula, matan nieniedene oreye. Orekushi Hudase irezho. Orechen kunshi Hudase iresan kewosi wo, Hudai tanine.
Ulie orechen Hudai tani dane. Hudashi oreku wo.
Huda orekune matande ingiezhi uzheghawo. Huda niekozi kewonne peizhi duyade ireghadene hhei tungo giezhi matanyi amituraghawo.
Eneshijiu oreku wo. Matan Hudade oresan pusho. Huda matande orezho. Hhe matande orezhi kewonne peizhi ireghadene mai zuini deilazhi fuguwo.
Mii orentula, Huda matande ingiezhi orezho. Matanye indan nieniedene orekuni wo.
Kun Hudai uzhezhi ese daozhoma, matan nieniedene orese Huda mai sudoro beizho. Hhei oreku mai dunda chengun oluwo.
Huda matande Shenlinne ogizho. Ingiese matan Hudai sudoro, Huda matanyi sudoro beisei mejiene.
Ada kewonne peizhi duyani kunlai jiuighale iresei bijien chanlawo, ye ganzhen beine.
Kien Ersashi Hudai Kewon giezhi renjise Huda hhei sudoro beizho. Hheye Hudai sudoro beizho.
Huda matande orekui matan mejiezho, xianxinye giezho. Hudashi oreku wo. Orechen kun Hudai sudoro beizho. Hudaye hhei sudoro beizho.
Oreku mai dunda ingiezhi chengun oluwo. Ersa Mexiha matugiese matanye duyade qingiene. Ingiese matan panjiku udude yamase ayikui uwo.
Orekui sudoro ayikui uwo. Zhenzhenji orese ayikui man widaghane. Ayichen kun faikuse ayizho. Ayichen kunni sudoro orekui chaizho.
Matan orekushi Huda xien matande orezho.
Kien, "Hudade orene." giezhi kieliedene gaijiulane henjise ghudan kieliezho. Chanla shidaku gaijiuladene ore dase chanla daku Hudade ore dane.
Hudade orechen kunla gaijiuladeneye orekuni wo. Eneshi hhe matande ogisan minlin wo.
Kien Ersashi Mexiha wo giezhi xianxin giese hheshi Hudase iresan kewosi wo. Adade oresan kun hhei kewosideye orene.
Matan Hudade orezhi hhei minlinyi zunjise matan Hudai kesilade orekui mejiene.
Matan Hudai minlinni zunjise Hudade orezho. Hheni minlinni zunjiku hende chijia uwo.
Hudase iresan kesila duyase inji shidane. Mai xianxin giekughala injine.
Duyase injisanshi kien wine? Ersashi Hudai Kewon wo giezhi xianxin giesanla pushonu?
Hheshijiu usu, chusunghala iresan Ersa Mexiha wo. Zinie usughala iresan pusho. Usu, chusunghala irewo. Enende Shenlin ganzhen beine. Shenlinshi zhendao wo.
Ganzhen beisanshi ghuran wo.
Shenlin, chusun, usu wo. Ene ghurulie niekielien ganzhen beine.
Matan kunni ganzhenni jienliese Hudai ganzhenni genjia jienliekuni wo. Ene ganzhenshi Huda kewondene oluzhi beisan wo.
Hudai Kewonni xianxin giechen kunyi sudoro ene ganzhen wine. Hudai xianxin ulie giechen kun Hudai ghudanchi danlaghazho. Huda kewondene ganzhen beisanyi hhe xianxin ese giezho.
Eneshijiu ganzhen beisan wo, "Huda chanqiku aminni matande ogiwo. Ene chanqiku hheni kewonni sudoro wine."
Kewon bichen kunde amin wine. Hudai Kewon wichen kunde amin uwo.
Bi enezighanyi tande huaikushi Hudai Kewonni niereni xianxin giesan tande chanqiku amin bikuni mejieghane giezho.
Matan Hudai melie echikude ulie ayine. Zhao hhei isi mutun xiahua giese hhe chenliene.
Matan xiahua giesei hhe chenliekui mejiese yan xiahua giese yan ogikuiye mejiene.
Kien gaijiula ulie fuguku zui fanjisei chanlase hhende oluzhi onxian gie. Huda ulie fuguku zui fanjisan kunlade amin ogine. Fuguku zui fanjise bi hhende onxian gie giezhi ulie kieliene.
Gou winilashi man zui woma, man fuguku zui pusho.
Hudase iresan kesila zui ulie fanjikui matan mejiene. Hudai kewon hhelai bouise Ibilisi hhelai hei dane.
Matanshi Hudanughun bikui, duyashi man Ibilisii kha doura bikui matan mejiene.

Matan Hudai Kewon irezhi matande agheli, lijie gieku nenli ogidene zhenzhenji Hudai tanighasei, pse matan hhe zhennii sudoro, yejiushi hhei kewon Ersa Mexihai sudoro bikui mejiene. Hheshijiu zhenzhenji Huda wo, chanqiku amin wo.
Kesila, ta nigiedalase gholodo.
2 Yaheiya
Bishi nie zhanlao wo. Huda sunghusan funi pse hhei kesilade xin huaizho. Bi tande shixin orezho. Zinie bi pusho, zhendaoni mejiesanla man tande orezho.
Tande orekushi zhendaoni yenyin wo. Ene zhendao mai sudoro wine, chanqi matanre hhantu wo.
Ada Huda, Adai Kewon Ersa Mexiha zhendao, orekuni zunjisan matande nenjien, ubali xiiku, pinnan ogi gie!
Bi uzhese chii niezhan kesila Adani minlinyi zunjizhi zhendaode yozho. Ingiese bi hende bayasuzho.
Ingiese funi, bi chade goude fenfulaye. Matan indan nieniedene orekuni wo. Eneshi nie shini minlin pusho, matan dei qiikude jienliesan minlin wo.
Matan Hudai minlinni zunjizhi giese eneshijiu oreku wo. Hhe ogisan minlinshi nieniedene orekuni wo. Enei ta eqighanse chenliezhi daowo.
Duya jiere olon piendachen kun khizhezho. Hhela Ersa Mexiha beye gholuzhi iresei ulie renjine. Hhelashi piendachen kun wo, Mexihani duitou wo.
Ta xioxin giezhi bijien giesan wilielai belien bu gholughadene Huda ogiku soyuji jianlini man linla.
Kien Mexihani sughasande ulie beizhi gholodose hhei sudoro Huda uwo. Sughasande beise hhei sudoro Ada Huda, kewonni Ersa Mexiha wine.
Kien Mexihani ene izhun sughasanghala ulie irese giedene bu jienlie. Kielienye bu asa.
Hhelade kielien asase hhelai doghunnide hhantulazho.
Bi tande huaiku shiqin da olon woma, meshuighala giejie jiere huaiku duran uwo. Bi xiwon giese tani hhende echizhi danmien kielieku duran wo. Ingiese matan hende bayasune.
Huda sunghusan eghechiichii kesila chade kielien asazho.
3 Yaheiya
Bishi nie zhanlao wo, zhughe jieredu Gaiyude xin huaizho. Bi chade shixin orezho.
Mii orentu, ruhherchii gou biku mutun shiqinlachii, beyechii man gou woshijiu.
Gaijiula kharei iredene chii zhughede zhendao wine, pse chi zhao zhendao mutun giezho giezhi zhenmin giese bi hende bayasuzho.
Bi chenliese kesilami zhao zhendao mutun giezho giese enense bayasukui uwo.
Mii orentu, chi gaijiulade tani daseye shixinde zhaogu giezho.
Hhela iredene ene jiohuini kunlade chi hhelade oresei kieliezho. Hhela mo yokude Huda bayasuku mutun ta izhi hhelai khughose gou wo.
Hhela Ersa Mexihani nierede oluzhi ghadane khireiwo, xianxin uye giechen niman kunlase yama ese kerewo.
Matan indan imutu kunlade banman giese oluzho. Ingiese matan zhendaode oluzhi hhelare lienshou gholune.
Ene shiqinde melieshida bi jiohuide xin huaizhoma, touzi danlakude xiqi bitu Jiutefei bijiennughunyi ese chenliezho.

Ingie bi echise hhe giesan shiqinlani kielie khizheghane. Hhe doghun kielienghala bijienni heizho. Dou enende ese kuruzhi mo yozhi chonjisan gaijiulani goya ulie jienliene, jienliene giesan kunyi ulie jienlieghane, da jiohuise tou khighane.
Mii orentu, doghunnii bu dagha, gounii dagha. Gouni giesanlashi Hudanughun wo, doghunni giesanla Hudai uzhezhi ese daozho.
Olon kunla Jimijiushi gou kun wo giezho, zhendao benshen hhende ganzhen beine. Bijienye hhende ganzhen beine. Bijien beisan ganzhenshi zhenni bikuni ta mejiene.
Bi chade huaiku shiqin da olon woma, meshui, bighala huaiku duran uwo.
Bi xiwon giese ghujighan chii chujieghedene danmien kielieku duran wo. Chade pinnan ogi gie. Zhanlienla man chii asazho. Chii hhendedu zhanlienlai zhao nierezhe kielien asa.
Yuda
Ersa Mexihani hoji, Yagebuni gaijiu Yuda tande xin huaizho. Tashi Ada Huda orezhi urusan wo, Ersa Mexihade oluzhi baohu giesanla wo.
Tande ubali xiiku, pinnan, orekui ologhonni ogi gie!

Mii orentula, matan hhantu jienliesan jiuiku shiqinni fanmiende bi yenlai tande xin huaiku hende duralazhoma, ede bi sumulase ta xianxin giekune goude bareizhi baohu gie giezhi xin huaizhi fenfulaku biyo wine. Ene xianxin giekushi Huda shentulade 1 huide ogisan wo.

Niezhan kunla tai dunda ghulazhi orozhezho. Enelashi xienlian witu kun wo, hhelai zuini jinjikui eqighanse huaizho. Hhela Hudai nenjienni lon kijiezhi hu giekui gholughazho. Da mai zi niekozi zhanguiji, Ezhan Ersa Mexihai ulie renjine.
Ta ene shiqinyi 1 huide man mejiewoma, bi tande pse jilaghaye giezho. Ersa bexinlane Aijise jiuidene khuinashi niezhan xianxin ulie giechen kunlai widaghawo.
Pse goya wizidene ulie beizhi sousan oronsene likai giesan qienxienlani fugie panjiku udu kuzhetula qieshenghala chanqi soziladene zui kharanide khazho.
Pse Sodoma, Emola, zhouwidedu chenshini kunlaye hhela mutun kunlare lon kijiezhi zhenchan wini naduzho. Ingiese hhelai faizhi ibeizi ulie xinieku khande teidene kunlade jingao giezho.
Hhe ghulazhi iresan jia loushilaye niekielien wo. Oruntan zhoujiliedene qienli wine giezho. Beyene zannanshighazho, qienlini yamacha ulie teine, da asiman jieredu famatulai sugiene.
Fugie qienxien Mijialeliuzhe qingiezhi ese giezho. Hhe Ibilisighala Musani fugusan beyede oluzhi jianjindukude sugieku kielienghala hhende zui ese jinjiwo. Zi ezhan chii kheila gie giewo.
