fugie shenqighala waradazhi kieliezho, "Jiuiku baozo sousan mai Hudaji ghoni ghughande wine!"
Qienxienla man baozo, zhanlao, jieran amitu ojienlai zhouwide beidene baozo melie papala Hudai beiizhi
kieliezho, "Amine! Zanjiku, kuaiku, agheli, mafan gieku, zhigui, nenli, lilianni Mai Hudade chanqi izhi ogi! Amine!"
Zhanlao dunda niekozi made asazho, "Enezighan chighan jien musisanshi kien wo? Hhela khalase irezho?"
Bi hhende kieliewo, "Mii gujiu, chi mejiene." Hhe made kieliewo, "Enezighan kunla zeinan dundase khizhezhi ghoni ghughanyi chusun hhelai jienni waghazhi chighanshighazho."
Ingiese "Hhela Hudai baozo melie xieni udu Hudai dajiende hhei beiizho. Baozo sousan hhe zhanfanghala hhelai huizho.
Hhela pse ulie oliesune, ulie undasune. Naran, pse hhereini hhelai tulie dane.
Ingiekushi baozo dundadu ghoni ghughan hhelai chezhezhi udurudene aminni usui bula konde echine, Huda hhelai nunpusunyi saine."
Ghoni ghughan ji 7 gie fenqioni keighakude asiman jiere bangie xioshi yama shenqi uwo.
Bi chanlase Hudai melie dolon qienxien beizho. Hhelade dolon laba ogizho.

Da nie qienxien iredene antanni xianlu bareizhi sidagha gieku teizi kanzide beizho. Olon xianni hhende ogizhi shentulai onxianghala hhantu baozo kondedu antanni sidagha gieku teizi jiere ogine giezho.
Hhe xianni funi shentulai onxianghala hhantu qienxienni khase Hudai melie khireiwo.
Ingie qienxien xianluni bareizhi sidagha gieku teizi jieredu khanni zhonlozhi durughadene zemin jiere kiese olien tunguliezho, fugie shenqi, shanjien, zemin gojioluzho.
Dolon laba bareisan dolon qienxien feiliene giezhi zhunbei giezho.
Ji 1 gie qienxien labani feiliese mendou, chusunghala huisan khan zemin jiere bouzhezho. Zeminni 3 fenzhi 1, mutunni 3 fenzhi 1 ni sidera widaghawo, pse noghon osunlai man sidera widaghawo.
Ji 2 gie qienxien labani feiliese khan siderasan xianlitu fugie ulai haide bendawo. Haini 3 fenzhi 1 chusun gholuwo,
Haini amitu ojien 3 fenzhi 1 fuguwo, chonni 3 fenzhi 1 qida oluwo.
Ji 3 gie qienxien labani feiliese hoba mutun siderasan fugie hodun asimanse moron, bulai 3 fenzhi 1 de bouzhewo.
Ene hodunni nierei Kou giene. Usuni 3 fenzhi 1 kouni gholuwo. Usu koudase olon kunla fuguwo.

Ji 4 gie qienxien labani feiliese naranni 3 fenzhi 1, sarani 3 fenzhi 1, hodunlai 3 fenzhi 1 ni eghizhi naran, sara, hodunlani 3 fenzhi 1 kharalawo. Uduni 3 fenzhi 1 de gon widawo, xieniye niekielien wo.
Bi chanlazhi sonosuse asimande musisan nie in fugie shenqighala kieliezho, "Gou widawo! Gou widawo! Duyade sousan kunlade gou widawo! Da ghuran qienxien labani feiliene giezho!"
Ji 5 gie qienxien labani feiliese bi chanlase nie hodun asimanse zemin jiere bouwo, jizi witu nokienni yeshii hhende ogizho.
Hhe nokienni niese funi ojiede mouizhi fugie luzini funii xianli. Ene funi naran, asimanni kharalaghawo.
Machazi funise khizhedene zemin jiere luiwo. Hhelade nenli ogizhi hoxian zemin jieredu xiezini nenlii xianli.
Hhelade fenfulazhi zemin jieredu osunji yanyanji noghon dunxi, mutunlai bu shanjidene zinie manlou jiere Hudai zhanzii ese taisan kunlai shanji giezho.
Hhelai bu alazhi tawun sara tendun shouigha giezho. Ene tendun xiezi kunyi jinjisan niekielien wo.
Hhezighan udude kun fugune giezhoma fugu dane. Fuguku duran biliuzhe fuguku hhelase piizho.
Machazini yanzi hoxian zhan eghindune giezhi zhunbei gie goudaghasan moreii xianli. Qiorun jiere zhosan antanni maghalai xianli, ungienni ere kunyi ungiei xianli,
usunni biereini usunyi xianli, shidunni shizii shidunyi xianli.
Echan jiereni qiemu majiai xianlitu huiku majia wine. Hhelai sibanyini shenqi hoxian olon mache holuzhi zhanchan jiere khireiku shenqii xianli.
Hhelai xien xiezii xianli, xien jieredu duni kunyi tawun sara shanji shidane.
Jizi witu nokienni qienxien hhelade honshan danlazho. Xibolai kielienghala kieliese niereini Yabadun giene, Xila kielienghala Yabolun giene.
Ji 1 gie zeinan daowo. Uzhe, pse ghua zeinan irene.
Ji 6 gie qienxien labani feiliese bi sonosuse nie shenqi Hudai meliedu antanni sidagha gieku teizii jieran gochase khizhezho.
Ene shenqi laba bareisan ji 6 gie qienxiende kieliezho, "Yufalaji fugie moronde banlasan jieran qienxienni andagha."
Ingie jieran qienxienni andaghawo. Hhela alinie hon, sara, udu, zhuntoude kunni 3 fenzhi 1 ni alakui zhunbei gie goudaghazho.
Bi shuzii sonosuse hhelade morei unusan budui lianyi wine.

Bi zhoujin mutun hhezighan morei, morei unusanlai chanlawo. Morei unusanlai echan jiere huiku majia wine. Majiani yenshei khan mutun hulan, manou mutun kugie, liuhon mutun shira wo. Moreini qiorun shizini qiorunni xianli. Khan, funi, liuhon, moreini amanse khizhezho.
Amanseni khizhesan khan, funi, liuhon ene ghuran zeinanghala kunni 3 fenzhi 1 ni alawo.
Moreilai nenli amandeji xiende wo. Xienni mogheini xianli, qiorun bizhi qiorunghala kunni heine.

Enezighan zeinanghala ese alasan psedu kunla goya khaghalane giesanne geizhen ese giedene da sheitanlai, pse hhezighan uzhe daku, sonosu daku, yo daku, antan, miengu, tun, tashi, muzhaghala giesan nigiedalai beiizho.
Hhela kun alaku, fashu shuaiku, lon kijieku, ghulaku shiqinlasene geizhen ese giezho.
Bi pse chanlase dou nie fugie liliantu qienxien asimanse bouzhezhi olienni nanbezho, qiorun jiereni lun sulasan wine, ungienni naranni xianli, ghua konni khantu tuhuai xianli.
Hhei khade keighasan ga shu wine. Borun konni haini taizho, soghei konni zeminni taizho.
Fugie shenqighala waradase hoxian shizi onghonosei xianli. Waradakude dolon olien tunguliesan shenqi khizhezho.
Dolon olien tunguliesan shenqi khizhekude bi hhei huaine giezho. Ingiekude bi sonosuse asimanse shenqi kieliezhi dolon olien tunguliesan kieliesei bu huaidene fenji giezho.
Bi chanlasan hai, zeminni taisan qienxien asimande borun khane zhadeighadene
zhiizhi asiman, asiman jieredu ojien, zemin, zemin jieredu ojien, hai, hai dundadu ojienlai zhayaghasan chanqi izhi amituku hhende fayen giezhi kieliezho, "Pse danwu ulie giene.
Ji 7 gie qienxien labani feiliekude Hudai mimi Huda xienzhi hojiladene chonjizhi ogisan gouxioxi mutun chenjine."
Bi melieshi asimanse sonosusan shenqi pse made kieliewo, "Chi echidene hai, zeminni taisan qienxienni khase keighasan shuni agi."
Bi qienxienyi hhende yo dao horosan ga shuni made ogi giezhi kieliewo. Hhe made kieliewo, "Chi bareidene ijie agi. Kielidechii koudanema, amandechii qiende shimei niekielien wo."
Bi qienxienyi khase ga shuni jienlie daozhedene ijie agise mii amande zhenzhenji qiende shimei niekielien wo, kielidemi kou wo.
Pse made kieliezho, "Chi olon minzu, gojia, yanyanji kielienyi kieliechen kun, honshanlai fanmiende kieliesan Hudai kielienyi indan pse kieliekuni wo."
Made nie zhugunyi xianlitu chizii ogizhi kieliezho, "Bosizhedene Hudai dajien, sidagha gieku teizi, pse hhende libai giesan kunlai nanji.
Dajienni ghadanedu yenzii bu nanji, hhei niman kunlade ogizho. Hhela zhiguitu chenshini 42 gie sara tai pindaghane.
Bi ghua ganzhen beisan kundene madei jien musighazhi qienli ogidene 1260 qien Hudai daolini kielieghane."
Hhelashi duyai Ezhanyi melie beisan ghua ganlan mutun, ghua zhula teizi wo.
Kien hhelai heine giese hhelai amanse khan khizhezhi duitoulai sidera widaghane. Hhelai heine giesanlai kenjin ingiezhi alane.
Ene ghualade Hudai kielienyi kielieku udude asimanni menjighadene ghura ulie boughaku nenli wine. Pse usulai chusun gholughazhi da goyane isizhe yanyanji zeinanghala duyai eghiku nenli wine.
Hhela ganzhen bei balukude jizi witu nokiense khizhesan yewo hhelare eghinduzhi injidene hhelai alane.
Hhelani fugusan beyeni fugie chenshini geidoude jiene. Ene chenshini bilazhi kieliese Sodomaye giene, Aijiye giene, jiushi hhelai Ezhanni shizijia jiere ghada alasan oron wo.
Go minzu, go pai, go kielien, go gojialase iresan kunla hhelai fugusan beyei ghurudu zharun xihan uzhezhi mezade ulie teighane.
Ene ghua xienzhila zemin jiere sousan kunlai tendun shouighazhi daozho, ingiese zemin jiere sousan kunla hhela fugusande bayasuzhi nieniedene mure khughone.
Ghurudu zharun daodene amin bitu ho Hudai hhense hhelai sudoro orose hhela bosizhewo. Hhelai chanlasan kunla hende ayizho.
Ghua xienzhi sonosuse asimanse fugie shenqi hhelade kieliezho, "Enende khizhe." Hhela olienre hhantu asimande khiwo. Duitoulaniye chanlawo.
Zhen ingiekude zemin hende gojioluzhi chenshini 10 fenzhi 1 tairezho. Zemin gojioluzhi fugusan kun 7000 gie wo. Feiliesan kunla ayizhi kuaikui asiman jieredu Hudade ogizho.
Ji 2 gie zeinan daowo. Uzhe, ji 3 gie zeinan deigo irene.
Ji 7 gie qienxien labani feiliese asimande fugie shenqila bizhi kieliezho, "Duyani gojia mai Ezhanji hhe teisan Mexihani gojia gholuwo. Hhe chanqi izhi honshan danlane."
Hudai melie goya wizide sousan 24 gie zhanlao papaladene Hudai beiizhi
kieliezho, "Edeku, eqighanku Ezhan, nenlitu Huda, bijien chade mafan kielieye. Chi fugie nenli bareizhi honshan danlawo.

Gojiala noiwoma, chii hokuku irewo. Fugusan kunni panjiku shihou, chii hoji, xienzhi, shentu, jien chii jilasan kun fugiei gajiniji jianli linlaku shihou, Pse duyani pohai giesanlai chi widaghaku shihou irewo."
Ingiekude asimandedu Hudai dajien keizhi sudoroni kielien yenjisan xianzini uzhe shidane. Pse shanjien, fugie shenqi, olien tunguliesan, zemin gojiolusan, fugie mendou wine.
Asimande fugie zunji xienjizhi nie bierei naranni musizhi sarani taizho. Qiorun jierene 12 gie hoduntu honshan zhoku maghala zhozho.
Hhe kewosi laizhi olukude otuzhi tendun shouizhi waradazho.
Asimande pse nie zunji xienjizhi nie hulan lunde dolon qiorun, hharan gocha wo. Dolon qiorun jiereni dolon honshan zhoku ga maghala zhozho.
Hhe xienghalane asimanni hodunlai 3 fenzhi 1 ni laizhi zemin jiere bendawo. Pse kewosi olune giesan biereini melie beidene hhe oluse hhei kewosii ijiene giezho.
Bierei nie kewon oluwo. Ene kewon jianlai qiemu zhugunghala gojialai man gonjine. Hheni kewosii Hudai baozoi hhende qila echiwo.
Bierei hontande holuzhi echise Huda hhei hhende 1260 qien qiezhene giezhi zhunbei giesan oron wine.
Asiman jiere zhan eghindu qiiwo. Mijiale qienxienlarene lunghala eghinduzhi lunye kha douradedularene hhantu bosizhezhi eghinduzho.
Lun inji dase asiman jiere hhelade oron widazho.
Fugie lunshi gushihouni moghei wo, niereini Sheitan giene, pse Ibilisiye giene. Duyade sousan kunlai man miizho. Hhei zemin jiere bendawo, hhei kha douradedulaiye hhantu bendawo.
Bi sonosuse asimanse fugie shenqi kieliezho, "Ede mai Hudai jiuiku, nenli, gojia irezho, hhe teisan Mexiha qienli bareizho! Mai Hudai melie xieni uduji mai gaijiulai zhasan hhei benda boughawo.
Gaijiula lunni injikushi ghoni ghughanyi chusun, pse goyalane ganzhen beisan daolighala wo. Hhela amindene ulie orezhi fugukude kuzho.
Ingiese asiman, pse hhende sousanla bayasundu! Zemin, haide gou widawo! Ibilisi goyade shihou oloncha widakui mejiedene Hende hokuzhi tai hhende bouwo."
Lun goyai zemin jiere bendasei mejiedene kewon olusan biereini fenjiezhi biizho.
Ingiese fugie inni ghua sibanni biereide ogise hhe musidene mogheise piizhi hontanni goya orondene echiwo. Hhende biereini nie shihou, ghua shihou, olie shihou qiezhezho.
Moghei biereini khuinase amansene moron mutun usuni nunpuzhi biereini chunji yolaghane giezho.
Zemin biereide banman giezhi amanne keighadene lun amansene nunpusan usuni yenjiwo.
Lun biereide hokudene biereini psedu kesilare eghindule echizho. Ene kesilashi Hudai minlinyi zunjizhi Ersade ganzhen beisanla wo.

Qingiekude lun haibienzini shazi jiere beizho. Bi chanlase nie yewo haise khizhezhi hharan gocha, dolon qiorun wine. Hharan gocha jierene hharan honshan zhoku ga maghala zhozho. Dolon qiorun jiereni Hudai sugieku niere wine.
Bi chanlasan yewo laohuni xianli, konni gouxinni konni xianli, amanni shizini amanni xianli. Lun goya nenli, wizi, fugie qienline hhende ogiwo.
Bi chanlase yewoni dolon qiorun dunda niekozi hoxian fuguku shan deilazhoma goudazho. Zemin jieredula man ghanirazhi yewoni daghazho.
Hhela lunni beiikushi lun qienline yewode ogizho. Pse yewoni beiizhi kieliezho, "Kien ene yewoghala bilane, kien hheghala eghindu shidane?"
Yewode tungulieku, Hudai sugieku aman ogizho. Pse 42 gie sara durare gieku qienli ogizho.
Yewo amanne keighazhi Hudai sugieku kielien kieliezho. Hudai nierei, hhei zhanfan, jiushi asiman jiere sousanlai sugiezho.
Pse shentulare eghinduzhi injiku dainni jienliezhi go pai, go minzu, go kielien, go gojialai hanshilieku qienlini jienliezho.
Jien zemin jiere sousan, niereini duyai zhayaghasanse alasan ghoni ghughanyi aminni jilasan benzi jiere ese jilasan kunla man hhei beiine.
Chighin bitu kunla chenliendu!
Qianla echiku kunyi kenjin qianla echine. Khudoghoghala alaku kunyi kenjin khudoghoghala alane. Ingiese shentulade bixi rennai, xianxin gieku bikui wo.
Bi chanlase da nie yewo zeminse khizhezhi ghua gocha bisan ghoni ghughanyi xianli, kielien kieliese lunni xianli.
Hhe tou 1 gie yewoni nenlini hhei melie man khizheghazhi zemin, zemin jiere sousanlai, fuguku shanni goudaghasan tou 1 gie yewoni beiighazho.
Pse fugie ghudureqilai giezhi da kunlai melie khanni asimanse zeminde bouzheghazho.

Ene yewo qienlini jienliedene tou 1 gie yewoni melie ghudureqilai giezhi zemin jiere sousan kunlai miizho. Pse khudoghoghala shan deiladene ese fugusan yewode nie nigieda gie giezhi hhelade kieliezho.
Hhe nenlini jienliedene nigiedade ho ogizhi kielien kielieghazho, pse soyuji nigiedai ese beiisan kunlai man alaghazho.
Pse soyuji kunlai bugon fugiei, gajii, nanxinyi, bayanyi, hoji ese danlasan, hoji danlasanlai borun kha jiere onu manlou jiere zhanzi taighadene
zhanzi uwochenlai meimei ese gieghazho. Ene zhanzishi yewoni niere, pseshi yewoni nierei daibio giesan shuzi wo.
Enende agheli kerene. Jienzha kun ene yewoni shuzii sana khizhegha. Ene shuzi nie kunni nierei daibio giezho, 666 wo.
Bi chanlase ghoni ghughan Xiwunshande beizhi 144000 kun hhere hhantu wo! Hhelai manlou jiere hhei nierei, adaini nierei huaizho.
Bi sonosuse asimanse iresan shenqi hoxian olon usuni shenqi, fugie olien tunguliesan shenqii xianli. Bi sonosusan shenqi hoxian qin tanjisan kunla tanjisan shenqii xianli.
Hhela baozo melie pse jieran amitu ojien, zhanlaolai melie shini don doulazho. Zemin jierese shuizhi iresan 144000 kunse chugo kiemada ene donni suru dane.

Enezighan kunla biereini shighazhi ese daozho, biereilare kijiezhi ese daozho. Ghoni ghughan khala echise hhela hhei daghazho. Hhelashi kun dundase shuizhi iredene Hudaji ghoni ghughonde ogisan tou 1 ban kun wo.
Hhelai amanse ghudan ereizhi olu dane, hhelade jienjien goujida uwo.
Bi chanlase da nie qienxien asimande musizhi zemin jiere sousan go gojia, go pai, go kielien, minzulade chonjiku chanqiku gouxioxii bareizho.
Hhe fugie shenqighala kieliezho, "Hudai zunji! Kuaikui hhende ogi! Hhe panjiku shihou kuzhezho. Asiman, zemin, hai, bulai zhayaghasei beii!"
Pse nie qienxien irezhi kieliezho, "Soyuji gojialade lon kijiezhi hokukui ireghasan Babilun fugie chenshi furawo, furawo!"
Pse nie, jiushi ji 3 gie qienxien irezhi fugie shenqighala kieliezho, "Kien yewo, hhei yanzii beiizhi manlou jiere, kha jiere zhanzi taise
kienye Hudai hokukui shouine. Huda zui fugiede hokukune ireghane. Ene kunla zhiguitu qienxien, ghoni ghughanyi melie khan, liuhon dunda tendun shouine.
Hhela tendun shouisan funi chanqi izhi ojiede mouizho. Hhezighan yewo, yewoni nigiedai beiizhi hhei niereni zhanzii taisanlade udu xieniji nanran uwo."
Ingiese Hudai minlinyi zunjizhi Ersai xianxin gieku bisan shentulade bixi rennai bikui wo.

Bi sonosuse asimande shenqi bizhi kieliezho, "Enedu khuinashi Ezhanni miende fugusan kunlade fuqi wine giezhi chi huai." Ingiese Shenlin kieliezho, "Enbene, hhela khishulasansene xiine, giesande huibao wine."
Bi pse chanlase niegieda chighan olien wo! Olien jiere hoxian kunni kewon souzhi qiorun jierene honshan zhoku antanni maghala zhozho, khadene xidu liendao bareizho.
Pse nie qienxien dajiense khizhezhi olien jiere sousande fugie shenqighala waradazhi kieliezho, "Ghuraku shihou kuruzho. Zemin jieredu zhonjiala bolu momoreizho. Liendaoghalane ghura!"
Ingiese olien jiere sousan liendaoghalane nie ghaduliese zemin jiereshiku zhonjiani ghurawo.
Pse nie qienxien asiman jieredu Hudai dajiense khizhezhi xidu liendaoye bareizho.

Pse nie qienxien sidagha gieku teizise khizhezhi nenli bizhi khanni gonjizho. Xidu liendao bareisande fugie shenqighala waradazhi kieliezho, "Putou bolu momoreizho. Xidu liendaoghalane ghaduliezhi zemin jieredu putoui ghura."
Hhe qienxien liendaoghalane ghaduliezhi zemin jiereshiku putouni ghuradene Hudai hokuku fugie jiu gieku chizide bendawo.
Chenshi ghadane jiu gieku chizide putouni taizho. Hhense chusun usuruzhi khizhezhi undude morei ghada undu wo, gholode 1600 sitaji wo.
Bi pse chanlase asimande da nie zunji wine. Fugie, ghudure no wo. Dolon qienxien dolon zeinanni bareizho. Eneshi zuihouku zeinan wo. Hudai hokuku eneghala barane.
Bi chanlase khan huisan boli mutun hai wine. Yewo, yewoni nigieda, yewoni nierei daibio giesan shuzise injisan kunla boli hai jiere beizhi Hudai qinni bareidene
Hudai hoji Musai don, ghoni ghughanyi donni doulazhi kieliezho, "Ezhan Huda, fugie nenlituya, chii gieku fama wo, ghudure wo! Soyuji gojiani honshanya, chii mo gundan wo, zhen wo!
Ezhan, zinie chishi zhiguitu wo. Kien chii ulie zunjizhi chii nierei ulie kuaine? Soyuji gojiala irezhi chii beiikushi chi gundande giekune khizheghazho."
Enense khuinashi bi chanlase asiman jiere dajien keizho. Eneshi ganzhen beiku zhanfan wo.
Dajiense dolon zeinanni gonjisan dolon qienxien khizhewo. Ganjin, gieghantu gou jien musizhi echan jierene antanni popu banlazho.
Jieran amitu ojien dundadu niekozi chanqi izhi amituku Hudai hokukui zhonlozhi durughasan dolon antanni ighai dolon qienxiende ogiwo.
Hudai fama, nenlighala dajiende funi duruzho. Dolon qienxien dolon zeinanni bouzhezhi baraghatula kiema dajiende oro dane.
Bi sonosuse dajiense fugie shenqi khizhezhi dolon qienxiende kieliezho, "Ta echidene Hudai hokuku dolon ighai zeminde pojie."
Ji 1 gie qienxien echidene ighani zeminde pojiese yewoni zhanzi taisan, yewoni nigiedai beiisanlai beye jiere zannan, du yara khizhezho.
Ji 2 gie qienxien ighani haide pojiese hai fugusan kunni chusun mutun gholuwo. Haini amitu ojienla man fuguwo.
Ji 3 gie qienxien ighani moron, bulade pojiese usu chusun gholuwo.
Bi sonosuse usuni gonjisan qienxien kieliezho, "Eqighanku, edeku zhiguitu Huda, chi ingiezhi panjise gundan wo.
Hhela shentu, xienzhilai chusunyi usurughazhi daozho. Ede chi hhelade chusun ochighazho. Ingiezhi giese hhelade indanji wo!"
Bi pse sonosuse sidagha gieku teizise shenqi bizhi kieliezho, "Enbene, Ezhan Huda, fugie nenlituya, chii panjiku zhen wo, gundan wo!"
Ji 4 gie qienxien ighani naran nudunde pojiese nanran kunni khanghala kouine.
Kunlai hende hhereide kouise nenli bizhi zeinanni gonjisan Hudai nierei sugiezhi, da geizhen ulie giezhi kuaikui Hudade ulie ogine.
